tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// theg chen bstan pa'i snying po'i khrid yig bstan pa'i yang snying ngam nor phreng mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

theg chen bstan pa'i snying po'i khrid yig bstan pa'i yang snying zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rang rig ma bcos byang chub sems mchog gdod nas yongs grub 'khor lo'i mgon// rig stong mtha' bral bla ma mchog de ma bcos lhun 'byams phyag rgya che// bsngo bya sngo byed ngo bos stong pa dbu ma'i lam gyi chos lnga po// gdod ma'i dbyings su ro gcig gyur pa'i dam pa khyod kyis 'gro 'di srungs| |'dir theg pa chen po bstan pa'i snying po'i khrid yig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi brnag pa bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len/ zab pa'i mthar thug mdo sngags thams cad kyi snying khu/ nyams len thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba 'di nyid nyams su len pa la/ rgyu mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam tshul gyis rgyud sbyang ba dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa'i lam dngos nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sngon du 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po la spyi dang bye brag khyad par gsum las| dang po ni/ bla ma gang*/ bsten tshul ji lta bu/ lam rnyed nas ji ltar bya ba nyams su blang ba'i thabs so// dang po/ gzhung las/ yangam̐ dgam̐ lamam̐ stonam̐ zhes pas yang dag pa'i lam ni nges legs kyi go 'phang thob pa yin la de'i thabs ni tha mal gyi shes pa de sad par bya ba yin la/ de yang tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ yum rgyas pa las/ rab 'byor/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pha rol tu phyin pa ston par byed pa de dag la bsten par bya/ mnyan par bya/ bsnyen bkur bar bya zhes gsungs la/ de lta bu'i bshes gnyen de'i mtshan nyid ji lta bu zhe na/ gzhung las/ tshadam̐ ldanam̐ bla ྃmam̐ btsam̐l| |zhes pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bla ma'i tshad ni/ mgon po byams pas/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba// yon tan lhag par brtsaun bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la bsten// zhes pa'i chos bdun dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhig btsal bar bya'o// gnyis pa tshul ldan gyi bla ma de bsten tshul ji lta bu zhe na/

gzhung las/ skyo ྃmedam̐ gusam̐ pasam̐ stonam̐ pa'im̐ bka'am̐ bzhinam̐ sgrubam̐// ces pa ste/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ lha dang mi yi ston pa gang*// rkang gnyis thams cad mkhyen pa ste| |ma 'ongs bla ma'i gzugs kyis gnas// de nyid tshul 'dir bstan pa'o// zhes ston pa nyid rtsod dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen du brten pa'i dam pa rnams ni dus kun du bsten par bya ste/ de'i tshul ni byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'tshol ba ltar rang nyid ngal ba khyad du bsad nas lto gos la gyong bskur zhing tshe 'di'i 'ching ba las grol bar bya yi/ de lta min pa'i 'dzom 'dzom po skyid skyid po khe grags dang nga rgyal tshe 'di'i che thabs gtso bor 'don pa dag la ni mkhas grub kyi go 'phang thob pa rus sbal gyi spu la gos su re ba ltar ro// de yang bla ma tshul ldan de nyid dus kun tu mnyes pa kho na bya zhing*/ mi mnyes pa skad cig kyang mi bgyi ba ni shin tu gal che ba ste/ gzhung las/ zangam̐ zingam̐ rdzasam̐ dngam̐ srim̐ zhum̐ sgrubam̐ pasam̐ mchom̐d// ces pa'i zang zing gis mnyes par bya ba ni/ khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ khyim bdag gal te byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i chos tshig bzhi tshigs su bcad pa gcig pu zhig nyan te lung mnos pa blangs pa'i slob dpon de la gus par bya'o// g.yo med par rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i mchod pa thams cad kyis rim gro dang bkur sti bya'o// zhes zang zing gi dngos po yod dgu rang gi lus ngag yid dang bcas pa de la ltos med du phul nas mnyes par bya'o// sri zhu zhes pa dad gus kyis mnyes par bya ba yang*/ bsod nams thams cad sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpa' thos pa ji ltar btsal bar bya zhe na/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la nga rgyal bcom pa dang bka' blo bde bas sri zhu dang gus pa dang*/

'phangs pa dang gces par 'dzin cing ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar don dril na bla ma la sgo gsum ma gus pa thams cad spangs la gus pa'i sgo nas bsten par bya'o// sgrub pas mchod ces pa ni/ mi dge ba thams cad spangs pa tshul khrims gyi bslab pa/ dge ba mtha' dag sgrub pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/ rang gi sems 'dul ba ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa ste bslab pa gsum nyams pa med par sgrub pa ni mnyes pa thams cad kyi mchog ste/ dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod pa'i nang nas mchog ni chos kyi mchod pa ste/ de ni mchog dam pa/ mchog rab/ bla na med pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar mdor na dge ba'i bya bar dus 'da' bar bgyid pas mnyes par bya ba ste/ de ltar na bla ma dam pa de la zang zing gi sgo nas g.yo sgyu med pas mnyes pa/ nga rgyal med pa'i sgo nas dad gus sri zhus mnyes pa/ nyams chag med pa'i sgo nas sgrub pas mnyes pa ste/ mnyes pa gsum gyis tshul bzhin du bsten par bya'o| |de ltar bla ma bsten pa'i dus du thos bsam bya ba yang*/ gzhung las/ lem̐ lo'im̐ gnasam̐ spangam̐ zhes pa'i le lo dang rnam par g.yeng ba spangs te brtson par bya ba ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don la brtson par mi byed pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' dgon par gnas pa dang ldan pa'i bdud kyi lcags kyus zin pa yin no// zhes pas le lo spang la 'bad par bya zhing*/ de la brtson par bya ba'i chos kyang*/ gzhung las/ donam̐ ldanam̐ zhes don dang ldan pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bsgrub pa'i thabs rnams bsgrubs pa ste/ bram ze chen po sa ra has/ gang zhig bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu// gdung sel bsil ldan ngoms par mi 'thung bar// de ni bstan bcos don mang mya ngan gyi| |thang la skom pas gdungs te shi bar zad// ces pa ltar don dang ldan pa'i chos kho na btsal gyi/

don dang mi ldan pa ni/ dpung bzang las/ bud med mtshan nyid skyes pa'i mtshan nyid dang*// sman dang glang chen rta dang skar ma'i dpyad*// mtshon cha btags dang brtag dpyad rang bzo yi// bstan bcos ngan pa slob cing klog pa spang*| |zhes mdor na tshe 'di don du gnyer ba'i 'jig rten rgyang 'phen pa'i bstan bcos sman dpyad ngan sngags la sogs pa la ni brtson pa 'dor bar bya ste don med pa'i phyir ro// blang bar bya ba'i chos ni/ gzhung las/ thosam̐ bsam̐m byam̐ zhes pa ste/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing*// khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsung*| |zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang*// de ni drang srong gsung yin zlog pa gzhan// zhes rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi// dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad// thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa// de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang*// zhes rgyal ba'i gsung dpang du bzhag pa'i bstan bcos rnam dag ste/ de rnams ni yang dag par thos par bya ba'i chos so// de lta bu'i bka' dang bstan bcos rnams kyang nyan pa'i dus su snod kha sbub lta bu/ bsam pa'i dus zhabs rdol lta bu/ sgom pa'i dus dug can lta bu ste skyon gsum spangs shing de ltar thos pa rnams kyang yin rlom du song ba spangs nas don legs par bsam dgos pa yang*/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med// dga' bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug /shun pa zos pa'i mis ni bu ram ro// zhim po rnyed par nus pa ma yin no| |ji ltar shun pa de bzhin smra ba ste// de lta bu ni 'di la don sems yin// de lta bas na smra la dga' spangs te// rtag tu bag yod byos la don sems shig /ces gsungs shing thos pa mang yang don mi bsgom pa ni ngan 'gror 'gro ste/

ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ gal te mang du thos pas de rgyags shing*// thos pas rgyags nas tshul khrims mi bsrung na// tshul khrims 'chal bas ngan 'gror de 'gro ste// thos pa mang pos de la skyob mi nus/ zhes so/ gsum pa lam rnyed nas bya tshul ni/ gzhung las/ zabam̐ donam̐ rnyedam̐ nasam̐ gcigam̐ puram̐ dbem̐n gnam̐s bstenam̐// zhes pa ste/ bla ma'i gdams pa rnams thob pa kho nas mi chog nyams su len dgos la/ de yang las dang po pa rnams rnam g.yeng gi dbus su sgom pa mi 'thad pas dgon pa sogs bsten pa gnad zab ste/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ grong dang grong khyer dag la dga' spong la// rtag tu dben zhing nags khrod bsten par gyis| |bse ru lta bur rtag tu gnyis med byos// ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'thob 'gyur// zhes so// bzhi pa nyams su blang thabs ni/ gzhung las/ yonam̐ tanam̐ phunam̐ tshogam̐s gnasam̐ deram̐ brtsonam̐ 'grusam̐ brtsam̐m// zhes pas/ gnas dben pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yon tan phun sum tshogs pa 'phel ba'i gnas shig ste/ dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las/ gnas gang bsod snyoms blang ba'i yul ha cang yang mi ring ba/ ha cang yang mi nye ba/ chu dwangs shing rnyog pa med cing tshegs chung ba yod pa/ ljon shing dang me tog dang 'bras bu dang lo ma phun sum tshogs pa yod pa/ gcan gzan dang khro ba med pa/ phug dang ldan pa/ sman ljongs dang bcas pa thag thug med pa/ 'gro na bde ba/ dben zhing yid dga' ba'i gnas de lta bur gnas par bya'o// zhes gsungs la/ der gnas pa'i tshe rnam par g.yeng ba tshe 'di'i bya ba blos dor nas sgrub la brtson par bgyi ba yang*/ drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ khyim bdag gzhan yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dgon pa na gnas pas 'di ltar bdag ci'i phyir dgon pa na gnas par bsam ste/ dgon par gnas pa 'ba' zhig dge sbyong ma yin na/ dgon par ri dwags dang spre'u dang*/

chom rkun dang gdol pa dag kyang gnas te/ de dag kyang dge sbyong gi yon tan dang ldan pa ma yin pas bdag dgon par gnas nas dge sbyong gi don yongs su rdzogs par bya'o snyam du brtag par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar 'bad pa drag tu bya zhing*/ sgrub pa la mi 'bad pa dag dgon par gnas kyang ngal ba don med du 'gyur te/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa las/ sems g.yeng ba la 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan yang mi skye na bla na med pa yang dag pa'i byang chub ni lta smos kyang ci dgos// zhes gsungs shing*/ dben par gnas pa'i tshul yang 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgon par gnas zhes gsungs na/ ji tsam gyis dgon par gnas pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung dgon par gnas pas yid la byed pa brgyad bskyed par bya ste/ lus la mi blta bar bya ba dang*/ srog la mi blta bar bya ba dang*/ 'du 'dzi la mi blta bar bya ba dang*/ dgon pa'i yon tan la gnas par bya ba dang*/ chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar bya ba dang*/ log pa'i 'tsho bas 'tsho bar mi byed pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i 'tsho bas 'tsho bar byed pa dang*/ dge sbyong gi don yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang brgyad bskyed par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa kho na ltar gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa bye brag gi sngon 'gro la gnyis/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ lus kyi gnas thabs dang*/ bsgom bya dngos so// dang po ni gzhung las/ drangam̐ poram̐ skyilam̐ krungam̐ dranam̐ pam̐ mngom̐n bzhagam̐ nasam̐// zhes pas/ gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par lus drang por bsrangs shing rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag sogs lus rnam snang gi chos lnga'am bdun gyis gnas dgos te/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi phan yon bstan pa'i mdo las/ bsam gtan dag la skyil mo krung bcas nas// drang po'i lus kyi mnyam bzhag mngon phyogs na// gnyid kyis mi non le lo'i gzhi spangs pa// des na ting nge 'dzin la bde blag gnas// zhes pa ltar grim lhod snyom par gnas pa'i ngang nas sems kyang phyir phyogs pa ma yin pas nyams su blang ba'i chos la dran pa mngon du phyogs par bya ba dag go// gnyis pa bsgom bya dngos la bzhi/

mi rtag cing 'chi ba/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams so// dang po la mi rtag cing 'chi ba bsam tshul ni/ gzhung las/ tshem̐ 'di'im̐ gnyenam̐ poram̐ mim̐ rtagam̐ ces pa'i tshe 'di'i che thabs dang 'jig rten gyi bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba kho na sngon nas da lta'i bar du myang 'das kyi sar ma slebs pa yin gyi/ da nas bzung tshe 'di'i don kho na bsgrub na sngar ltar 'khor bar 'gyur bas tshe 'di la mngon zhen dang chags pa spang ba'i phyir 'dus byas 'di rnams mi rtag pa'i chos nyid can yin la/ gang mi rtag na/ rgya cher rol ba las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang 'dra| |'gro ba'i tshe ni nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri bzar 'bab chu bas kyang myur 'gyogs 'gro// zhes pa ltar phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/ nang bcud kyi 'gro ba/ de dag gi tshe la sogs pa skad cig re re nas mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos tshul rgyas par bsam mo// yang gzhung las/ 'chim̐ bam̐ bsamam̐/ zhes pa/ bdag lta bu tshe 'dir yun du sdod pa'i blo brlag 'di lta bu zhig skye 'gro thams cad sngar ma shi ba med pas 'chi nges te/ sngar shi ba'i yul mi khyim mtshes rang gi pha ma nye du la sogs pa shi ba mang du bsam la/ de 'dra ba zhig bdag la nam 'ong snyam du bsgom ste/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ sa 'am 'on te mtho ris na// skyes nas la la ma shi ba// 'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am// thos sam 'on te the tshom za| |zhes so// 'dus byas yin pas kyang 'chi nges te/ lus sha khrag sogs 'dus pa las byas pa dag la rlung sems kyi 'du shes byas pa dag ste/ 'dul ba lung las/ skyes pa gang zhig 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba// de gang na yod 'dus pa gang zhig de// 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba de gang na yod// ces so// tshe skad cig mar mi sdod pas kyang 'chi bar nges te/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/

nyin mtshan sdod pa yong med par// tshe 'di rtag tu god gyur la// bsnon pa gud nas yong med na// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// zhes so// thabs gang gis kyang mi stong par 'chi bar nges te/ ji skad du/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na// pha yang skyabs su mi 'gyur zhing*// bu yang ma yin gnyen 'dun min// khyod la skyabs su gyur pa med// ces so// tshe la nges pa med pa'i 'chi bar nges te/ mtshan ma bzang po'i mdo las/ sang tsam 'chi ba sus shes kyi// de ring nyid du bstun te bya// 'chi bdag sde chen de dang ni| |bdag nyid bshes pa ma yin no// zhes so// 'chi ba'i rkyen mang zhing gson pa'i rkyen nyung bas kyang 'chi bar nges te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste| |gson pa'i rkyen ni cung zad cig /de dag nyid kyang 'chi ba'i rkyen// de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar tshul du ma'i sgo nas bsam la tshe 'di'i mdun ma rbad kyis bcad cing gang gis kyang dgos pa med pa zhig rgyud la skye bar bya'o// kha cig mi rtag cing 'chi bar bsam pa 'di blo dman ngan ngan po'i chos su byas nas de la mtho mtho bzang bzang*| zab zab mo'i chos yod pa skad smra na'ang*/ 'di rgyud la skyes na chos mi 'ong ka med la 'di rgyud la ma skyes na chos gzhan gang bstan kyang me long gi logs la sran ma gtor ba ltar gnas par mi 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dal 'byor thob dka' bar bsam pa ni/ gzhung las/ dam̐ lta'im̐ lusam̐ 'dim̐ bsodam̐ namam̐s mthum̐ lasam̐ rnyedam̐// phyisam̐ nasam̐ dalam̐ 'byoram̐ 'dim̐ nim̐ rnyedam̐ dkam̐' ste/ྃ /zhes gsungs pas/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di rnyed dka' zhing 'jig par sla ba zhig ste bsod nams kyi mthus da lta rnyed pa yin gyi 'di lta bu thob pa'i tshe chud ma zos pa zhig byed dgos pa'ang*/ zhi ba lhas/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bu don sgrub thob par gyur pa la/

/gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na| |phyis nas yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur// zhes so// de la yang dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu las byung ba ste/ mi khom pa brgyad las dal ba ni/ ji skad du/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stong pa// lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad// ces pa de rnams so so'i las dbang gis chos sgrub par mi khom la de las khom pa dal ba nyid dang*/ de la yang gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs// bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o| |zhes so/ rang 'byor lnga ni/ ji skad du/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*// las mtha' ma log gnas la dad// ces so// mdor dril na/ dkon brtsegs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba rab tu rnyed par dka'// pha dang ma dag chos la gnas pa dang*// dal dang 'byor dang chos 'dod grogs po dang*// mthun par gnas pa bstan la rab dad dkon// de rnyed nas ni byang chub ma thob bar// mkhas pas chos ni nam yang mi gtong ngo*// zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas bsam par bya'o| |gsum pa rgyu 'bras la yid ches bsam pa ni/ gzhung las/ rangam̐ garam̐ mim̐ 'jugam̐ lasam̐ kyim̐ dbangam̐ dum̐ 'grom̐// dkam̐r nagam̐ rgyum̐ 'brasam̐ bdem̐ sdugam̐ som̐ soram̐ sminam̐// zhes gsungs pas tshul de lta bu yang rang bzhin byung rgyal du ma yin par dkar nag gi las kyis byed pa yin te/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ dus kyis mnar te rgyal po 'gro gyur na// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// skyes bu de ni gang dang gar 'gro yang*// las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// zhes rang gi tshe 'di'i longs spyod mdza' bshes la sogs pa 'bad pas bsgrubs pa kun shi ba'i rjes su mi 'brang gi rjes su 'brang nges shes pa rang gis bsags pa'i dkar nag gi las rnams so// de dag kyang chud za ba med par bskal pa 'das kyang 'byung ste/

dkon brtsegs sdom pa gsum bstan pa las/ ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa// rnam par smin pa de 'drar 'gyur// bskal pa bye ba phrag brgya yang*| |de ni chud zar 'gyur ba med// ces so/ de yang dkar nag gi las gnyis las 'bras bu yang bde sdug gnyis su smin te/ dbul po des pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ sdig pa'i las la sdug bsngal dang*// dge ba'i las la bde ba ste// khyod kyis de ltar shes par gyis// zhes so// de lta bu'i 'bras bu la yang bzhi las/ bral ba'i 'bras bu ni gang du skyes kyang bde ba dang bral ba'o// rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni ngan song gsum du skye ba'o// rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la yang gnyis/ byed pa rgyu mthun srog bcad pa'i 'bras bu ngan song las thar yang srog gcod pa la dga' ba/ myong ba rgyu mthun tshe thung zhing nad mang ba ste/ mi dge bcu ga la'ang des 'gre'o// dbang gi 'bras bu ni/ srog bcad pas yul bkra mi shis shing mthu nyams pa'i gnas su skye ba sogs mdo sde las rnam 'byed nas gsungs pa lta bu'o// dge ba'i las ni de rnams las zlog pa'o// 'bras bu yang de las bzlog go// de gnyis ka ma yin pa mi g.yo ba'i las ni/ chos thams cad rang rig tsam du rtogs pa dang*/ rang rig kyang nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa dang*/ ci yang med par rtogs pa dang*/ yod min med min du rtogs pa ste| de'i 'bras bu skye mched mu bzhir skye ste/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ rtag dang mngon par zhen dang gnyen po med// ces so/ myong 'gyur ma nges pa ni/ dge ba'i las byas zin nas tshogs shing dus la ma bab par gnyen po'i stobs kyis zad pa lta bu'o// de ltar las dkar nag rang gzhan su'i ched du bsags kyang 'bras bu rang gis myong ba ni/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ khyod kyis bram ze dge slong lha dang ni// mgron dang yab yum dag dang btsun mo dang*// 'khor gyi slad du'ang sdig pa mi bgyi ste// dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis| |zhes gsungs pa lta bu tshul du ma'i sgo nas bsam par bya'o// bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ni// gzhung las/

dmyalam̐ bam̐ yim̐ dwagam̐s dem̐ bzhinam̐ dudam̐ 'grom̐ dngam̐*// mim̐ dngam̐ lham̐ mim̐n lham̐ rnamam̐s garam̐ skyesam̐ kyangam̐*// tsham̐ grangam̐ bkresam̐ skomam̐ blunam̐ rmongam̐s skyem̐ 'chim̐ sogam̐s// 'thabam̐ rtsodam̐ 'chim̐ 'phom̐ sdugam̐ bsngalam̐ dgam̐ gisam̐ gzim̐r// zhes pas mi dge ba'i 'bras bu rigs drug tu skyes nas so so'i sdug bsngal myong tshul yang dang po dmyal ba la tsha dmyal ni/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ sems can nyes par spyod pa spyad rnams la// yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang*// bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogs pa'i// dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur// zhes so// de'i 'khor du me ma mur kyi 'obs dang*| ro myags kyi 'dam dang*/ ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal dang*/ shal ma li'i sdong po dang*/ thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med rnams yod la/ de rnams kyang las bsags pa che chung gis dmyal khams bco brgyad tshang bar myong dgos pa dang*/ gtso bo tsam dang 'khor rnams dang 'khor re re tsam myong ba sogs lci yang ni khyad par che'o// grang dmyal la yang chu bur can dang*/ chu bur rdol pa can/ a chu zer ba/ kye hud zer ba/ so tham tham pa/ pad+ma ltar gas pa/ ut+pal ltar gas pa/ ut+pal ltar cher gas pa dang brgyad do// sdug bsngal de rnams bzod par dka' ba'i tshul yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa// des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang*// 'ol yang mi bgyi char yang mi phod do// zhes so// yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal ni/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis// bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa// bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis// bskyed pa shin tu mi zad bsten 'tshal lo// zhes pa ste/ de la phyi'i sgrib pa can dgun me dang nyi ma yang grang zhing bsil ba dang*/

dbyar zla ba dang rlung yang tsha ba dang*/ bltas pa tsam gyis ljon shing gi lo 'bras dang 'bab chu rgya mtshor bcas pa skams shing dgun dung dang tsha sgo can du 'gyur ba dang*/ 'gul ba tsam gyis tshigs dang dbang po thams cad 'khrol nas 'gro ba sogs so// nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ lus che zhing rid pa pags pa srab cing brang dang rtsibs ma cher gyes pa kha chung zhing ske phra ba/ gsus pa sbom zhing rkang lag skem pa bkres shing sdug bsngal ba can no// zas skom gyi sgrib pa can ni/ lus rid cing zas skom la yid btags pa/ zas skom gyi sgra tsam yang mi thos pa/ rgya la rnyed na thams cad lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba dang me ma mur du 'gro ba dang*/ rnag khrag dang snabs lud dang mi gtsang bar mthong bas bza' mi nus pa dag go// spyi mthun gyi sgrib pa can ni/ dur khrod kyi sha za lta bu zas rang gar med pa/ skom rang gar btung du med cing bkres skom dbul phongs grang ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba'i dus med pa dag go// dud 'gro la yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang*// bcings dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa// zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa// zhes pa'i byings la gnas pa ni/ phyi'i rgya mtshor gnas pa glum ngar ma'i sbang ma tsam yod pa rnams/ gcig gis gcig za ba dang*/ gsod pa dang*/ 'drud pa dang*/ gnod pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med do// kha 'thor ba ni/ da lta mngon sum du mthong ba 'di rnams yin te/ rang la dbang med par gzhan gyis sna phug cing khrid pa dang*/ lcags dang*/ lcags kyus btab ste mi nus bzhin du rmo ba dang*/ bkol ba dang*/ mi theg bzhin du 'gel ba dang*/ sha dang*/ pags pa dang*/ mu tig dang*/ bal dang*/ rus pa la sogs pa'i ched du gsod cing 'dzin pa dang*/ dud 'gro nang khul du gcig gis gcig gsod cing rnam par 'tshe ba rnams so// mi rnams kyi sdug bsngal yang*/

rgya cher rol ba las/ srid gsum skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang*// 'chi me rab 'bar 'di ni mgon med pa// srid las 'byung 'gyur rigs drug rtag tu rmongs// bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor bzhin no// zhes pa ltar skye rga na 'chi ste sdug bsngal gyi chu bo chen po bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang yod pa phyogs bsrung*/ med pa 'tshol btsal/ dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad pa/ gnyen byams pa dang bral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'byung ba ni rang re rnams la nyams su myong bas grub pa 'di nyid yin| lha min la yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi// dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che// zhes lha'i dpal la phrag dog cing lha'i bu mo mdzes ma la rtsod pa'i g.yul chen po bshams te 'thab cing brtsad pas pham nas bsad cing 'gyel ba dang*/ khrag tu skyugs pa dang*/ kha sbub tu 'gyel zhing yid mya ngan gyis non nas cho nge 'debs shing sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa dmyal ba yang sos dang khyad med par gsungs so// lha rnams la yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang*// stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying dang*// gos la dri ma chags dang lus las ni// sngon chad med pa'i rngul 'byung zhes bgyi ba// mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron bgyid 'chi ltas lnga// lha yul gnas pa'i lha rnams la 'byung ste// sa steng mi rnams 'chi bar gyur pa dag /sbron par byed pa'i 'chi ltas rnams dang 'dra// zhes lha rnams kyang longs spyod bde skyid la dbang 'byor yang 'chi ba'i tshe nye ba'i ltas lnga mthong bas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur la/ tshe 'phos nas sngon gyi bsags pa zad pas slar ngan song rnams su lhung bas bde ba'i skabs med do// de lta na 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las med pa'i phyir/ de rnams bsam tshul sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bsam par bya'o| |gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ni/

gzhung las/ 'grom̐ skyabam̐s bla ྃmedam̐ bstanam̐ rtsam̐ dkonam̐ mchogam̐ gsumam̐// zhes pas de ltar rigs drug gi sdug bsngal las skyob par nus pa ni gang zhe na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ dge bsnyen gsum la skyabs 'gro bas// de ni sdom brgyad rtsa ba yin// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni// thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs| |zhes so// de ltar mchog gsum kho nar skyabs su 'os pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ gzhung las/ rtagam̐ pa'im̐ zhes smos pas sangs rgyas ni don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i phyir gtan gyi skyabs gnas yin la chos dang dge 'dun ni de sgrub pa'i thabs dang lam gyi grogs yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla ma las/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste// zhes gsungs so// de la skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo ni/ gzhung las/ skyabam̐s gnasam̐ zhes yul khyad par can de la skyabs su bsten 'dod kyi blo ste/ 'dul lung phran tshegs las/ skyabs de la ni brten nas su// sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur// zhes so// skyabs 'gro'i nges tshig ni/ gzhung las/ skyobam̐ mdzadam̐ rinam̐ chenam̐ gteram̐// zhes gang las skyob na 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal de las skyob pa ste/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo las/ 'jigs gyur 'jigs pa sel mdzad phyir// skyabs med skyob pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// zhes sogs so// skyabs 'gro'i dbye ba la'ang*/ gzhung las/ thegam̐ pam̐ gsumam̐ bstanam̐ zhes pas nyan thos rang sangs rgyas byang sems gsum gyi theg pa chung 'bring che gsum gyi dbye bas skyabs 'gro byed tshul sogs mang du yod kyang 'dir ma spros la/ skyabs 'gro dngos ni/ gzhung las/ bsgrubam̐ byam̐ sdomam̐ pa'im̐ mchom̐g /ces pas bla ma dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod gtor bshams la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa tshul ldan du blang dgos so// sngar skyabs sdom thob zin na skabs 'dir lus gnad sogs snga ma ltar gyi ngang nas rang nyid tha mal pa'i mdun du/

gyad dang seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i rgyan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i steng du ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po bai ḍūr+ya lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mdun du yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ g.yas su bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ rgyab tu yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la dam pa'i chos ji snyed pa glegs bam gyi rnam pas bskor ba/ g.yon du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams tshom bur bzhugs pa/ khri'i thad du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams sprin dkrigs pa ltar phung nger bzhugs par bsam la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa ltos med du phul nas/ bdag sogs khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug ma tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i don dran bzhin pas bdag gis skyabs 'gro bgyis pa'i tshe nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang skyabs 'gro 'ur di ri ri byed par bsam la thun rer brgya rtsa re yan chad nges par bya dgos so// mthar skyabs yul rang gi spyi bor bstim pa'am yang na dus kun tu mdun gyi nam mkhar 'bral med du bsgom par bya'o// de dag gi bslab bya ni/

gzhung las/ bslabam̐ bya'im̐ snyingam̐ pom̐ zhes pas skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya'i rtsa ba'am snying po yin pas spang bar bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas dbang phyug la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu bo che rnams la phyag mi bya zhing*/ skyabs su mi 'gro na gzhan yul lha gzhi bdag sogs la smos ci dgos te/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas dag la skyabs gsol nas// de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te// nam du'ang lha rnams gzhan dag la// skyabs su gsol bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba spang dgos te/ chos ni zhi zhing 'tshe ba dang bral ba'i mtshan nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ srog chags gsod pa dang*/ go rar gzud pa dang*/ mi nus bzhin rmo ba dang*/ mi theg bzhin 'gel ba dang*/ sha gcod pa dang*/ sna 'bug pa dang*/ bred sngangs cher 'ded pa dang*/ rdung ba dang*/ rdeg pa sogs mdor na srog chags la 'tshe ba mtha' dag spang dgos te/ myang 'das las/ dam pa'i chos la skyabs song nas sems can la 'tshe zhing gsod pa'i sems dang bral dgos so// zhes so// dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs te/ myang 'das las/ dge 'dun dag la skyabs song nas| |mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs so// zhes gsungs la/ mu stegs can gyi rigs min na'ang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos la log par lta zhing chos min la spyod na/ cha lugs ji ltar bzang yang mu stegs dang 'dra bas spang dgos so// sgrub cing blang bar bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku bris 'bur sogs gang la yang mos gus rgya chen po bya/ de la rin thang gcod pa dang*| bshig pa dang*/ gta' mar gzud pa dang*/ rab gnas byas ma byas gang yin yang rung sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rnam pa tsam du grub na legs nyes tsam la yang ma ltos par dad pa'i stobs bskyed la ma gus pa spang*/

dam pa'i chos rnam dag la skur 'debs spangs la chos min gyi rjes su mi 'jug /chos yang dag smra ba'i bshes gnyen la mi gus shing nyes pa brjod pa dang brnyas pa'i spyod pa spangs la gus pa lhur bya/ dge 'dun la ngan smras skur 'debs co 'dri brnyas pa/ 'thab rtsod sogs spang zhing dad gus phyag dang gus phyag dang zhe sa bsnyen bkur ba mchod cing rim 'gro bkur sti phu dud sogs la bslab par bya zhing*/ tha na dge 'dun gyi gzugs brnyan tsam la yang brnyas par mi bya/ dge 'dun ni dran pa tsam la yang phan yon ni dpag tu med la/ mthong nas dad pas mtshams sbyar nas tshe 'phos pa dag la'ang phan yon gzhal du med pa'i phyir ro// thun mong du dus bzang po rnams la dkon mchog gsum mchod cing bkur ba dang*/ nyin zhag phrugs re la'ang mchod pa tshang ma tshar re brjes nas dbul/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal byung yang dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs shing theg chen sems bskyed kyi lam gtong bya ba ma gtogs thabs gzhan sman dpyad mo rtsis bon chog sogs mi bya/ de lta bu byung tshe dkon mchog mchod dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bya/ gsung rab bklag /sāts+tsha gdab/ chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba sogs bgyi/ srog dang bya dga' la sogs dgos pa gal po che gang gi ched du'ang dkon mchog gsum blos mi spang*/ phyogs gar 'gro yang dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs pa'i skyabs gzhan mi btsal/ rab dus kun/ 'bring nyin mtshan dus bcu gnyis/ tha na yang nyin mtshan dus drug tu dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing dran pas mi brjed par bya/ gtso bor sems can rnams 'khor bar 'khyams pa las skyob 'dod bu gcig pu dgra'i lag tu shor ba'i pha ma ltar bya'o// de lta bu'i phan yon ni/ gzhung las/ phanam̐ yonam̐ zhes smos pas sdom pa gsum gyi rtsa ba dang 'khor ba'i nyes pa sreg byed yin pa sogs phan yon brjod pas mi lang ba ste/

'dul ba lung rnam 'byed las/ rtswa skam phung po ri ltar spungs pa yang*// me stag yung 'bru tsam gyis sreg pa ltar// dkon mchog gsum la mchod byas bsod nams kyis// sdig pa'i phung po ma lus sreg par byed// ces sogs dpag tu med pa gsungs so// de lta bu'i skyabs su song ba'i sdom pa khyad par can de yang*/ gzhung las/ gtongam̐ thobam̐ bstanam̐/ zhes pas thob pa'i dus ni rang rgyud la 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa rgyud la skyes shing rgyu 'bras la yid ches/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong*/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad sdug bsngal de las thar 'dod kyi bsam pas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i blos mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar skyabs su song ba'i tshe thob cing*/ rgyu 'bras dang dkon mchog gsum la log par lta zhing yid mi ches pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya las 'gal ba dang*/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig la drug tu byas pa'i cha gcig la mchog gsum la skyabs su ma gsol zhing ma dran na sdom pa gtong ba yin no// gsum pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro ni/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas nyon mongs pa spong ba'i tshul khrims la bslab dgos pa'i phyir/ de yang*/ gzhung las/ spongam̐ semam̐s gnyenam̐ posam̐ zhes smos pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba mtha' dag spong ba'am nyon mongs pa de dag gi gnyen po dang*/ sems dge ba'i sa bon dam pa ste/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las// tshul khrims pha rol phyin ces bshad// ces gsungs la/ de yang gzhung las/ sdomam̐ pam̐ risam̐ bdunam̐ gangam̐*| |zhes pas gong gi dgos pa khyad par can de dag dang*/ khyad par sdom pa gsum rim can gyi slad du so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ris bdun gang rung zhig nges par thob dgos pa yang*/ rten gyis dbye na dge slong pha ma gnyis/ dge tshul pha ma gnyis/ dge gnyen pha ma gnyis/ bar slob ma dang bdun no// cho gas dbye na/

dge slong dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ bar slob ma| dge bsnyen gyi cho ga rnams so// bslab bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum/ dge tshul gyi bsrung bya bcu gsum/ dge bsnyen gyi rtsa ba bzhi 'am lnga sogs so// gzhan yang khyim pa yin na bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa dag go// de ltar na sngar sdom pa thob zin nas rab nyes med phun tshogs/ tha na yang bshags sdom gyis rnam par dag pa zhig dgos la/ de min na skabs 'dir so thar ris bdun gang rung sdom pa nyes med phun tshogs rgyu rkyen 'dzoms par byas la blang zhing*/ tha na yang bsnyen nas tsam zhig nges par blang dgos so// de ltar blang dgos na blang ba'i yul ni/ gzhung las/ rnamam̐ dgam̐ zhingam̐ lam̐ zhes pa cho ga so so nas bshad pa'i mkhan slob tshul ldan mang thos shig go// blang tshul yang*/ gzhung las/ ngesam̐ 'byungam̐ bsam̐m pam̐ yim̐s// zhes pas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i blos blang ngo*// de ltar blangs pa'i bslab bya yang gzhung las/ bslabam̐ lasam̐ mim̐ 'da'am̐ zhes pas gshis kyi rang bzhin gyi mi dge ba de bcom ldan 'das kyis dgag bcas kyi bslab pa dang*/ gshis rang bzhin gyi dge ba de bcom ldan 'das kyis sgrub bcas kyi bslab par mdzad pa ste/ so sor thar pa las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// zhes so| |de lta bu bsrung tshul yang*/ srog dang mig 'bras ltar phra zhing phra ba nas bsrung dgos pa yang*/ so thar las g.yag rnga'i rtse mo'i dpes mtshon nas gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar bsrungs pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhung las/ yonam̐ tanam̐ kunam̐ gyim̐ rtenam̐// zhes pas tshul khrims 'di ni yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas chos thams cad kyi gzhi ma/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi rtsa ba kho na ste/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/

'di lta ste sa chen po 'di la brten nas rtsi shing dang lo tog dang shing gel pa dang nags tshal la sogs pa thams cad skye'o| |de bzhin du tshul khrims gyi rtsa ba 'di la brten nas dge ba'i chos thams cad 'phel zhing skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes so// de lta bu'i tshul khrims de nyid rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir gal te skyon gyis gos na'ang*/ gzhung las/ nyamam̐s nam̐ phyiram̐ bcosam̐ zhes pas gzhan dag so thar gyi sdom pa rdza be'u chag pa lta bu dang*/ rtsa ba gcig nyams na sdom pa kun ma phul ba slar mi chags pa dang*/ sdom pa blangs nas nyams pa bas ma blang ba phan yon che ba sogs bshad tshul mang na yang 'dir pham pa bzhi bu lon nor can ltar gsungs pa dang*/ nyams kyang stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pas nges par byang bar bshad pa dang*/ gser 'od dam pa las/ gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su// shin tu mi bzad sdig bgyis pa// lan gcig rab tu bshags pa yis// de dag thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur// zhes so// de lta bu gtong thob kyi dus kyang*/ gzhung las/ gtongam̐ thobam̐ dusam̐ shesam̐ bya/ྃ /zhes pas gzhan dag so thar gyi sdom pa ni/ mngon pa mdzod las/ bslab pa phul dang sogs kyi lung gis gtong zhes theg pa chung ngu'i tshul ltar bshad kyang*/ 'dir mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos 'dul ba lhag par theg chen du bzhed pas shi 'phos kyang gtong bar mi 'dod de/ rnam par shes pa 'pho ba'i mdo las/ bzang skyong rnam par shes pa'i khams 'di ni lus yongs su btang nas dge dang mi dge ba'i rjes su 'jug ste/ de'ang ji ltar zhe na/ rnam par shes pa'i khams gzugs can ma yin pa 'dis/ lus 'di bor nas sngar gyi bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa dag yongs su 'dzin to// zhes gsungs pas/ dge slong gi sdom pa'i spong sems kyi gnyen po des bar dor yang sred len spangs nas kyang tshur shog dang gsol bzhis bsnyen par rdzogs par 'gyur la/

tshe yang ji srid 'tsho bar mi 'dod de/ bsam pa ji srid 'tsho dang*/ dus sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du bsrung bar bya'o// thob pa'i dus ni rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthong nas bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams thar 'dod kyi blos gsol bzhi'i las brjod pa gsum gyi tha ma'i cha gsum pa la thob par gsungs so| |gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang sems sdom pa ni/ gzhung las/ mthom̐ risam̐ nyanam̐ rangam̐ 'dodam̐ minam̐ zhes pas rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo ni go chod pa ma yin zhing*/ der yang ma zad nyan thos dang rang rgyal yang gtan gyi gegs te/ theg bsdus las/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas la// gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te// nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas| |sa ni gtan gyi gegs byed do// zhes gsungs/ des na so thar gyi sdom pa blang bar mi rigs dang po nas theg chen la 'jug go zhe na/ so thar ris bdun gang rung gi sdom pas rgyud dul ba zhig nges par dgos pa/ jo bo rjes/ so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min| |zhes so// des na mi dge ba spong sems dang ldan pa des tshad med pa'i snying rje las byung ba'i byang sems zhig nges par dgos pa ni/ gzhung las/ rdzogam̐s sangam̐s rgyasam̐// medam̐ nam̐ mim̐ 'byungam̐ sam̐ bonam̐ byangam̐ chubam̐ semam̐s// zhes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs la med na mi 'byung ba'i sa bon lta bu ni byang chub kyi sems kho na yin no// de gang las skye zhe na/ gzhung las/ bdagam̐ gisam̐ semam̐s canam̐ bdagam̐ tu ྃ'dzim̐n pam̐ lam̐s// byasam̐ shesam̐ drinam̐ mthongam̐ zhes bshad pas byang chub kyi sems de tshad med pa'i snying rje las skye/ snying rje de yang byams pa las skye bar gsungs/ byams pa de yang bdag gis sems can thams cad bdag tu bzung ba las skye bar gsungs te/

dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las/ sems can la sred pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i rigs so// zhes dang*/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa las/ bdag tu 'dzin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung ngo*// zhes gsungs te/ de yang nga yir 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin ni thar pa'i gegs yin la/ sems can bdag tu 'dzin pa ni byang chub sems kyi rgyu yin no// dang po byams pa skye ba'i rgyu ni/ gzhung las/ byamam̐s dngam̐ zhes pas sems can thams cad bdag gir bzung byas shes drin bzo las 'byung ngo*// ngo bo ni sems can rnams dper na mas bu gcig pu mthong ba'i tshe byams shing bde bar 'dod pa lta bu'o| |dbye ba ni/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni/ sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'o// chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni/ spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'o// dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa ni/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'o| |zhes gsungs pas/ skabs 'dir sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa dag go// byams pa bsgom pa'i thabs dngos ni/ dang po rang gi ma la byams pa bsgom pa ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i ma de shi gson gang yin yang de'i bzhin dang*/ lus gos rgyan sogs de kho na ltar yid yul du bsam/ ma de rang la gdung ba'i spyod lam ci lta bu zhig byed kyi yod pa ltar yid la gsal btab/ 'di bdag gi drin can gyi ma yin ang snyam du bsam/ de'i drin bsam tshul ni/ lus byin pa'i drin/ srog byin pa'i drin/ blang dor bstan pa'i drin/ dka' ba spyad pa'i drin no// de la lus byin pa'i drin ni/ bdag gi rnam shes bya spu rlung khyer de khu khrag la brten nas zla ba dgu ngo bcu'i bar du mngal du bzung*/ de la phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam bsten/ gnod pa'i zas spyod spangs/ dal 'byor gyi lus dbang po kun tshang*/

skyon med pa 'di byin pa yin pas 'di bdag la drin che'o snyam du bsam/ srog byin pa'i drin ni/ bdag phyir btsas ma thag lus kyis kha lag mi 'phrod/ ngag gis brda don mi 'phrod/ sems kyis blang dor mi shes pas 'bu red lta bu de 'chir ma bcug par brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ sor mo lnga'i rtse la blangs/ zas khas snyod/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ lus kyi drod kyis bsros/ mngar ba'i nu zho byin/ me chu g.yang sogs kyi 'tshe ba las bsrungs/ tsha grang gi reg pa las bskyabs/ skad cig kyang 'bral mi phod par snying lta bur gces par bskyangs pa'i drin can gyi ma yin no snyam du bsam/ blang dor bstan pa'i drin ni/ za lugs 'thung lugs mi shes pa la za lugs 'thung lugs bslabs/ 'gro sdod mi shes pa la 'gro lugs sdod lugs bslabs/ smra brjod mi shes pa la smra ba dang brjod pa bslabs/ dngos po'i brda don phra rags thams cad ngo sprad de blang dor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i drin can ma yin snyam du bsam/ dka' ba spyad pa'i drin ni/ ma rang nyid yal bar dor nas/ bdag na dogs/ shi dogs/ gzhan dang ma mnyam gyi dogs/ mo byed/ rtsis byed/ sman pa 'bod/ rim gro la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang ba byas/ bdag gi ched du nyin dal rgyu med/ mtshan gnyid rgyu med par rkang lag thams cad ser khar song yang las byas/ ma rang gis za ma nus/ gzhan la ster ma nus/ tshe 'di'i ched du spyod du ma nus/ phyi ma'i ched du gtong ma nus/ zas nor thams cad bdag gi ched du bsags shing gtong ba'i tshe 'phang med du btang*/ de ltar byas pas ma rang gi bsam don 'grub pa'i khul byas/ bsam rgyu bsgom rgyu bdag las med pas drin che/ khyad par dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra tsam yang 'jig rten du 'byung ba dkon na/ bdag rang gis byung na tshe 'dir lus bde/ bar dor sems bde/

phyi mar lam bde/ rnam pa thams cad du bde ba nas bde bar 'gro chog pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos sgrub tu yod pa 'di kho na ma'i drin yin snyam du bsam mo// de ltar yang yang bsgoms pas dang po bcos ma lta bu'i byams pa ldang ba 'byung*/ mthar bcos min gyi byams pa tshad med pa skye/ de nas de bzhin rang gi pha la sogs pa nye du rnams kyis bdag gi ma byas pa la bsam nas bsgom/ de'i rjes su yul mi dang khyim mtshes rnams kyis kyang rang gi ma byas pa la bsam nas bsgom/ de'i rjes su lho dzam+bu'i gling gi 'gro ba rnams la bsgom/ de nas gling bzhi/ de nas mthar nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam kyi sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med nas da lta'i bar du bdag gi ma byas pa la bsam nas bsgom par bya'o// khyad par du rang gi dgra 'dre rnams la 'dis bdag gi tshe rabs mang por ma byas pa kho na yin/ 'di bdag gi mar gyur pa'i dus drin lan du drin ma khur/ phan lan du phan ma btags pas bu lon 'ded pa kha smras su go ba ltar tshe rabs snga ma'i lan chags 'ded pa la 'ong ba dgra dang 'drer mthong ba yin/ rang cag gnyis ka las nyon gyis bsgribs/ skye 'chi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pas phan tshun gnod res su gyur/ sems 'khrul ba'i dbang gis rang dbang ma thob par gnod lan du gnod pa skyel res byed pa yin/ lar gnod lan du gnod pa kho na byas pas da bar bdag 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin ang snyam pa rang rgyud la 'dre nges shes par bsam mo// yang byams pa la nye ring byung na nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can bdag gi ma yin pa la nye ring byas/ dgra 'dre yang bdag gi ma yin par gnod pa byas pas nye ring phyogs lhung can gyi byams pa sgom mkhan/ rang gis sdug bsngal chung ngu yang mi bzod par gzhan la gnod pa byed/ las 'bras rang la yong bas/ rang gis rang la gnod pa byas nas gzhan la thengs par rlom pa'i 'khrul ba mgo 'khor ba'i nye ring can khyod las blun pa'i theg chen gyi lam sgom mkhan su zhig yod snyam du rang gis rang la khrel btab nas slar byams pa sngar ltar bsgom mo// de ltar byams pa bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/

rgya cher rol ba las/ byams sems ldan la dug dang mtshon mi tshugs// ro langs dang ni 'jigs pa gzhan mi 'byung*// byams sems ldan la gzhan gyis gnod mi 'gyur| |dpung bcas bdud rnams rgyal mtshan sder bcas pa// nag po'i rtsa lag byams pa'i stobs kyis 'joms// zhes so// de ltar sems can thams cad bde bar 'dod pa'i byams pa yod kyang de rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yun du myong ba la bsams nas snying rje bskyed dgos pa yang*/ gzhung las/ snyingam̐ rjem̐ skyem̐// zhes pas snying rje skye ba'i rgyu ni byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal la bsam pas so// ngo bo ni de ltar sdug bsngal mthong ba'i tshe/ 'di rnams 'di lta bur ngal ba snying re rje snyam du sems gdung zhing ba spu g.yo mchi ma 'khrugs pa'o// dbye ba ni/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje ni/ mar gyur 'gro ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal la bsam zhing de dang 'bral 'dod kyi bsam pa dag go// chos la dmigs pa ni/ 'gro ba rnams las 'bras la rmongs shing sdug bsngal ba la bltas te/ de dag gi don bya bar bsam mo// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje ni/ yul yul can gnyis su med par rtogs pa dag go// snying rje sgom pa'i thabs dngos ni sngar ltar/ rtsa ba'i ma gsal bar bsam pa de nyid mes tshig pa'am/ chus khyer ba'am/ yan lag 'breg pa la sogs pa mthong ba dang thos na snying rje ste/ mgon skyabs ni rang la bab/ mgon skyabs ma byas na ni ma yi chad/ gzhan gyis 'phya/ rang gi snying mi dga' bzhin du byed pa'i thabs med pa rgyu mtshan du byas la bsgom/ yang ma de bkres pas ni nyen/ skom pas ni gdung*/ kha skam/ bzhin nyams/ lus la mthu stobs med par mthong ba la bsam nas bsgom| yang ma de gzhan gyis rdeg cing 'tshog pa dang*/ bkol ba dang*/ gsod pa dang*/ 'ching zhing 'tshod pa sogs la bsam te bsgom/ yang ma de rgas shing 'khog

/nad drag pos gdungs| mig long*/ rna ba 'on/ dbang po nyams nas rgud pa la sogs la bsam nas bsgom/ yang ma de bsod nams bsags pa'i dge ba ni zad/ las ngan gyi sdug bsngal ni smin/ chos kyi mig dang ni bral/ lam gyi 'khar ba ni med/ dam pa'i mgon gyi dmigs bus ni ma zin/ ngan song gi g.yang sar lhung du nye ba sogs la bsam la bsgom/ de dag la snying rje'i sems bcos ma min pa bzod glags med par mi bzod pa tsam du byung na sngar byams pa'i skabs ltar spel la bsgom mo// de'i phan yon ni/ yum sdud pa las/ mi yi 'jig rten 'byung po'i gdon dang nad mang ba// phan dang snying brtser ldan pas bden pa'i byin gyis zhi// zhes so// de lta bu'i byams pa dang*/ snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa zhig rgyud la skyes na de las byang chub kyi sems skye bar nges te/ gzhung las/ dem̐ lasam̐ drim̐ medam̐ rin ྃchenam̐ byang ྃchubam̐ semam̐s// gnasam̐ dngam̐ zhes pas so so'i skye bo'i dus nas byang chub sems dpa'i rigs dang ldan na 'di gnas pa'i rgyu yin te/ chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ mi rtsub bslu ba ma yin la// g.yo dang sgyu ni rnam spangs shing*// sems can kun la rab dang ba// de ni byang chub sems dpa'i rigs/ zhes pa ste tshul de lta bu ni gdod ma nas byang chub sems dpa'i rigs so// de ltar rigs dang ldan pa tsam gyis mi chog ste/ gzhung las/ bskyedam̐ pa'im̐ rgyu ྃlasam̐ 'byungam̐ bam̐ stem̐// zhes pas byang sems skye ba'i rgyu bzhi las/ dang po ni/ tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams la bsnyen bkur byas// de las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun| |dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa// 'di nyan pa yi snod yin no// zhes gsungs pas thog mar rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs shin tu rgya che ba la 'bad cing*/ 'dir mtshon byed du tshogs rdzogs pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni/

gong gi skyabs yul ltar gsal btab la/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dag cing gas chag med pa dri bzang gi khu bas chag chag btab pa'i steng du rin po che sman 'bru la sogs pa'i tshom bu so bdun ma'am/ bdun nam lnga bkod la/ tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis phul rjes/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i slad du bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa zhe thag pa nas dbul zhing gsol ba gdab/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim mo// rgyu gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can te/ rgyud bla mar/ spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir// med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir// chos rnams gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no// dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi// skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir// zhes gsungs pas skyabs yul sngar ltar gsal btab la/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas dkon mchog gsum thob par 'dod pa'i blos/ dus snying po byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs 'gro lan brgya yan chad bya'o// rgyu gsum pa tshad med pa bzhi la blo sbyang ba ni/ sems can thams cad rtsa ba'i ma yin la/ de thams cad bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa'i byams pa/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i dga' ba/ nye ring phyogs ris med par sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i btang snyoms rnams sgom pa ni rang rgyud la 'dre nges shes par kha tshig tsam ma yin par/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig

/ces don dran pas lan brgya phrag yan chad brjod do// rgyu bzhi pa ni/ rgyu yi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed dgos te/ de yang byang chub kyi sems de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes byas na snang ba thams cad rang gi sems yin pas bla ma des thugs bskyed ji ltar mdzad pa nyid rang rgyud la skye bar 'gyur te/ dkon mchog sprin las/ bdag cag gi ston par 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// bla mar 'du shes bskyed par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas so// de lta bu'i sems de ji ltar bskyed ce na/ gzhung las/ snyingam̐ rjesam̐ kunam̐ bslangam̐s gzhanam̐ donam̐ rdzogam̐s sangam̐s rgyasam̐// thobam̐ 'dodam̐ bsam̐m 'phem̐l zhes pas thog mar smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dgos te/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ sems can de ni sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog cig /ces bya bar smon pa'o// de ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nye ba yin/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi de bzhin nyid mnyam pa yin/ zhes gsungs so// bsgom tshul ni/ kye ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi pha mar gyur pa'i drin can po 'di rnams bde ba 'ba' zhig 'dod kyang*/ la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod| bde ba'i rgyu dge ba'i las la ni gyi na tsam yang mi spyod pa ni snying re rje/ 'on te snying rje ba tsam du bzhag pas mi 'thus/ ma chus khyer ba'i ra mda' bus byed pa yin la/ ma rgan sems can rnams 'khor ba'i gnas nas bsgral te rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa zhig bya dgos la de lta bu mthu ni bdag la med/ bdag ma zad lha mthu bo che rnams la'ang med/

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas des na thog mar bdag nyid 'gro ba skyob pa'i mthu dang ldan pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig ci nas kyang byed dgos/ de yang ma rnams sdug bsngal mi bzod pa 'di lta bu yun ring du nyams su myong na mi 'ong bas myur du thob pa zhig bya'o// de thob nas ma rnams theg pa gsum gyi sgo nas myur du byang chub kyi sa la bzhag par bgyi'o snyam du bsam zhing 'dun pa drag pos mgo la me shor ba lta bu'am/ pang du dug sbrul rgyug pa ltar skad cig skad cig la ltos nas bya'o// de bdag gi thun rnams su yang yon tan rin po che mang po'i 'byung gnas dam par gyur pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de thob na ci ma rung snyam pa nyin mtshan kun tu bsam/ nyin thun drug gam dus bzhi'am gsum du bcad pa'i dgong thun la yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar gyi mjug tu/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// zhes pa nas/ rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes pa'i bar gyi smon 'jug gi sdom pa len chog mdor bsdus re tshogs zhing gi spyan sngar bya ba shin tu gal che'o// de ltar yid smon tsam gyis mi 'grub pas na don sgrub pa'i las la 'jug dgos pa yang*| gzhung las/ 'jugam̐ semam̐s dgem̐ ba'im̐ rgyunam̐// zhes gsungs pa ni/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ 'jug pa bskyed pa de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang mnyam pa yin| chos kyi yul thams cad dang mnyam pa yin/ zhes gsungs so// de dag gi dbye ba ni/ gzhung las/ sam̐ sogam̐s yonam̐ tanam̐ zhes smos pas/ yon tan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ dpe nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi don dang ldan pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho// rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*// yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu// rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che// bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni// sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis// rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang gzhung las/

lamam̐ dngam̐ zhes pas lam gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed 'di ni sa rnams dang*// mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*// rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod| |de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o// zhes so// gzhan yang gzhung las/ smonam̐ 'jugam̐ sdomam̐// zhes pas/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdus na// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// zhes so// de lta bu'i sems bskyed smon 'jug gi sdom pa blang tshul ni/ gzhung las/ sangasam̐ rgyasam̐ nasam̐ brgyudam̐ blam̐ mam̐ mkhasam̐ lam̐ blangam̐*// zhes pas/ de lta bu'i sdom rgyun yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du rgyun ma chad cing tshul ldan byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la mkhas pa zhig las blang dgos te/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan las blang bar bya// zhes so// sdom pa blang ba dngos ni/ dus bzang po dkon mchog gsum gyi rten khyad par can gyi drung du mchod pa rgya chen po bshams te/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed la skabs 'dir mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i phyag bzhes thun mong ma yin pa thugs bskyed chen mo ltar sdom pa rgyas par 'bogs dgos so// de lta bu'i phan yon ni/ gzhung las/ dem̐ yim̐ phanam̐ yonam̐ namam̐ mkham̐'i mtham̐' mnyamam̐ zhingam̐*/ zhes pas phan yon bgrang las 'das shing bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems bskyed tsam gyis ni// bsod nams phung po gang thob pa// gal te 'di la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste// de ni de las lhag par 'gyur// zhes so// de yang bsdu na| gzhung las/ tshogam̐s rdzogam̐s zhes bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dam pa rdzogs par 'gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo las/

'od srung de bas kyang gang zag gcig byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la bkod na/ bsod nams khyad par du che zhing dpag tu med do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dkon mchog gsum kyi gdung rgyud mi 'chad pa'i phyir ro// zhes so| |gzhan yang gzhung las/ thegam̐ chem̐n rnalam̐ 'byoram̐ zhes pas/ byang chub mchog tu sems dang po bskyed pa tsam gyis nyan rang rnams las khyad par gsum du 'phags shing lus ngag yid gsum theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor du grub pa yin te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'od srung*/ dper na bya ka la piṅka'i phrug gu sgo nga'i nang na 'dug cing mig ma bye na'ang zab cing 'jam pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis bya gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa de bzhin du/ thog mar sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rig pa'i sbub na 'dug cing las dang nyon mongs pa'i rab rib kyis bsgribs shing bar du chod kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba las sbyor ba'i skad 'byung ste/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams zil gyis gnon par byed do| |zhes so// des spang bya spong tshul ni/ gzhung las/ sgribam̐ gsum̐m 'jomam̐s// zhes pas/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa tsam gyis las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad zad cing srab par 'gyur te/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa phyag rgya la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ bskal pa grangs med par sems can dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gror skye bar 'gyur ba'i las rab tu mang po yang rnam par smin par mi 'gyur ro// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyi rgya mtsho chen po bsags pas rab tu che ba'i phyir ro// zhes so/ /bsgrub bya ni/ gzhung las/ rgya ྃchenam̐ zhes pas byang chub tu sems bskyed nas dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad cig bsags na'ang byang chub kyi sems kyis zin cing yongs su bsngo bas rgyas thebs pas mi zad pa'i gter du 'gyur zhing rgya chen po 'phel bar 'gyur te/

spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba yin// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes so// de yang gzhung las/ sangam̐s rgyasam̐ srasam̐ nyidam̐ ces pas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed ma thag nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi sras su 'gyur zhing*/ lha mi thams cad kyis phyag bya ba'i 'os kyang yin te/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyams thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes so// de nyid 'chi ba'i tshe yang*/ gzhung las/ byangam̐ semasam̐ kyim̐s// mtshamam̐s sbyoram̐ bdem̐ b.ram̐ 'phom̐ zhingam̐ zhes pas tshe 'dir byang chu+ub tu sems bskyed cing 'dris par byas pa dang*/ 'chi khar yang byang chub kyi sems kyis mtshams sbyar nas 'phos pas rab rdzogs pa'i byang chub/ 'bring sa lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ tha na'ang dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral zhing gnas khyad par can du skye bar 'gyur ro// mthar thug ni/ gzhung las/ rgyalam̐ b.ram̐ 'gyuram̐// zhes pas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed na/ myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur te/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus dang ldan pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de dag ni myur du thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'ang ngas mthong ngo*// zhes so// de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed nas bslab bya gang la'ang slob tshul gyi dngos po smon pa'i bslab bya ni/ gzhung las/ dem̐ phyiram̐ tshogam̐s bsagam̐ ces pas yar dkon mchog gsum la lus dang longs spyod dge rtsar bcas pa ltos med du dbul/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas tshun la zas kham gcig yan chad sbyin pa sogs dge rtsa 'grub tshad du bya/

de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rgyu bsod nams dang 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa la 'bad do// de yang dus thams cad du dran dgos te/ gzhung las/ rjesam̐ dranam̐ zhes pas byang chub sems kyi phan yon rnams mthong bar byas nas dus kun tu dran par byas pa'i ngang nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la bslab bo// de lta bur ji ltar slob ce na/ gzhung las/ spelam̐ zhim̐ng sbyangam̐*// zhes pas spel ba ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro bas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed nyin mtshan dus drug la sogs par chag med du bgyis pas byang chub kyi sems rgya chen por 'phel zhing yon tan rgyas par 'gyur ro// sbyang ba ni/ phar phyin drug gi tshul gyis sam yang na 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag sogs dus kun tu smon 'jug gi sems dang ma bral bar bya zhing*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang zhing theg pa chen po'i bsngo bas rgyas gdab par bya'o// de yang gzhung las/ semam̐s canam̐ mim̐ spangam̐ zhes pas/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa nas brtsams te dus thams cad du sems can blos mi spang ste/ de yang spong ba'i rgyu ni/ stong nyid la lta nyes pa dang*/ dus mtha' ring ba dang*/ sems can grangs mang la byed pa ngan zhing gdug rtsub che ba dang*/ bag med du gyur pa dang*/ sred pa'i chus khyer ba sogs mdor na ma rungs pa dag la legs pa'i lam bstan kyang mi legs par mthong nas smras pa la/ ma nyan tshe khyod la bdag re ltos ni med pas gang dga' ba gyis zhes pa lta bus sha tsha btang na sems bskyed nyams pa yin pas de lta bur sems can mi spong ba la bslab pa yang*/ gzhung las/ chosam̐ bzhim̐ spangam̐ dngam̐ blangam̐*// zhes pas nag po'i chos bzhi ni/ pha rol bslu ba'i sems min yang bzhad gad tsam gyi ched du yang rdzun tshig smra ba dang g.yo rgyus sems can rnams la lhag bsam gyis gnas par rlom pa dang*/

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ston par 'du shes mi bskyed cing bsngags pa mi brjod pa dang*/ nyi tshe ba'i theg pa 'dod nas sems can rnams la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dzin du mi 'jug pa dang bzhi spang zhing de las zlog pa bzhi nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya ni/ gzhung las/ sdomam̐ pa'im̐ tshulam̐ khrimam̐s semasam̐ can ྃdon ྃbyedam̐ dngam̐*| |dgem̐ bam̐ chom̐s sdudam̐ tshulam̐ khrimam̐s yangam̐ dgam̐ gzungam̐*// zhes pa yang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ tshul khrims gsum po de yang byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba gsum byed de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis sems gnas par 'gyur ro// sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims kyis ni sems can yongs su smin par 'gyur ro// dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims kyis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes so// de lta bu tshul khrims ni mi dge ba spong ba'i sems de bdag gcig pu zhi bde thob pa'i slad du bsrung ba ni nyan thos kyi tshul khrims yin la/ sems can thams cad rdzogs byang 'thob pa'i ched du bdag gis sdom pa gzung bar sems pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims yin pas dus rtag tu sems bskyed de lta bus zin par bya'o// de la byang sems kyi sdom pa'i rtsa ba ni/ gzhung las/ nyonam̐ mongam̐s dragam̐ po'im̐ dbangam̐ gyur ྃrtsa ྃbam̐ stem̐// zhes nyon mongs pa dug gsum drag pos kun nas bslangs pas ltung ba dam pa'i chos spong ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gtong bar byed pa dang*/ ser sna byed pa dang*/ sems can la gnod 'tshe byed pa ste rtsa ltung bzhi dang*/ yang rnyed bkur dang khe grags thob 'dod kyis rang nyid la bstod cing dregs pa ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang po'o// rnyed bkur gzhan la shor gyis dogs pas phrag dog gis gzhan la smod cing skur ba 'debs pa ni gnyis pa'o// sems can sdug bsngal zhing skyabs med pa re sa gzhan med pa chos zhur 'ong na chos ston pa'i nus pa yod bzhin du mi ston pa ni gsum pa'o// sems can dbul zhing phongs pa re sa med cing sdug bsngal ba dag slong du byung na phan gdags pa'i mthu yod bzhin du mi ster ba ni bzhi pa'o// gzhan dag dam tshig nyams pa sogs nyes pa bshags pa dang bzod gsol du byung yang 'khon bzung nas bshags pa mi len pa ni lnga pa'o// zhe sdang drag pos rgyud dkrugs te khros pa'i sems kyis gzhan la rdeg pa ni drug pa'o// theg pa chen po'i chos zab cing rgya che ba ston pa'i brjod bya phyogs snga mar bzhag nas theg pa chung ngu la slob na bdun pa'o// theg chen gyi chos don du gnyer ba la/

chos min phyi rol pa'i rigs sngags sogs dang gzhan yang ngan sngags sman dpyad sgyu rtsal la sogs pa dang*/ tshe 'di 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba'i bsam pas chos rnam dag bstan kyang 'drar snang du 'gyur bas brgyad pa'o| |de rnams la nyon mongs drag pos kun nas bslangs shing sems can blos spong ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas na ltung ba ches shin tu lci ba'o// de rnams kyi yan lag ni/ gzhung las/ zagam̐ pam̐ 'bringam̐ gisam̐ yanam̐ lagam̐ nyesam̐ byasam̐ 'gyuram̐// zhes pas dkon mchog gsum la nyin zhag phrugs gcig tu lus ngag yid gsum skyabs su mi 'gro zhing mi mchod pa dang*/ phyi longs spyod nang sems can gang la'ang chags sems skyes ma thag dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis zin par ma byas pa dang*/ rang las rigs dang khrims dang yon tan sogs kyis rgan zhing che ba la dad gus dang zhe sa mi byed pa dang*/ chos dang mthun pa'i gros 'dri ba byung na ji ltar legs shing 'tsham par mi smra ba dang*/ yul gang yang rung bas mgron du bos na khyod kyi de 'dra ba la 'di srog dang dge sbyor gyi bar du 'gyur na nyes pa med do/ mchan mi 'ong snyam du bdag gir mi byed pa dang*/ dad pa'i sems kyis gser la sogs pa gzhan gyis 'bul ba mi len pa dang blangs nas dkon mchog gsum la 'bul lo/ mchan/ ser snas dkris pa la chos mi ster na pham pa yin zhing*/ chos sbyin rgyu bzhag nas bya ba gzhan la 'jug pas de g.yol ba dang*/ gzhan tshul khrims 'chal ba dag bdag gi gan du 'ongs nas 'gyod sems kyis bshags pa bgyid dam tha na yang skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed tsam zhu na'ang rang nyid btsun po 'di tshul khrims 'chal ba'o snyam du dor ba dang*/ gzhan dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bdag nyid spyod lam rnam par dag pa la mi slob pa dang*/ sems can gzhan theg chen gyi chos la 'jug pa'i nus pa bdag la yod bzhin du theg dman gyi chos la 'dzud pa dang*/

tshul 'chos dang kha gsag gis rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang*/ lus sgeg chos dang rtsab hral/ ngag mu cor dang bre mo/ yid rtog pa sna tshogs kyi rjes su 'brangs shing gzhan ma dad par bgyi ba'i rgyags 'chos dang*/ dregs 'chos byed pa dang*/ rang rdzun can dang g.yo sgyu can la sogs pa'i grags pa ngan pa phogs kyang mi spong ba dang*/ sems can gzhan bya ba ma yin pa la 'jug pa mthong na de bcos pa'i nus pa yod bzhin du mi bcos par 'dor ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bdag la gshe ba dang*/ rdeg pa dang*/ khro ba dang*/ mtshang 'bru bzhi byed na/ de'i lan du bdag gi phar la gshe ba rdeg pa khro ba mtshang 'bru bar byed pa dang*/ gzhan gyis bdag la khros 'dug na khyod khros pa'i nad khyog gi snyam nas yal bar 'dor ba dang*/ gzhan gyis nyes pa byas pa bdag gis mthong ngam thos nas slar de dag gis bdag la 'di ltar go ma go dang 'khrul ba'i dbang ngo zhes zhu gtug byed du byung na mi nyan par spong ba dang*/ gzhan gyi byed spyod mtho dman la brten pa'i khro sems byung ma thag gnyen pos mi spong ba dang*/ bsnyen bkur gyi phyir 'khor mang po sdud pa dang*/ dge sbyor dang chos spyod kyi khrid rim rnams dus su mi byed pa dang*/ snyom las dang le los dus 'da' ba dang*/ mtho dman gyi gtam la chags pas ku re dang bre mo'i gtam gyis dus 'da' ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don mi 'tshol ba dang*/ rgod pa dang 'gyod pa dang gnod sems dang rmugs pa dang*/ gnyid dang 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang the tshom rnams rang rgyud la skyes kyang de ma thag mi spong ba dang*/ zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la mchog tu 'dzin cing yang dag par lta ba dang*/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dman no zhes spong zhing gzhan la phan nges par 'dug na sman dang bzo dang sgyu rtsal la sogs pa mi slob pa dang*/ rang la byang sdom theg pa chen po'i khrims srung sla zhing phan yon che ba yod bzhin du theg dman nyan thos kyi spyod pa la brtson pa dang*/

mu stegs byed sogs kyi grub mtha' dang mthu dang ngan sngags rig byed sogs chos min la brtson pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos la brtson par bya ba bas phyi rol pa'i chos blta ba la dga' zhing sred na'ang*/ shes pas srid la mi gnas pa dang*/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i brjod bya theg chen spangs nas dman pa'i chos la sred cing nyams su len pa dang*/ ku re dang bzhad gad dang mtshang 'bru'i bsam pas bdag bstod gzhan smod dang*/ gnas dus kyis ma bskal ba'i sa na chos dang gdams pa nyan dgos pa yod kyang nga rgyal gyis der mi 'gro zhing mi nyan pa dang*/ rang dang gnas dus mtshungs pa'i sa na dge ba'i bshes gnyen theg chen gyi chos ston pa gzhan dag yod na de la phrag dog gi bsam pas smod pa dang*/ skur ba 'debs pa dag dang*/ chos dang zang zing lhan cig tu spyod pa'i grogs rnams dang 'grogs pa'i dus su bya ba rang la bab tshod de go ba blangs nas byed dgos pa la de ltar ma byas pa rnams nyes byas kyi sde tshan no// gzhan yang gzhung las/ semam̐s canam̐ tham̐ malam̐ lamam̐ zhugam̐s phyim̐ rolam̐ gyim̐// donam̐ bsgrubam̐ ces pas theg pa chen por zhugs pa'i byang sems ni sems can gyi don ma gtogs bsgrub rgyu med pa zhig dgos la/ de la tshul ji ltar bsgrub na nad kyis gdungs pa'i sems can la sman dang sman pa 'tshol ba dang*/ bza' btung sbyin pa la sogs pa thabs du ma'i sgo nas nad de las grol ba'i thabs la 'bad/ sems can lus sems sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba la rang la nus pa ci yod kyi sgo nas phan 'dogs shing sdug bsngal de bsal ba'i thabs bya/ rang rtag tu bag yod par gnas shing gzhan bag dang mi ldan pa dag mthong na de yang thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bag dang ldan par bya zhing gdams pa bstan| rang la gzhan gyis phan btags na de'i lan du phan cher 'dogs shing theg chen du gzud/ sems can gzhan dag gi pha ma shi ba'am nor brlags pa sogs mdor na yid mya ngan gyis gdungs shing gtses pa dag mthong na de la 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa 'di lta bu'i chos can chos thams cad 'di las ma 'das pas mya ngan ma byed cig

/ces bya ba la sogs pa thabs du ma'i sgo nas de'i mya ngan sel ba la 'bad/ gzhan dag gis nor slong na de la le lo dang g.yeng ba spangs nas de ma thag tu ji ltar 'tsham pa dang 'os pa re dga' spro dang bcas pas sbyin| rang la brten pa'i gang zag rnams la btang snyoms dang le lo spangs nas ji ltar 'dod pa'i chos bstan cing nor zas la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas phan gdags/ dgon gnas sogs gang du 'gro'am 'dug kyang rung chos mthun gyi grogs dang 'grogs shing ci byed dam pa'i chos dang blo mthun par bya/ gang zag gzhan la dad pa dang dag snang bya zhing*/ btson 'grus dang ting nge 'dzin shes rab can bsngags par 'os pa dag la bsngags pa yang dag par brjod/ rang la brten pa'i gang zag gcig log par zhugs pa mthong na dang po zang zing gi sbyin pas phan btags la bzhams te bsgo/ des kyang ma bzlog na bka' bkyon drag pos sma 'bebs pa dang gnas dbyung sogs thabs du mas tshar gcod cing de ma thag tshul dang mthun pa'i lam du bkri zhing skad cig kyang sems brtse bas ma dor bar bya/ bstan pa la sdang ba'i mu stegs can sogs log par lta ba'i 'gro ba rnams kyang dang po zang zing gi sbyin pas bsdus la dad par bya/ dad pas smin par bya/ smin pas grol bar bya/ des ma thul na rdzu 'phrul bstan la grol bar bya/ yang rdzu 'phrul med na dus phyi mar smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar la bsdu bar bya'o// tshul de rnams las 'das na'ang nyes byas re re 'byung ngo*// de ltar byang sdom kyi gtong thob kyi dus kyang*/ gzhung las/ dusam̐ brjom̐d ces 'byung bas dam tshig rdzogs pa gsang ba'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sdom pa thob pa'i dus ni bla mas gnang ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ blo mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ tshig brjod pa gsum gyi tha ma la 'thob ste/ zhes gsungs pas dus de lta bur sdom pa thob par shes pa nas bzung*/ ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bshad ma thag pa'i bcas pa rnams mig dang srog las kyang gces par bsrung bar bya'o// gtong ba'i dus ni/

lhag bsam gyis sems can thams cad bdag tu ma bzung ba dang*/ sems can gcig tsam yang blos spangs nas thun tshod las 'das pa dang*/ nyin zhag phrugs re la thun drug tu byas pa'i snga dro'i stod lta bu la gong du bshad pa'i ltung ba byung bar gnyen pos ma slebs par de'i thun phyi ma 'das na de ma thag tu byang sems kyi sdom pa gtong bar 'gyur ro// de ltar nyams na phyir bcos bya thabs ni/ gzhung las/ dem̐ nyamam̐s phyiram̐ bcosam̐ bya/ྃ /zhes pas/ dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i rtsa ltung byung na sdom pa rtsa ba nas gtong bas sngar bshad pa ltar cho ga tshul bzhin bskyar nas blang*/ zhe sdang med par gti mug dang chags pas kun nas bslangs pa'i ltung ba ni/ dkon mchog gi rten drung du byang chub sems dpa' gsum dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar bshags par bya/ chags pa rkyang pas kun nas bslangs pa'i ltung ba byung ba'am nyes pa la nyes par shes bzhin du ltung bas gos na byang chub sems dpa' gcig gi mdun du bshags sdom bya/ lus ngag tu ma grub pa'i sems la skyes tsam ni de ma thag tu dran shes kyi gnyen pos bsdam mo// de lta bu'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes pas mi gos pa'i thabs ni/ gzhung las/ rnyedam̐ bkuram̐ lam̐ zhenam̐ 'dom̐d yom̐n chagam̐s pam̐ spangam̐*// zhes pas de ltar sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des ni 'das pa'i 'dod pa la yi rang bar mi blta/ da ltar gyi 'dod pa la zhen cing chums par mi bya/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'dod pa la yid gdung bar mi bya/ mdor na bdag nyid kyi don du 'dod pa la don du gnyer ba spangs shing gzhan dag tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ de dag gi don sgrub pa sogs kyi ched du ni gang dang gang sbyin pa dag legs par blangs shing*/ longs spyod dkon mchog gsum gyi phyogs su btang zhing de rnams la yang 'dod sred dang chags sems spang*/ sems can phongs pa la sbyin pa byin la bsdu bar bya dgos so// de la bsgrub bya ni/

gzhung las/ lusam̐ ngagam̐ yidam̐ gsumam̐ rnam ྃdag ྃces pas/ lus yongs su dag pa/ lus kyi mi dge ba mtha' dag dang*/ gzhan ma dad par gyur pa'i spyod lam thams cad spangs shing*/ zhi ba dang dag pa dang*/ dang ba dang bag yod par bya/ ngag yongs su dag pa/ ngag gi mi dge ba mtha' dag spangs shing*/ ngag 'jam zhing des pa'i tshul dang ldan par bya/ yid rnam par dag pa/ rjes su chags pa dang gzhan la gnod sems dang log lta 'khon 'dzin nye du la chags pa dang*/ longs spyod la sred pa dang*/ rtag par 'dzin pa/ gzhan khyad du gsod pa la sogs spangs la sems zhi dul dang ting nge 'dzin la bslab dgos te/ bslab btus las/ kun tu mi rgod 'jam pa dang*// rang bzhin snyan par smra ba dang*// skal can skye bo 'dun pa yis| |gzung bar 'os pa skye bar 'gyur// zhes so// de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad ni dben par gnas na shugs kyis 'byung ste/ gzhung las/ dbenam̐ pam̐ bstenam̐| |zhes pas lus ngag yid gsum g.yeng ba'i rgyu dang bral bas der mi 'jug par 'gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang zhig grong gi dbus su 'dug na ni// bla med byang chub dam pa thob gyur pa'i// de 'dra'i sangs rgyas gang du'ang sngon ma byung*// ma byon pa dang da ltar bzhugs pa'ang med// rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs nas// dben par gnas shing ting 'dzin mchog zhugs pa// nyon mongs spangs shing bdud kyi sde bcom nas// byang chub rdul med 'dus ma byas 'tshang rgya// zhes pas byang chub sems dpa' gsar bu pa dag ni dben pa bsten pa mchog tu bsngags so// de yang gzhung las/ bgam̐ yodam̐ ces pas dben par gnas pa gcig pus mi chog pas lus ngag yid gsum bag yod par bya dgos te/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ khrims dang thos dang gtong dang bzod pa dang*// dge ba chos sdud brjod pa ji snyed pa// kun gyi rtsa ba bag yod 'di yin te// gter thob byed ces bde bar gshegs pas bstan// zhes so// de yang ji ltar spyod pa spyad ce na/

gzhung las/ spyodam̐ lamam̐ phunam̐ sumam̐ tshogam̐s pasam̐ gnam̐s// zhes pas/ de yang spyod lam ma dag pa'i gnas bdun spang ste/ dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang*/ bshan pa'i khyim dang*/ chang 'tshong ma'i khyim dang*/ smad 'tshong ma'i khyim dang*/ rigs ngan gyi khyim dang*/ rgyan po 'gyed pa'i khyim dang*/ rol mo mkhan gyi khyim rnams su gnas pa spong zhes so// sdig grogs bcu spang ba ni/ dkon mchog sprin las/ lta ba nyams pa dang*/ cho ga nyams pa dang*/ 'tsho ba nyams pa dang*/ tshul khrims nyams pa dang*/ khyim la chags pa dang*/ le lo can dang*/ 'du 'dzi la dga' ba dang*/ 'khor la dga' ba dang*/ byang chub la rgyab phyogs pa dang*/ bre mo'i gtam la dga' ba'i sdig pa'i grogs po dag yongs su spang bar bya'o// zhes so// gzhan yang log pa'i 'tsho ba bcu spang ba yang*/ tshul 'chos dang*/ kha gsag dang*/ gzhogs slong dang*/ rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang*/ thob kyis 'jal ba dang*/ mi rigs pas rnyed pa dang*/ chos ma yin pas rnyed pa dang*/ yongs su ma dag pa'i rnyed pa dang*/ rnyed pa la lhag par zhen pa dang*/ ma rnyed pa la yid skyo ba rnams spang dgos so// spyod lam dag pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i spyod lam ma dag pa de rnams las zlog par spyod cing mdor na sems can thams cad kyi don du mi dge ba spang dge ba sgrub 'jig rten ma dad par gyur pa thams cad las bzlog par bya dgos so// bsgrub bya'i tshul ni/ gzhung las/ bdagam̐ gim̐s khyadam̐ du ྃmim̐ gsodam̐ brtsom̐n 'grusam̐ brtsamam̐// zhes pas nga 'dra bas brtson pa bskyed kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi 'thob snyam du sems zhum pa spangs nas 'bad brtson drag pos sgrub cing rang gis rang la khrel mi dgos pa'i 'bad brtson byed dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ sbrang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang*// de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa// des kyang brtson 'grus stobs bskyed na// byang chub thob dka' bla med 'thob// bdag lta rigs kyi mir skyes pa// phan dang gnod pa ngo shes pas// byang chub spyod pa ma btang na// bdag gis byang chub cis mi 'thob| |ces gsungs pas don yid la byas te 'bad dgos so// de yang dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/

gzhung las/ lamam̐ bcum̐ pham̐ rolam̐ phyinam̐ drugam̐ bam̐sdu dngom̐s bzhim̐// rnamam̐ bcum̐ spangam̐ zhingam̐ lamam̐ bcum̐ rdzogam̐s param̐ spyadam̐// ces pas mi dge ba bcu spangs shing dge ba bcu bsgrub tshul ni/ srog gcod spangs la srog 'don pa dang*/ tshe skyob pa/ ma byin len spangs la sbyin pa gtang*/ mi tshangs spyod spangs la gzhan tshangs spyod la 'god/ rdzun tshig spangs la bden tshig gis gzhan bsdu/ phra ma spangs la gzhan mi mthun pa bsdum/ tshig rtsub spangs la zhi zhing 'jam par smra/ ngag 'khyal spangs la don dang mthun par smra/ brnab sems spangs la chags med du sbyin/ gnod sems spangs la byams shing phan gdags| log lta spangs la yang dag gi lta ba la goms par bya/ de ltar mi dge ba bcu'i las spangs la dge ba bcu'i lam la yang dag par spyad do// de yang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i rtsa ba ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa ste/ dang po gzhung las/ sbyinam̐ dngam̐ zhes pas/ de yang zang zing gi sbyin pa ni rang la nor rdzas yod dgu 'dus byas yin pas snying po med/ de bas da lta snying po len pa'i skabs yin pas sbyin pa btang la 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo/ da lta ma btang na 'chi khar gtong 'dod kyang dbang mi 'ong nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu yin/ ser snas mtshams sbyar ba ni yi dwags su skye bas da lta lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba'i sbyin pa phyogs med du gtong ba gnad che'o// chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ gang zag gang la'ang chos tha na tshig gcig tsam yang tshig don ma 'chug cing lung gis nges pa rigs pas 'thad pa nyams myong gis grub pa/ byams snying rje byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslangs la tshe 'di'i che thabs khe 'dod sogs spong la gzhan phan kho na'i blos mchog dman thams cad 'dam nga med par bshad do// mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i dge sbyong gi chos bzhi dang ldan pa la bslab par bya'o// skyabs kyi sbyin pa ni/

sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod dang ma bral ba'i blos dus 'da' bar bya zhing tha na rang la nus pa yod tshad kyis gzhan gyi 'jigs pa mtha' dag las skyob nus tshad la 'bad par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gzhung las/ tshulam̐ khrimam̐s zhes pas sdom pa'i tshul khrims byang chub tu sems bskyed nas sems can thams cad kyi don du lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba mtha' dag spangs shing dge ba bsgrub par bya/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang chos spyod bcu la sogs pa dge ba'i las thams cad spyod cing de thams cad byang chub sems kyis rtsis zin par bya/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dge ba mi spong sdig pa spong la dge ba bsgrubs pa rnams sems can gyi don du bya zhing gzhan don la 'bad par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gzhung las/ dem̐ bzhim̐n bzodam̐ pa ྃdngam̐*// zhes pas de yang gnod lan du gnod pa bskyal bas de'i 'bras bur da lta bdag la 'di lta bu byung ba yin snyam du bsam la/ gzhan gyis gnod 'tshe ji ltar byas byung yang khong khro ba spangs la bsran cing bzod thub par bya ba mdor na rang gi sdug bsngal thams cad bzod thub par byas nas/ gzhan phan kho na la bslab cing*/ gzhan gyi ched du bdag gi srog 'dor ba la'ang phangs pa med pa la bslab bo// bzhi pa/ gzhung las/ brtsonam̐ 'grusam̐ zhes pas sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus snyoms las dang le lo spangs nas dge ba la sbyor zhing sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'god par 'dod pa las byang chub kyi phyogs la sbyor ba'i brtson pa drag po dpag tu med par bya/ go cha'i brtson 'grus btang snyoms dang le lo'i dbang du ma btang bar brtson pa'i go cha dang ldan pas chos kyi bya ba la phyi bshol dang yid rlom rjes 'jog mi bya bar da lta dran ma thag dran grub mgo la me shor ba ltar lag tu blang bar bya'o// chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus ni/

chos kyi dam bca' dang dka' thub brtul zhugs la sogs pa yang res 'jog dang 'di tsam gyis chog shes dang tshe 'di zhes sogs kyi dus nges pa sogs nges pa lnga la sogs pa spangs nas glang po che'i 'gros sam pi waṃ gi sgra ltar rgyun ma chad pa ste/ sems can thams cad byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dam bca' zhing de yang ma drag ma zhan par rgyun mi 'chad du bya dgos so// lnga pa ni/ gzhung las/ bsam̐m gtanam̐ zhes pas/ dge ba'i chos zag pa med pa'i bsam gtan ni/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa dang*/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por bzod pa dang byams pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de ma rig pas bsgribs pas rten 'brel bcu gnyis su 'khor bas rten 'brel de rnams kyang gdod ma nas skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi mtha' dang bral bar mthong ba ni ma rig pa nyid rig pa ye shes su shar zhing 'khor ba'i rang bzhin mya ngan las 'das par rtogs pa dag go// tshul 'di ni zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sgo nas nyams su blang dgos pas phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su 'chad do// drug pa gzhung las/ shesam̐ rabam̐ pham̐ rolam̐ phyinam̐// ces pas shes par bya ba'i chos ni kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis su 'dus la/ de yang kun rdzob kyi ngo bo ni tshogs drug gi yul med bzhin du 'khrul ba'i blo la bden par snang ba 'di rnams yin zhing*/ de yang kun zhes pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas rnams zab mo la bzhugs par snang ba man chad/ sems can dmyal bar lcags khang me 'bar ba btso sreg byed par snang ba yan chad yin la/ rdzob ces pa ni/ de thams cad gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba la/ bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa'i las kyis snang ba tha dad du 'dzin cing*/ 'khrul ba'i blos bden par bzung bas na kun rdzob kyi bden pa zhes so// don dam pa'i bden pa ni/
