ngo bo mtshon du med pa smra bsam brjod med blo las 'das pa de la rang gi lta ba sgrub tu med cing gzhan gyi lta ba dgag tu med pa khas len thams cad dang bral ba/ tshig dang tha snyad kyis mtshon du med cing 'dus ma byas mtshan nyid thams cad dang bral ba phung khams skye mched shes rgyud kyis bsdus pa 'di mi rtag pa la rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba la bde ba/ mi gtsang ba la gtsang ba/ du ma la gcig tu 'dzin pa'i bdag de rig pas brtag na gang yang rtag pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ gtsang ba dang*/ gcig tu grub pa med cing stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i dus na gang zag gi bdag med pa'i don dam pa zhes bshad do// de ltar gang zag gi bdag med kyang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ mi gtsang ba dang*/ du ma stong pa nyid du 'dzin pa'i chos kyi bdag yod do zhe na// 'dzin pa'i chos gang snang ba de nyid stong pa yin pa'i phyir chos gang la yang bdag med de/ kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi snang ba spang du med cing don dam stong pa nyid du bsgrub tu med par rtogs pa'i dus na bsal bzhag dang dgag sgrub kyi mtha' las grol ba chos kyi bdag med ces bya ste/ de'i dus na shes bya'i sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba'i blo la sangs rgyas rnam snang chen por snang bas na/ 'khrul ba'i blo la dmyal ba snang ba yan chad sgyu ma lta bur snang zhing*/ sgyu ma de yang ma skyes shing gdod ma nas dag cing zhi bar rtogs pas kun rdzob spang du med cing don dam bsgrub tu med pas na/ bden pa gnyis su med pa'i phyir mtha' gnyis dang bral ba dbu ma'i lam zhes bya ba tha mal gyi shes pa rang ngo shes pa ste/ de yang phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su rtogs par bgyi'o// de lta bu'i phar phyin drug gi gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ gzhung las/ bdem̐ 'groram̐ longam̐s spyodam̐ gzugam̐s bzam̐ng gzim̐ brjidam̐ chem̐// zhim̐ dngam̐ rnamam̐ grolam̐ zhes pas de yang*/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las/

sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyi bde// bzod pas gzugs bzang brtson pas brjid// bsam gtan zhi ba blo yi gros// shes rab bden don gtan la 'bebs// zhes so// mthar thug ni/ gzhung las| dem̐ 'brasam̐ yom̐n tanam̐ rdzogam̐s// zhes pas rang don chos kyi sku ni bsam gtan dang shes rab kyis 'thob la/ gzhan don du gzugs kyi sku ni sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bzod pas 'grub la/ brtson 'grus kyis ni gnyis ka'i grogs byed par bshad do// bsdu dngos bzhi ni/ gzhung las/ donam̐ sbyinam̐ snyanam̐ smram̐ donam̐ spyodam̐ mthunam̐ pa ྃdesam̐// zhes pa de yang*/ blo gros mi zad pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ don sbyin pa ni zang zing gis bsdus nas chos sbyin pa'o// snyan par smra ba ni gang slong ba dang chos nyan pa rnams la tshig 'jam zhing snyan par smra ba'o// don spyod pa ni bdag med pa dang gzhan gyi don bya ba thams cad bsam bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o// don mthun pa ni theg pa gang la bdag tu 'dzin cing yon tan du 'du shes pa rnams chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas theg pa chen po la mthun par 'god pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar de lta bur brtson par bya'o// de rnams kyi byed las ni/ gzhung las/ snodam̐ 'gyuram̐ dadam̐ dngam̐ donam̐ grubam̐ 'brasam̐ bu ྃ'thom̐b// ces pas/ zang zing gi sbyin pas chos kyi snod du 'gyur bar byed/ snyan par smra ba'i chos la dad cing mos par byed/ don spyod pas chos de 'grub par byed/ don mthun pas chos las mi ldog cing 'bras bu thob par byed pa'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de rnams gang gis sdud par byed na/ sbyor ba byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslangs shing rjes 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas sdud par byed de/ des yul gang du bsngo na/ gzhung las/ kunam̐ mkhyem̐n thom̐b ces pas/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras nyan rang sogs kyi rgyur mi bsngo bar sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i rgyur bsngo bar byed do// de la bsngo rgyu bdag gi dge ba ni/

gzhung las// byasam̐ bskulam̐ dngam̐ yim̐ rangam̐ dngam̐*// zhes pas rang gis byas pa ni phar phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs pa/ bskul ba ni de rnams gzhan phan la byed du bcug pa/ yi rang ba ni de ltar dge ba'i las thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba'i bsam pa bgyis pa sogs so// gzhan yang ji ltar bsngo na/ gzhung las/ 'khom̐r zhes pas snod khams gsum/ bcud 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngo ba ste/ rgyu mtshan ni de thams cad bdag gi pha mar ma gyur pa med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ gzhung las/ 'dasam̐ zhes pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dang po thugs bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags/ mthar sangs rgyas pa sogs sems can thams cad kyi don yin zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnams la bdag 'dzin mi mnga' bas bsngo bar gsungs la/ de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun yang slob mi slob zag bcas zag med thams cad bsdus nas bsngo bar bya'o// ji ltar bsngo na/ gzhung las/ dusam̐ gsum̐m bsagam̐s dngam̐ zhes pas 'khor 'das thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba/ 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas bsngo ba'o// de la yang gzhung las/ yodam̐ pa'im̐ dgem̐// zhes pas sems can thams cad la khams rang bzhin gyis rnam dag gdod nas yod pa de gshis rang bzhin gyi dge ba bsngo rgyu'i gtso bo yin te/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ kun gzhi dri med bsod nams kyis// de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin// de nyid rtogs nas mthong ba ni// rnal 'byor 'jigs med rnal 'byor ro| |zhes gsungs so// bsngo ba'i thabs ni/ gzhung las/ yongam̐s bsngosam̐ zhes pas/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyi dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/

bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /ces kha tshig tsam min par don rgyud la 'dre nges shes par byas la thun thams cad kyi mjug tu 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas rgyas gdab par bya'o// bsngo ba 'grub pa'i rgyu ni/ gzhung las/ dem̐ 'grubam̐ ces pas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa des bsngos na 'grub/ dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar bsngos na 'grub/ dge 'dun gyis mthun 'gyur brjod na 'grub/ rang gis ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas yang dang yang du bsngo bas na ji lta bar 'grub pa'i phyir ro// ma bsngos pa'i skyon ni/ gzhung las/ mam̐ bsngosam̐ 'dzadam̐ 'gyuram̐ zhingam̐*// zhes pas rang gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta yan chad du 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ma shes pa gcig pus lan pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba lta zhog |bsngo ba'i rgyas ma thebs pas de dag zad cing smin par ma gyur ba yin no// dge ba de lta bu 'dzad pa'i rgyu ni bsngo bas rgyas ma btab pa dang*/ nga rgyal skyes pa dang*/ 'gyod pa skyes pa dang*/ yul khyad par can la log lta dang gshe skur bgyis pa na dge ba'i rtsa ba zad par 'gyur ro// log par bsngos pa'i nyes pa yang*/ gzhung las/ logam̐ pasam̐ deram̐ 'gyuram̐ zhes pas dge ba byas kyang bdag gzhan sems can thams cad rdzogs byang 'thob pa'i ched du ma bsngos par 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mngon mtho zhi bde nyan rang gi go 'phang thob 'dod du bsngos na de ltar 'grub cing grub nas zad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// bsngos pa'i dgos pa ni/ gzhung las/ bsngosam̐ pasam̐ thamasam̐ cadam̐ mkhyenam̐// ces pa ste/ de yang sangs rgyas gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'gro ba'i don du thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i slad du bsngo zhing chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i phyir de thams cad dmigs pa med pas rgyas gdab par bya'o| |de dag gis sa lam bsgrod pa'i tshul ni/

gzhung las/ dem̐ ltaram̐ zhes pas khongs su so skye'i dus tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum dang*/ sbyor lam drod rtse mo bzod pa chos mchog rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga stobs lnga rnams thob la de yang rang don du spyod na nyan thos pa yin la gzhan don du spyod na theg chen pa'o// gzhan yang thun mong gi 'bras bu ni| gzhung las/ 'jigam̐ rtenam̐ 'dasam̐ dngam̐ zhes pas/ mthong lam gyi dus sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ gsum pa 'od byed pa/ bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ lnga pa sbyang dka' ba/ drug pa mngon du gyur pa/ bdun pa ring du song ba rnams 'thob cing byang chub kyi yan lag bzhi 'thob pa'o// sgom lam gyi dus 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad sogs 'thob bo| |chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du 'gyur ba ni/ gzhung las/ dag ྃpa'im̐ sam̐// zhes pas sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar don dam pa'i bden pa mthong yang lus dang snang ba ma rtogs pas ma dag pa'i sa zhes brjod la/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin gsum thob pa ni lus dang snang ba snang med du rtogs pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa'i phyir/ bdag don du spros pa thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi sku mngon du byas shing*/ gzhan don du gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don 'bad med du 'byung ba'o// sa'i ngo bo yang*/ gzhung las/ bcum̐ bgrodam̐ ces pas sa bcu ga'i ngo bo nyid ni chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag ni dang po nas bcu pa'i bar khyad med kyang rjes thob kyis sems can gyi don byed pa la sprul pa 'gyed pa dang zhing khams sbyong ba dang sbyin pa la sogs pa bcus khyad par phye ba'o// mtshan nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po thob pa de mi 'gyur zhing brtan pa thob pas na sa zhes bya ba dang*/ yon tan gong ma thob pa'i gzhi rten byed pa'i phyir sa zhes bya'o| |zhes so// dbye ba ni/

bshad ma thag pa ltar bcu'o// mthar phyin pa'i sa ni sa bcu pa'i ming gi rnam grangs tsam mo// gzhung las/ rnamam̐ dpyodam̐ ces pas sa dang po nas sa bcu pa'i bar du sbyin pa sogs phar phyin drug gi steng du/ thabs mkhas pa dang*/ smon lam dang*/ stobs dang*/ ye shes kyi phar phyin te bzhi bsnan pas pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la spyod pa dag go| |de ltar 'thob bya'i 'bras bu la grangs su bcad na/ gzhung las/ grangam̐s medam̐ gsumam̐ 'bram̐s 'thobam̐// ces pas tshogs lam nas sbyor lam man chad grangs med dang po/ mthong lam nas sa bdun pa man chad grangs med gnyis pa/ sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa man chad grangs med gsum pa zhes go bde ba tsam gyi phyir grangs su bcad pa dag go// zhes pas de yan chad kyis rgyu mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam tshul gyis rgyud sbyang ba'i rim pa yongs su rdzogs pa legs par grub pa ni skabs dang po'o/// / ༈ /gnyis pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam dngos nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ gzhung las/ brtsom̐n gangam̐ myuram̐ skyobam̐ bdem̐ chenam̐ them̐g mchogam̐ 'dim̐r// zhes pas brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa'i gang zag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las myur du skyob par byed pa'i thabs ni bde ba chen po'i theg pa zhes pa theg pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje'i theg pa 'di nyid yin la/ de yang 'dir 'jug pa'i thabs ni gnyis te/ smin byed kyi dbang dang/ grol byed kyi khrid gnyis so// dang po ni/ smin lam dbang bskur bgyis par 'os pa'i slob dpon yang*/ gzhung las/ rgyudam̐ ldam̐n zhes pas sngar bshad pa'i phar phyin theg pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i steng du rgyud kyi don phyin ci ma log pa shes shing*/ sngags dang dkyil 'khor gyi lag len la mkhas pa/ rnyed bkur la mi lta zhing gzhan don la brtson pa/ rtogs pa dang ldan zhing bskyed rdzogs kyi don la sbyor shes pa/

dbang gi ye shes ngo sprod nus pa zhig nges par dgos te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ slob dpon mtshan nyid thams cad ldan// dbang dang ye shes rgyud shes shing*// he ru ka dpal gsang sngags shes// khro med gtsang zhing brtson pa dang*// sbyor shes ye shes pha rol 'gro// zhes pa ltar ro// slob ma yang gzhung las/ rtenam̐ lam̐ zhes pas/ rten slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang phar phyin theg pa nas bshad pa'i steng du/ dam tshig bkod pa rgyal po'i rgyud las/ snying brtser ldan zhing rab du dul// dpa' brtan brtul zhugs rab tu che// gtong phod bla ma la gus pa'i// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob ma la// zhes so// de ltar dpon slob mtshan ldan gyis ji ltar bgyi ba ni/ gzhung las/ zabam̐ donam̐ nusam̐ pam̐ bzham̐g /ces pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor| don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor rnams la brten/ bum gsang shes rab tshig dbang dang bcas pa bskur bas/ lus ngag yid chos nyid dang bcas pa dri ma dag nas sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i nus pa rgyud la 'jog pa ste/ thugs rjes khros pa'i rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor lha dang slob dpon dag /ldan pas slob pa'i rgyud dag la// dbang bskur nus pa 'jog byed pa// dbang bskur ba yi ngo bo yin// zhes so// rgyu mtshan yang gzhung las/ bkrusam̐ dngam̐ blugam̐s brjom̐d ces pas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes pa dri ma 'khru ba'am yang na nyer bsgyur a bhi ni mngon pa dang ṣiñtsa 'thor ba'am yang na a bhi ṣe ka ta zhes pa skal ba dang ldan pa'am ye shes bskyed pa'am mngon par dbang bskur ba'i don te/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ sems can rnams kyi don grub phyir// dbang ni rnam pa bzhi ru bshad// bkrus dang blugs pa zhes bya 'dis// des na dbang zhes brjod pa yin// zhes so// de'i dbye ba ni/ gzhung las/ dbangam̐ bzhi'im̐ rimam̐ pa ྃzhes pa yang*/

gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ dbang bskur ba ni bzhi ru dbye// bum pa'i dbang bskur dang po ste// gsang ba'i dbang ni gnyis pa yin// gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang*// rgyud 'di la ni rab tu grags// zhes so// bskur tshul ni/ gzhung las/ rdzogasam̐// zhes smos pas bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ tshig dbang 'khor dang bcas pas yongs su rdzogs par nod dgos pa'i don te/ de la 'dir slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing bsnyen pa tshad du thems pa dag gis slob ma rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sgom bzlas tsam dang yig brgya'i bzlas lung dang bar chad sel ba'i phyir las sngags kyi lung tsam byin la/ slob dpon gyis zhag bdun la sogs par bsnyen pa kha gso zhing las kyi rdo rjes thig tshon rnams sta gon byas la/ slob dpon mtshams grol 'phral slob ma rnams la dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni/ sa brtag pa sogs nas bzung dngos gzhi'i bar du gzu lum dang ras gcod spangs la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bdun ldan gyi sgo nas dbang rdzogs par bya ba ni rgyud sde gong ma gsum gang rung gis 'thus kyang*/ skabs 'dir rgyal ba 'jig rten mgon po nas da lta'i bar du dbang gi chu bo ma nub cing rim gnyis kyi shing rta ma nyams pa yin pa'i phyir/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'am lhan skyes lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs par bskur dgos so// de ltar dbang bskur ba'i dgos pa ni/ gzhung las/ dgom̐s 'dodam̐ kunam̐ 'byungam̐ zhes pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad 'byung ste/ lung rnam bzhag gi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor thar pa'i grong mchog 'dir// zhugs pa dang ni dbang bskur la| |phyir bzlog pa ni yod min te// 'dir zhugs bu rnams skad cig kyang*/ 'bral med 'og min gnas su 'gro// zhes so// dbang ma thob pa'i nyes pa ni/

gzhung las/ dem̐ medam̐ dngom̐s grubam̐ mim̐n// zhes de lta bu med na dngos grub 'byung ba'i skabs med de/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ sngags pas dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar// gang zhig rnal 'byor pa nyid 'dod| |mkha' la khu tshur gyis rdeg dang*// smig rgyu'i chu la 'thung dang mtshungs// zhes so// de ltar dbang thob pa tsam gyis mi chog dam tshig bsrung dgos pa yang*/ gzhung las/ dem̐ thom̐b ces pas dbang bzhi thob nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig bsrung ba ste/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ shin tu mnyam bzhag sgrub pa pos// dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya// dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur dngos grub 'thob mi 'gyur// zhes so// bsrung tshul ni/ gzhung las/ rnamam̐ gsumam̐ mim̐ 'da'am̐ zhes pas sku bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang rtsa rlung gi nyams len/ thugs ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyi sems stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa sgom pa ste/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi// dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che// sangs rgyas kun gyi rtag pa 'di// rdo rje 'dzin gyis bsrung bar bya// zhes so// de la mi 'da' ba'i tshul ni/ gzhung las/ dmam̐ pa'im̐ tshigam̐ /ces pas dam pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la tshig ni des gsungs pa'i chos spang zhing blang bar bya ba rnams yin te/ dam tshig rdzogs pa gsang ba'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bsrung bar bya ba dang*/ 'da' bar mi bya ba'i dam tshig ni gsum ste/ gzhung thun mong gi sdom pa dang*/ lam spyi'i sdom pa dang*/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa'o// zhes so// de la'ang gsang sngags kyi sdom pa bsrung bya ni/ gzhung las/ thunam̐ mongam̐ zhes pas/ dang po rgyud sde thun mong gi dam tshig ni rigs lnga spyi'i sdom pa ste/ sangs rgyas rigs kyi dam tshig tu dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed dkon mchog gsum mi spong*/

rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang slob dpon mi spong*/ rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu sbyin pa bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum gyi chos mi spong*/ las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu sdom pa thams cad dang ldan zhing mchod gtor ma chag par nyams su blang bar bya ba rnams so// de'i steng du bsrung bya gzhung las/ rtsam̐ bam̐ zhes rtsa ltung ni bcu bzhir bshad de/ slob dpon bha bi lhas/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ zhes sogs so// de'i yan lag ni gzhung las/ yanam̐ lagam̐ ces pas/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ rab tu bde ba 'phrog byed pa// yan lag nyes pa nga yis bshad// dam tshig dag dang mi ldan pa'i// rig ma brten par dga' ba ni// yan lag nyes pa dang por bshad// tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa ni| |yan lag nyes pa gnyis par bshad// ma gsungs pa yi rig ma la// sngags pas bdud rtsi 'thor byed pa// yan lag nyes pa gsum pa yin// gsang chos yan lag shes gyur kyang*// gzhan la mi ston shes rab ngan// yan lag nyes pa bzhi pa yin// dad pa'i sems can chos kyi rgyu// gzhan gyi gtam byed byang chub sems// yan lag nyes pa lnga pa yin// nyan thos nang du zhag bdun 'das// yan lag nyes pa drug pa yin// rnal 'byor ye shes mi shes par// nga ni sngags pa yin zer ba// yan lag nyes pa bdun pa yin// snod min pa yi sems can la// phyi yi chos bshad yin pa la// gsang ba'i chos rnams bshad pa yis// yan lag nyes pa brgyad pa yin// zhes so// gzhan yang gzhung las| sogam̐s srungam̐ gangam̐*// zhes pas rgyud sde gzhan las bshad pa ste/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ rang lha blang dor ltung ba mig /de nyid dus 'das ri bong can// lha gzhan dga' ba yon tan no// rig byed dngos la zhen pa yis// ma rdzogs rdzogs byed mda' yin no// 'jig rten chos phyir dbang po ste// khyad du gsod pa smad ne ri// gong min tshul ston bkra shis so| |phrin las ma gtogs gza' zhes grags// don med gnas pa phyogs yin no// brtse ba gtong ba drag po ste// dman pa'i spyod pa nyi ma'o// zang zing rtog pa yan lag go//

yongs su mi 'dzin pa zhes bya// rang spyod dor ba tshes zhes grags// zhes bco lnga dang*/ gzhan yang*/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ dam pa nyer bsten gcig shos min// snod dang ldan pa rnam par brtag /'dod phyir gzhan la gnod pa spang*// dkon mchog la sogs nor la min// gzhan don skad cig yal mi 'dor// byang chub med par dge mi 'jug /rnam shes 'pho bar de nyid mkhas// gzhan du yan lag nyes pa'o// zhes so// de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bsrung bya thams cad kyi gtso bo ni slob dpon la mi brnyas pa ste/ gsang ba thugs rje'i rgyud las/ nyon cig dam tshig thams cad rtsa bar gyur pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rtsa ba'i yon tan bzung zhing nam yang smad par mi bya'o// zhes pa nas 'di lta ste/ dper na 'dod pa'i khams dang*/ gzugs kyi khams dang*/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyi sems can thams cad dus gcig tu bsad pa bas ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig la smad pa'i cha dang grangs su mi 'gro zhing bye ba brgya'i char yang mi 'gro'o// zhes pa'i bar gsungs pas slob dpon srog bzhin gzung ba ni dam tshig thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no// bsrung ba'i phan yon ni gzhung las/ phanam̐ bdem̐ kunam̐ 'byungam̐ zhes pa ste/ dam tshig rdzogs pa gsang ba'i rgyud las/ sdom pa dam tshig thams cad la legs par gnas pa ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ro// zhes so// nyams pa'i nyes pa yang gzhung las/ dem̐ nyamam̐s nganam̐ 'groram̐ ltungam̐*// zhes pa ste| dam tshig thams cad bkod pa'i rgyud las/ phyag na rdo rje legs par nyon// gal te rtsa ba'i slob dpon la// dam tshig rdzogs par nyams gyur nas// rnal 'byor bskang ba ma byas na| |rdo rje dmyal bar grags pa yi// sdug bsngal mi bzad myong bar 'gyur// yan lag nyes pa lo zla'i bar// ma bshags dmyal ba chung ngu'i tshad// de ni nges par 'tshed par byed| |gzhan pa'i sdug bsngal 'di dag ste// shin tu grang bkres yi dwags dang*// byol song gnas su skye bar 'gyur// zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs so// de yang gzhung las/

dem̐ phyiram̐ srogam̐ bzhinam̐ bsrungam̐ dang ྃzhes pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig thams cad srog ltar gces par bsrung dgos te/ mngon par byang chub pa las/ dam tshig 'di ni sus rig pa| |rgyud rnams kun la zhugs pa dang*// dkyil 'khor kun la dbang ba yin// sngags 'chang de ni nga dang 'dra// zhes so// gtong thob kyi dus ni gzhung las/ dusam̐ shesam̐ pasam̐| |zhes pas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i dus thob pa yin la/ gtong ba'i dus ni/ yul sum ldan gyi bla ma la der 'du shes pa dang*/ nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba/ srog gi yo byad dam nyams kyi 'tsho ba 'phrog pa byas par shes pa/ 'gyod pa med par rjes su yi rang ba dang bdun tshang na ltung ba rdzogs pa ste/ 'jam dpal sgyu dra las/ gcig la slob dpon gsum rdzogs pa// sbyor ba bdun dang ldan pa yi// rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung gyur na// sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rtsa ba yin// zhes so// rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba rnams kyang re re la sbyor dngos rjes kyi dbye bas lci yang gsum gsum 'byung ste/ thig le 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ ltung ba'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba// lus kyis ma spyad chung ba ste// zin kyang mi shes 'bring du bshad// zin kyang ma bshags chen po yin// ngag gi sbyor bas rnam pa gang*// ma brtag 'khrul ba chung ngu ste// brtag dpyad nyes pa 'bring du bshad// tshad 'das chen po'i sbyor ba'o// rnal 'byor sems kyi mtshan nyid ni// shin tu lci ba'i rim pa yi// gnod sems gsum ni brtag par bya// zhes so// ltung ba byung na phyir bcos pa'i thabs la/ dang po ltung ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba slob dpon la brnyas na stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa sogs byas pas rang gi bsam pa rdzogs pa'i khul byas kyang slob dpon gyis gnang bar ma gyur na ltung ba 'dag par mi 'gyur bas ltung ba dag pa ni slob dpon nyid kyis nges par gnang ba sbyin pa zhig dgos so// de la yang slob dpon la yan lag bdun ldan gyi dam tshig nyams nas ma bshags par rang nyid shi na mnar med pa'i dmyal bar ltung la/

rang ma shi na'ang bshags sdom ma tshar bar slob dpon 'das na ni bshags pa rnams tshad las lhag par bya dgos so// de yang slob dpon bzhugs na bshags thabs ni/ 'jam dpal sgyu dra las bshad pa'i tshul ni/ rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la phul la dbang bzhi rdzogs pa lan bdun/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo nyi shu rtsa gcig /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bdun/ gsang sngags kyi bsnyen pa bye ba phrag lnga/ maṇ+ḍal 'bum phrag gnyis/ srog chags bye ba'i srog skyob/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i don bsgom pa'o// yang na 'khor lo bzhi'i rdzogs rim zla ba bdun du sgom zhing*/ gang la yang zhen chags med par phyogs med du 'khyams/ yang na lus las khrag phyung nas maṇ+ḍal bdun nam brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul dgos par bshad do// ltung ba gzhan rnams phyir bcos bshags sdom bgyi tshul ni sngags gzhung so so nas bshad pa ltar 'di nyid kyi 'grel pa legs bshad lung gi rgya mtshor bshad pa ltar rtogs par bya'o// de ltar smin byed kyi dbang rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa kho nas mi chog par lam rim pa gnyis nyams su blang dgos pa yang*/ gzhung las/ rnamam̐ grolam̐ zhes pas srid pa'i 'ching ba las rnam par grol bar byed pa ni lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// rim pa gnyis la yang dag gnas// bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang*// rdzogs pa yi ni rim nyid do// zhes so// de lta bu nyams su blang ba'i thabs ni/ rgyas par ni gzhung las/ donam̐ mngam̐ zhes pas bskyed rim la'ang rnam pa du ma dang*/ rdzogs rim yang pha rgyud la rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ sems dmigs bdag byin gyis rlabs pa/ 'od gsal zung 'jug gi rim pa sogs dang*/ ma rgyud la'ang gtum mo rmi lam sgyu lus la sogs pa dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud la'ang*| |rdzogs rim du ma zhig bshad kyang*/ 'dir de dag thams cad kyi don bsdus pa ste/

gzhung las/ bstanam̐ pa'im̐ snyingam̐ pom̐ bsgomam̐// zhes pas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len gang zag gcig gi thun gcig gi thog tu nyams su blang ba la 'jug pa bde ba zhig ste de yang*/ gzhung las/ thabam̐s mchom̐g rnamam̐ dag ྃbdem̐ bam̐ chenam̐ pom̐'i skum̐// yidam̐ bzhim̐n noram̐ bum̐ mtha'am̐ bralam̐ namam̐ mkham̐'i dbusam̐// gnyisam̐ medam̐ chum̐ rgyunam̐ mim̐ zadam̐ rinam̐ chenam̐ gtem̐r// zhes smos pas rkang pa dang pos byang chub kyi sems dang bskyed rim/ gnyis pas bla ma dang rdzogs rim/ gsum pas bsngo ba bstan pa ste/ de yang dpal phag mo gru pas/ byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po ste// bsngo ba'i chos kyis nyams su blang*// zhes pa ltar lnga las| ༈ /spyi don dang po byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ gzhung las/ byamam̐s chenam̐ brtseram̐ ldanam̐ mkha'am̐ mnyamam̐ rinam̐ chenam̐ semam̐s// zhes pas rdzogs byang 'thob pa'i rgyu ni/ byang chub kyi sems 'dus ma byas pa 'di nyid kho na yin te/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ rtsa ba sa bon byang chub sems// de la rin chen pad sdong gi /yal ga lo 'dab me tog rgyas// 'bras bu bde gshegs gtsug gi nor// zhes so// de yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gang sgom yang sems de las tshad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de yang nam mkha' ltar tshad med par 'gyur/ de'i rgyu mtshan rtsa ba sman yin la lo 'dab dang me tog 'bras bu yang sman nyid du 'ong ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ des na gong du bshad pa lta bur byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa la blo sbyang ba ni 'dir rtsa ba'i chos dang po yin no// de myur du 'grub par byed cing rgya chen por 'phel ba'i thabs ni/ byang chub kyi sems stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i ngang nas bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa yin te/ de yang tha ma dang por brjod na/

gzhung las/ dem̐ lasam̐ gangam̐ byungam̐ deram̐ 'gyuram̐ dem̐ bsngosam̐ 'grubam̐| |ces pas bsngo ba'i tshul ni gong du yang rgyas par bstan zin la dgos pa'i skabs don ni 'og tu chos lnga pa'i dus su 'chad par 'gyur ro/// / ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa yi dam gyi lha sgom pa la yang*/ gzhung las/ gdom̐d nasam̐ lhanam̐ skyesam̐ zhes pas byang chub kyi sems de las byung ba'i lha ni sngon med pa zhig 'dir bskyed pa ma yin te/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i dngos po thams cad gdod nas rang bzhin gyis yongs su grub pa rten dang brten pa'i ngo bor lhan skyes su gnas pa ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lnga ni rab tu grags// zhes dang*/ nges brjaud bla ma las/ gzugs ni rnam par snang mdzad de// tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma yin// 'du shes pad+ma gar dbang yin// 'du byed pad+ma rgyal po ste// rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' yin// bde gshegs kun gyi he ru kaḥ /mig ni gti mug rdo rje yin// rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje yin// sna ni ser sna rdo rje yin// lce ni 'dod chags rdo rje yin// lus ni phrag dog rdo rje yin// skye mched dbang phyug rdo rje'o// zhes rgya cher gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar gdod nas yongs su grub pa'i lha de nyid yin pa la yin par rtogs pa'i thabs ni/ gzhung las/ 'dusam̐ sogam̐s rgyudam̐ rnamam̐s donam̐// zhes pas/ gsang 'dus sam/ bde mchog gam/ dgyes rdor sogs rang gi sngon bsags kyi las 'phro sad pa'i lha zhig bsnyen na 'grub nye ba'i phyir ro// de nyid bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ chos bzhi dang ldan dgos te dang po ni/ gzhung las/ byangam̐ chubam̐ lasam̐ byungam̐ zhes pas lha sgom pa de yang bshad ma thag pa'i byang chub kyi sems bzang po de'i ngang las byung ba zhig nges par dgos te/ mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog las/ byang chub sems la rab brtson na| |de nyid rnal 'byor lhar 'gyur ro// zhes so// de yang skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba'i dbye bas/

ji skad du/ mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis// bsgoms pa rnams ni yongs su brtag |ces mngal skyes sbyong ba la mngon byang lnga bskyed zhu ba glus bskul dang bcas shing rgyu 'bras kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa so sor bskyed pa dag go// sgong skyes glu ni med pa ste// sgra dang sgra min spang ba'o// zhes zhu ba glus bskul dang rgyu 'bras kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa so sor bskyed pa'i lugs ma byas pa zhig go// sems can brdzus te skye ba bzhin// sa bon med par rnam par bsam| |zhes pas sems can brdzus te skye ba ltar/ sa bon dang phyag mtshan gang la yang ma brten par skad cig la chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul gyis bsgom pa'o// drod gsher skyes ni de gsum ga la tshang bas sbyong tshul logs su mi dgos pa yin la/ kha cig gis nyi zla'i gdan sogs kyi steng du sa bon tsam gyis bskyed pa skye gnas de sbyong ngo zhes bzhed pa'ang yod do// de ltar bskyed tshul gsum gyi snga ma ni ha cang spros pa che bas las dang po pa rnams kyi blor chud par dka' zhing*/ phyi ma ni cung zad bsdus pas gsal snang ma thon gyis dogs/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma kun gyi blo dang 'tsham pa'i phyir bar pa nyid 'chad par byed pa la yang*/ dang po bsrung ba'i 'khor lo mdor bsdus pa bsgom pa ni/ lag g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis se gol mdun du gtogs shing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ g.yon du/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyab tu/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ g.yas su/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kyi yi ge rnams rim bzhin nag ljang dmar ser 'od dang bcas pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i bar khyab cing 'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs kyi mdog can gyi rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi par gyur pa dang dus mnyam par 'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang ra ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra ba dang*/

de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gur dang*/ gur gyi mtshams su rdo rje'i bla bre dang*/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab par gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+ri bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bsgom/ slar yang skabs 'dir spro na tshogs zhing spyan drangs la mchod bstod bdun rnam dag bya tshogs zhing rang la bsdus la tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po gru gsum pa 'og phra zhing steng yangs pa'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar bh+rūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas sngo ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa lnga'i steng du/ rin po che pha gu dang do shal dang do shal phyed pas 'phyang ba/ shar bu dang mda' yab kyis mdzes pa'i steng du gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ phyi 'gram du 'dod snam dmar po la lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas thogs nas mchod cing*/ sgo dang sgo 'khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rin po che rdo rjes spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du pad zla la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang gdugs dang g.yas g.yon du ri dwags gnyis gnyis kyis mtshan pa/

rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum bzang las thon pa'i dpag bsam kyi shing la rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pas spras shing*/ nam mkhar lha'i bu dang bu mo dang grub pa thob pa rnams rgyu ba/ gzhal yas khang gi nang ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis phub pa'i tog byur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'i steng 'og thams cad shar sngo byang ljang nub dmar lho ser ba/ phyi rol du sna tshogs pad+ma dang rdo rje ye shes me'i ra ba g.yon du 'bar ba'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams su dur khrod chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i shing dang*| phyogs skyong zhing skyong lha klu sprin dang ri dang mchod rten dang me chu grub chen dang phra men ma rnams brgyad brgyad dang*/ rig 'dzin grub pa dang rnal 'byor pho mo dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po ro langs sha za 'byung po'i tshogs rnams rgyu zhing*/ ro dang keng ru+us dang dum bur 'thor ba dang*/ khwa dang 'ug pa dang bya rgod ce spyang pho mo la sogs pa du mas gang ba'i bkod pa dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'jigs byed nag po dang dus mtshan ma dmar mo/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma la zla ba'i steng du ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du ā di phrag gnyis las zla ba dang*/ kā di ḍa ḍha da dha ya las brgyan pa phrag gnyis las nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po la rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po'i mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'gro don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs sa bon la thim zhing de thams cad 'dres pa songs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas par gyur pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba zhal gcig

/spyan gsum mche ba bzhi cung zad gtsigs pa/ skra mtshams su rdo rjes sbrel ba'i thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse bran gyis brgyan pa| ral pa'i cod pan gyi rtse mor nor bu dang*/ mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon du zla ba phyed pas spras pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed kyi mgo bo bltabs te brdzis shing g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma'i nu bar du mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol zhing thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig /spyan gsum ma/ dbu skra sil bu rgyab tu grol zhing skra mtshams su thod skam lngas spras pa/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul la 'khyud de stob cing g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ bde ba chen po'i nyams kyis sgeg cing lang tshos mdzes pa/ gcer mo thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gnyis ka'ang mtshan dpes spras shing bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can thabs shes gnyis su med pa snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lho ru gzugs can ma ser mo rnams zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ rgod pa'i zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing skra grol ba'i mtshams su thod skam lngas spras pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ gcer bu thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal dang rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab mar zla ba la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du byang sems sogs kyis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi gnas pa'o// de ltar gsal ba'i lha thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi snying khar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bauṣ+ṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃ ljang gu/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ haṃ'u ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur ces sgom/ slar 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ zhes pa'i sgra dang snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ añtsa mā ṇaṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad sbyar bas mchod/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pad skor dang 'khyud tshul bya/ slar yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes dbang gi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dbang lha thams cad kyang dbyer med du thim chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par bsam/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo'i mchod pa gong ltar/ oṃ badz+ra wi ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ waṃ she/ mṛ taṃ ge/ mu rañdze/ ha s+ye/ lā s+ye/ gīrti/ nīrti/ puṣ+pe| dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ oṃ rū pa badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dharma dhā tu/ sbyar bas mchod/ nang mchod g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas thigs gtor gyis mchod cing*/

snying ga nas rnal 'byor ma bzhi spros te sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas mchod par gyur ces dang*/ rgyas par na 'dir brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan mthar yi ge gsum btags pas dbul/ bsdus par na drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ lā me oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pi nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'grau rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong la sogs pa dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug gi srid pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la bsngo'o/ oṃ āḥhaṃ'u thams cad kyang zag med kyi bde bas tshims nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta swā da na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myang*/ slar yab yum snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po bskyed pas lha thams cad kyis kyang bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha he he ru ru+u kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes 'khyud tshul bya/ lha so so'i sku la dmigs nas yab yum gyi snying po nye snying dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags lan re brjod/ bstod pa ni/ o+oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin du/ oṃ dang huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ thog mthar sbyar bas/ ma hā kalpāg+ni saṃ ni bha ya/ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya/ daṃ ṣ+ṭ+wā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya/ pa ra shu pā shod+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/

byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya/ ma hā dhū mrān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya/ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ/ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīd+ye shwa ri/ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badz+re/ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ni tra bh+rā ma ṇi/ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni/ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye/ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam+bha ni mo ha ni/ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhung las/ brtanam̐ gnam̐s zhes pas rang nyid lha min pa la bsgyur nas sgom pa ma yin par gdod nas rang nyid lhar yongs su grub pa sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la gsal btab pa tsam yin pa'i phyir rnam pa kun tu nga rgyal brtan cing tshul de lta bur gnas pa dgos te/ rang rig ye gdod ma nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ma bskyed gsal rdzogs su yod pa'i phyir sems can thams cad kyis de ltar ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin no// de bas na dpal he ru ka nga'o// oṃ shrī he ru ka ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes sngags don dran bzhin pas nga rgyal brtan cing dus kun tu lha'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gzhung las/ gsam̐l zhingam̐ zhes smos pas de ltar gdod ma nas yin yin por nga rgyal tsam ma gtogs gsal ma btab na lha'i sku zhal phyag dang bcas pa gsal snang thon pa mi 'byung bas dang por gsal snang thon pa bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa zhig shin tu gal che bas des na sngar bshad pa ltar lha'i sku yab yum gtso 'khor thams cad kyi rgyan phra mo yan chad kyang nag nog med par shin tu gsal ba zhig dgos pas rab skad cig dran rdzogs lta bu gsal btab/ de ltar ma byung yang gtso bo'i dbu'am zhabs nas rim gyis gsal snang nges pa brtan po thon pa zhig gtso 'khor thams cad la gal che zhing yin rlom dang byas blo tsam la yid brtan med do// bzhi pa ni/

gzhung las/ dgam̐ /ces pas de lta bu'i lha sku la nga rgyal brtan cing dus kun tu tshul de la gnas pa dang gsal snang thon yang don dam par me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang stong gsal stong sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ zhal phyag rgyan la sogs pa yang chos dang chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i don dran pa zhig ma byung na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ba'i phyir rnam par dag pa dran pa ni/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni lā ma/ chos rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes ma/ sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o// yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dpal he ru ka rdo rje'o// zhes lha'i dag pa dang*/ dpa' bo rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang*// tshangs pa'i skud pa sogs su btags// dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi// lus kyi khams la brtag pa'o| |dpa' bo go cha drug pa yi// phyag rgya 'dis ni lus mdzes so// rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin// mgrin par mgur chus brgyan pa'o// lha yi snying po'i sngags kyi ni// phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyis brgyan// yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyi// gdub skor gyis ni rna ba brgyan// sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro mas// pags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o// rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyi// ska rag byas pas brgyan pa'o// 'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i// sngags ni btung ba'i thod pa'o// rnam snang mdzad ces sngags gang yin// thod pas dbu la brgyan pa'o// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku// shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra// nyin mo bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod// mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo ni// drug pa sems kyi sprul pa ste// dag pa'i chos kyi sprul pa ste// phag mo'i gzugs su ston pa'o// shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid| |ru ni bkod pa dang bral ba// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// zhes rgyan dang rtsa khams nyin mtshan sogs kyi dag pa dran par bya'o// de ltar chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i lha de lta bu yang 'chal bar mi bsgrub te/

gzhung las/ gsangam̐ dngam̐ zhes pas dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba dang ma dad pa sogs la dkyil 'khor lha dang sgrub rdzas la sogs pa sba zhing gsang bar bya'i/ de ltar ma byas na lha mi 'grub cing gsang sgrog gi ltung ba yang 'byung ste/ rdor phreng las/ snod dang cang te'u gri gug dang*// glegs bam dang ni bgrang phreng dang*// rnal 'byor spyod sogs bya ba dang*// man ngag rnams ni bstan mi bya// ras bris la sogs mi bstan cing*// gang gi dam tshig lhan cig tu// ji ltar spyod la bya ba min// zhes sogs gsungs so// de nas rags pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i spyi bor haṃ dkar po/ mgrin par oṃ dkar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar āḥ dmar po bsam zhing āḥlas ye shes kyi me rim gyis 'bar ba'i 'khor lo gsum gyi yi ge bsregs shing haṃ las byang sems rim gyis bab pas yi ge rnams slar gsos te bde drod 'bar bar bsam zhing rlung bum pa can kha sbyor du bsgom la du ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu mngon du bya'o// de dag gis skyo na/ gzhung las/ thugam̐s bskulam̐ sngagam̐s kyisam̐ zhes pas| lha rnams kyi thugs bskul bar byed pa ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste/ nges brjod bla ma las/ bgrang du med pa'i bzlas pa ni// rdo rje'i bzlas pa yin par bshad// ces pas bshad ma thag pa'i rdzogs rim gyi ngang nas rlung 'jug gnas 'gro gsum yi ge gsum gyi tshul gyis ngag nas brjod pa min zhing*/ yid kyis bgrang ba yang ma yin par tshul de lta bur bzla'o// yang sngags bzla ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng thon rdo rje nas bab yum gyi pad+mar zhugs pa yum gyi zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs pa sa bon la thim zhing*/ yang de ltar 'khor bar gyur pa la shes pa gtad nas/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/

zhes pas yab kyi snying po dang*/ oṃ hrīḥ ha ha huṃ haṃ'u phaṭ/ ces nye snying*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yum gyi snying po/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ haṃ'u phaṭ/ nye snying ngo*/ 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe 'khor so so'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i hūm̐ las lha tshogs spros 'gro ba'i don byas slar hūm̐ la thim par gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas so// sngags yid bzlas dang ngag nas drag tu bzla ba yang bya ste thams cad du lha rnams zhal nas kyang sngags brjod bzhin par bsam mo// thun mthar rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ de rnal 'byor ma bzhi la thim/ de yum la/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus/ nā da yang mi dmigs par 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur ces dar cig mnyam par bzhag /slar yang rang nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i he ru ka yab yum lhan skyes su gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par mos la thun las ldang ngo*// de ltar bskyed rdzogs ni bka' brgyud gong ma'i thugs dam gyi rim pa ltar bsdus nas bkod pa yin la/ rgyas par bya 'dod na/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs kyi khrigs rim ltar sngon gtor nas bzung ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi bar yan lag tshang bar byas na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// tshul de lta bu yang gzhung las/ dem̐ nyim̐d 'grub/ྃ /ces pas sku de nyid lha'i rnal 'byor mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ gsung de nyid rdor bzlas dang*/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe long gtam gyis bar ma chod pa/

thugs de nyid 'khrul rtog gi dbang du mi gtong bar ting nge 'dzin las ma yeng bar de nyid gsum dang ldan pas lha 'grub pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yid ni g.yo med byas nas kyang*// de nas sngags ni bzla bar bya// zhes so// gal te gsang sngags kyi chos med na thabs gzhan gyis 'tshang mi rgya ba ni gzhung las/ dem̐ medam̐ dngom̐s mim̐n zhes pas thabs pha rol tu phyin pa drug bskal pa mang por spyad kyang*/ phung khams skye mched tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba'i shes rab med na 'tshang rgya ba mi srid de/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ 'bras bus rgyu la rgyas gdab cing*// rgyus kyang 'bras bur rgyas gdab par// sgom zhing gzhan nas dngos grub ni// bskal pa bye bar 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes so// de bas na gzhung las/ dem̐ lasam̐ dem̐ 'brelam̐ thobam̐// ces pas byang chub kyi sems las byung ba'i lha'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pas 'bras bu yang de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las la sogs pa ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du 'grub ste/ rdor phreng las| gsang sngags lha yi tshul gyis ni// dngos grub thams cad bsgrubs pas 'grub// chos kyi sku la rab gnas te// sprul skus phyogs bcu'i 'gro don byed// de ltar phyi rabs rnal 'byor pas// tshul 'di nyid kyis 'grub par 'gyur// zhes so// ༈ /spyi don gsum pa lha yi bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i ngang nas yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma dam pa bsgom dgos te/ gzhung las/ dngom̐s grubam̐ rtsam̐ bam̐ dbam̐ng gim̐ rgyalam̐ pom̐ stem̐// zhes pas dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba nor bu dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i bla ma dam pa bsgom pa shin tu gal che ste/ mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod las/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud| |ces pas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal stong pa nyid don dam pa'i bden pa de khyod kyi rgyud la rtogs par byed pa ni bla ma'i drin la rag las pa yin no// de lta bu'i yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma yin na bsgrub tshul ji lta bu zhe na/

gzhung las/ sangam̐s rgyasam̐ nyidam̐ mthom̐ng zhes pas/ bla ma de so skyer mthong na dngos sgrub ci yang mi 'thob/ bla ma byang chub sems dpar mthong na dngos grub phra mo 'thob/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong na mchog gi dngos grub 'thob pas des na bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su 'du shes dgos la/ tshul de lta bu yang 'du shes gsum ldan du dgos pa ni/ gzhung las/ skum̐ gsum̐m rgyalam̐ ba'im̐ gtem̐r// zhes pas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas chos kyi skur 'du shes na rang nyid la rtogs pa mthar thug pa skye/ bla ma la longs skur 'du shes na 'dod pa'i don 'grub/ bla ma la sprul skur 'du shes na 'gro phan rgya chen po 'byung*/ bla ma la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor 'du shes na yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ gsang 'dus las/ sku gsung thugs gsang ba'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dngos grub ni slob dpon gyi lus dang ngag dang sems rdo rje la gnas so// zhes so// des na gzhung las/ rabam̐ gusam̐ zhes pas/ mos gus kyi gtso bo bla ma la dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor zhe thag pa snying khung rus pa'i gting nas 'du shes bskyed cing gdung shugs rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs dgos pa'i tshul yang gzhung las/ dbyeram̐ medam̐ ces pas/ zhing bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid du bsam la/ bsam pa rang byung lhan skyes kyi ye shes smra bsam brjod med yul las 'das pa de sems can thams cad kyi don du rtogs par 'dod pas/ dngos po rang gi lus longs spyod dge rtsa thams cad kyang sems can gyi don du bla ma la dbul zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa ste/ de ltar zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bla ma sgrub pa'o// de la yang bsgrub tshul ni gsum/ sprul pa'i sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/

chos kyi sku gsum mo// dang po ni/ rang nyid sngar bshad pa ltar chos bzhi ldan gyi yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor gyad dang seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor 'od 'bar zhing dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa so sor g.yas su 'khyil ba mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par spras pa/ sku la dar dmar gyi sham thabs dang*/ dar ngur smrig gi snam sbyar gser gyi pa tras spras pa mnabs shing*/ zhal 'dzum dgyes pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa la/ rgya chen spyod brgyud/ zab mo lta brgyud/ nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa ste/ bka' phyag chu bo gsum 'dres kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsam la/ yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pas mchod la/ mos gus kyi gdung ba drag po dang bcas pas rigs kun ma sogs kyi gsol 'debs tshar bdun las mi nyung ba kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gdung ba drag po bskyed la gsol ba gdab/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams 'od phung gi rnam par gtso bo la thim zhing*/ gtso bo'i gnas bzhi nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser 'phros rang gi gnas bzhir thim/ gnas skabs bzhi'i dri ma dag /dbang bzhi thob/ sku bzhi 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas par bsam zhing*/ mthar gtso bo yang 'od phung du gyur nas rang gi smin mtshams su thim par bsam pa'i ngang nas dmigs med kyi ngang du ngal gso'o// dbang bzhi rgyas par len na/

dpal ldan bla ma mtshan rnams kun rang bzhin/ sogs kyis dbang rer gsol gdab re byas na shin tu legs so// gnyis pa bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bsgrub pa ni/ rang yi dam gong ltar gsal ba'i snying khar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ kha dog dwangs shing 'od 'phro ba'i lte bar zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan la ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rnam pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku la zhing khams thams cad snang zhing zhing khams thams cad la skus khyab pa/ 'od dang 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol zhing*| zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra thor tshugs su bcings shing rin po che 'od 'bar ba'i phyag gdub zhabs gdub dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan dpung rgyan se mo do ska rag do shal la sogs pas rab tu brjid pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs kyis bklubs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa nges pa lnga dang ldan pa sku snang la rang bzhin med pa de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa de nyid la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams khrom tshogs pa ltar bskor nas bzhugs pa rnams kyi gnas gsum du'ang yi ge gsum gsal btab la/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi mtshan so so'i thog mar oṃ āḥdang mthar ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ btags pa mtshan yang legs sbyar gyis bcings pa'i bzlas pa stong phrag las mi nyung ba'i mthar oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dhṛka trai lokya nā tha rat+na shrī mū la gu ru ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes pa thun rer khri phrag las mi nyung ba bzlas shing*| mtshan sngags bzla ba'i tshe gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su gyur/

'od zer de dag tshur 'dus bla ma gtso 'khor gyi gnas gsum du thim/ khams gsum de dag 'od kyis gang bar dmigs la bzla'o// mthar 'khor rnams 'od du zhu nas gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo yang 'od phung du gyur pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du gyur par bsam pa'i ngang du dar cig mnyam par bzhag go// gsum pa chos kyi skur bsgrub pa ni/ rang byung lhan skyes ye shes rang gi sems dang bla ma'i thugs dbyer med gcig tu song ba zhig ma gtogs gzhan gang gis kyang mi rtogs pa yin/ de yang rang dang bla ma gcig tu gyur pa de gang la zer na/ mi gnyis sems mthun pa'i snying nye ba lta bu la mi zer/ rang gi sems phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i dri ma dang bral ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gter bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa de dang rang gi sems gcig tu gyur pa de la dus mtha'i mos gus zer ba yin/ bla ma'i thugs smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i phyir tshig dang yig ge'i ris su bris pa'i gdams ngag cung zad tsam la zab zab mor 'dzin pa rnams zab pa min/ rang gi sems nyid smra bsam brjod 'das gshis sam babs kyis gnas pa de bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med du rtogs pa'i dus na bla ma dam pa dang gcig tu gyur pa yin no// de ltar bla sgrub byed pa'i tshe sgom pa'i gnas ni/ gzhung las/ gnasam̐ gsum̐m brtanam̐ param̐ bzhugam̐s// zhes pas tshogs rdzogs par 'dod na 'og min gyi gnas su sgom zhes pas spyi bor bsgom/ sems nyid kyi don rtogs par 'dod na mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du sgom zhes pas snying khar bsgom/ skyon dag par 'dod na yum chen mo'i gnas su sgom zhes pas lte bar bsgom pa'i don yin la/

de yang snga ma gnyis ni gong du bla ma sprul longs kyi sgrub pa'i dus bstan zin la/ phyi ma ni gegs sel tsam ma gtogs mi dgos pas re zhig ma spros so// bla ma la mos gus ma byas pa'i skyon ni/ gzhung las/ mim̐g medam̐ ces pas/ tshul khrims dang thos pa gtong ba la sogs pa'i chos du mas phyug kyang bla ma la mos gus med na bde ba chen po sems kyi rdo rje lta ba'i mig dang mi ldan par 'gyur te/ gsang 'dus las/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med na srid thar min// zhes so// mos gus byas pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhung las/ migam̐ ldanam̐ rnamam̐ grolam̐ sangam̐s rgyasam̐ 'gyuram̐// zhes pas bla ma la mos gus bcos ma min pa skyes pas ni zab mo sems kyi rdo rje lta ba'i shes rab kyi mig dang ldan zhing*/ srid pa'i nyes 'ching las grol nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ rim lnga las/ ri dbang rtse nas gang zhig lhung gyur na// lhung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur// bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na// grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur// zhes so// de ltar mos gus dang ldan pas/ ༈ /spyi don bzhi pa don gyi snying po gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ gzhung las| gdodam̐ nasam̐ mam̐ skyesam̐ mkham̐' ltaram̐ 'dusam̐ mam̐ byasam̐// zhes pas 'khor 'das thams cad rang gi sems yin la sems de yang gdod ma nas ma skyes pa/ skye ba med pa nam mkha' lta bur thams cad la khyab cing 'dus ma byas rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal stong pa nyid de phyag rgya chen po zhes tha snyad du btags pa tsam ste/ gsang 'dus las/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med cing*// chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par spangs// bdag med chos la kun tu 'byung*// byang chub tshul 'di bstan pa'o// zhes so// de'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ gzhung las/ khyabam̐ dngam̐ rdom̐ rjem̐ mim̐ 'gyuram̐ thamam̐s cadam̐ gnasam̐// zhes pas 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab cing gzhan gang gis kyang gzhom gzhig dang bral ba 'gyur ba med cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnas pa ste/

ye shes grub pa las/ khyab dang rdo rje sku nyid dang*// mi 'gyur dus ni thams cad pa'o// zhes so// de la dbye ba ni/ gzhung las/ rnamam̐ dgam̐ ces pas mnyam bzhag la ltos nas 'od gsal zhes brjod la/ rgyu mtshan ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ni rang sems las logs su gyur pa med la/ de'i rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba ste/ bdag med pas dris pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems ni 'od gsal ba// rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu bsgom/ */zhes pas sems nyid phyag rgya chen po ni gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa 'od gsal ba don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o// de yang mnyam rjes ro gcig pa'i tshul ni/ gzhung las/ zungam̐ 'jugam̐ ces pas 'khor 'das kun rdzob don dam mnyam bzhag rjes thob sogs gnyis su 'dzin pa thams cad gnyis su med par rtogs pa la zung du 'jug pa zhes bya ste/ rim lnga las/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// rtog pa gnyis po spangs pas na| |gang du dngos po gcig gyur pas// zung du 'jug ces de la bshad// ces so// mtshan don gzhung las/ phyagam̐ rgyam̐ chenam̐ pom̐'i dom̐n// zhes pas mi 'da' ba'i don gyis na phyag rgya yin la/ de nyid kyi gong na rtogs bya gzhan med pas chen po zhes brjod de/ gsang 'dus las/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni// phyag rgya chen po'i don bshad pa// cho ga bzhin du don bsgom na// skad cig gis ni sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes so// de ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba dam pa phyag rgya chen po de rtogs pa'i thabs gang zhe na/ dgyes rdor las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla mas dus thabs bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ byang chub sems ni don dam zhes bya ba// skal bzang slob ma bzang po'i man ngag thob// thal mo sbyar nas me tog 'dzin pa yis// bla ma las ni slar yang blang bar bya//

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i don dam phyag rgya chen po sems kyi rdo rje rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i thabs ni gzhan gang yang med de/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i myong ba khyad par can gyis sna khrid cing gdams pa bstan pa dag rang gis nyams su blang na rtogs kyi gzhan ni rtogs pa'i thabs med pa'i phyir/ de la thabs khyad par can bka' brgyud gong ma'i grub thob bka' drin can rnams kyi myong khrid zhal nas zhal/ snyan nas snyan/ thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa'i gdams pa kha mkhas dang rtog ge dpyad sgom yin rlom zol zog sogs bsre lhad kyi dbang gis mi bar khyis ma chod pa'i gdams pa lag len dmar khrid du gdab pa la/ sngon chad phyag chen gyi myong ba gnas 'gyu go brag med pa zhig yin la/ sngar bshad pa'i dmigs pa rnams kyi mjug rnams su sems ma bcos par lhod de ci gnas re 'jog tu bcug la gnas shas che chung nyams tshad bya'o// de nas sems dngos po'i gnas lugs ston par byed pa la gnyis/ khrid rim dang ngo sprod pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ zhi gnas khyad par can sgrub pa dang*/ lhag mthong gi sgo nas 'khrid pa'o// dang po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas thabs skyon med kyi zhi gnas sgrub pa sems 'dzin pa la gnyis/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med do/ dang po la gnyis*/ rten can dang rten med do// dang po ni/ thun bzhi'am drug tu bcad pa'i thun 'gor sngar bshad pa'i sgom rim rnams thun chung ma chag pa tsam re byas rjes/ bde ba'i stan rgyab cung zad mtho ba la/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung ngam mi nus na sems skyil/ lag pa lte 'og tu mnyam bzhag bca'/ sgal tshig bsrang*/ mgrin pa gug /lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtser gtad/ so dang mchu bde bar bzhag /dbugs 'byung 'jug zo glod la nyin mo mdun du shing bu'am rde'u sogs kyi dmigs rten dkar mdangs can min pa zhig la sems mig gtad/

de nyid la btsir 'dzin dang kha dog dang dbyibs sogs la brtag dpyad kyang mi bya/ yang rnam rtog 'gyu ba phra mo sogs kyang mi bya bar dmigs rten de nyid la sems ci gnas su gtad la bzhag /der sems ci yang mi bsam pa'i rtog med du hu re ba mtshan mo rang gi smin mtshams su thig le dkar po sran ma tsam dang*/ yang res rang gi 'og tu thig le nag po sran ma tsam la sngar ltar sems 'dzin/ des bying rmugs kyang sel bar 'gyur ro// gnas cha rnyed na gnas bzhin pa'i ngang la shigs kyis bshig la cung zad ngal gso zhing*/ slar thun chung la grang mang bar bya/ thun bar du ltad mo blta ba dang*/ spyod lam drag po dang*/ smra ba mang po spangs shing lus sems dal bar bya'o// gnyis pa rten med la gnyis/ rlung can dang rlung med do// dang po ni/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la gtad de sgom zhing*/ de yang dang por khug pa gsum tsam dang mthar bdun sogs ci rigs la sems gzung*/ 'tshub na skabs su ngal gso/ de nas rlung ro gsum mam dgu sogs sangs kyis bus rjes rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi bum pa can 'dzin du bcug la de'i ring sems ma 'phros par sim mer bzhag /mi thub na rlung sna nas dal bus btang zhing slar bzung la bslab/ ngal na rlung sna bug nas ci bder 'gro 'ong byed bcug cing*/ sems ma yeng bar gnas su bcug /de ltar byas pas sems rgod na bsgrims pa'i skyon yin pas cung zad glod/ sems yun na dub pa'i skyon yin pas zhag re tsam khams seng bya/ mgo 'khor ba dang sems yer na rlung gis bskyed pas bza' btung bcud chen bsten la bsku mnye bya/ don du thabs du mas sems gnas cha rnyed pa la 'bad do// yang sems 'gyu ba mang zhing gnas cha chung ba ltar la rnam rtog 'phros pa thams cad gcig skyes gnyis skyes rig cing 'phrig tshud na/ gnas cha cung zad yin pas skyon du mi blta bar rtog pa sna mi bskyil zhing rjes kyang mi 'brang bar rang babs su bzhag pas gnas pa 'char/

yang sems 'phro ba dang gnas pa gang yang ma rig par 'phrig ma tshud na/ 'bod sgrogs dang bred sngangs lta bu'i dus kyi rtog pa rgyun chad phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar gyi shes pa de la bltas pas der 'dzin med pa de gnas cha yin zhing*/ de'i ngang nas 'gyu ba thol skyes su 'phro ba rnam rtog yin tshul sogs brda sprad la/ grim lhod res 'jog sogs thabs du ma'i sgo nas 'khrid mkhas byas la 'phrig tshud tu bcug nas sbyangs pas gnas cha rnyed par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rlung med ni/ de ltar sems cung zad gnas pa'i tshe/ lus gnad sngar ltar byas la phyi rol gyi gzugs la sogs pa'i yul snang la mi 'phro zhing 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi rtog pa la bcos lhad dang dgag sgrub mi byed par rang babs su lhod de ci gnas su bzhag / gnas bzhin du shigs la bshig nas sngar bzhin bya/ yun thung la grangs mang bar bya'o// gnas pa 'tshol ba'i tshe grim drag na 'phro rgod mang bas phal cher zo glod pa gnad zab/ de ltar bzhag pas sems rgod na dro sar bsdad zas bcud bsten bsku mnye bya/ rmugs na yul khyad par can la phyag dang skor ba dang bshags sdom bya/ ting nge 'dzin skye bar gsol ba btab/ 'di sems zin pa'i brtan byed yin pas gnas cha rnyed nas rten med gtad med du 'jog pa la bde bar ma byang tshe/ mtshan med la sogs mi 'byung bas byang bar bslab/ 'di'i tshe zhi gnas ting po dran rig med pa nag thom du song ba ni bstan bcos rab dbye nas bshad pa'i go 'phang gsum thob la nye ba'i skyon shin tu che bas rig pa hur phyung la thun chung la grangs mang bar bslab| yang dran rig yod tsam la gsal po min pa skyon yin yang*/ shugs kyis dag sla bas re zhig gnas cha kho na la bslab/ yang na sems la cung zad ngar bskyed pas kyang de las grol lo// gnyis pa mtshan med la gnyis/ sgrim pa dang glod pa'o// dang po ni/

lus gnad gong ltar la lta stangs thad kar bzhag /sems ngar bskyed skad cig kyang ma yeng bar bsgom/ de yang dmigs gtad med par sems ma bcos par ye re seng nge ba bsgom/ yud tsam nas bshig la slar bsgrims te bsgom mo// de lta bu'i sngar gyi gnas pa snyom me ba de grung sang gis song nas dran rig ye re 'dug na bogs thon pa yin/ rgod pa'i rigs la gsal cha thon nas gnas cha ma byung yang skyon du ma bltas par thun chung grangs mang bsgoms pas gnas pa grung po 'phel lo// gnyis pa ni/ lus gnad snga ma ltar la gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa med par lhod glod la/ dgag sgrub bzo bcos med par rang babs su bzhag /de'i ngang nas ma yeng tsam gyi dran rtsis bzung ba de yang pur pur du ma song ba'i dran pa rlabs che ba yangs sang nge bas bskyang*/ de'i tshe rtog pa rags pa shar na dgag sgrub med par ma yeng bar dran pas gzung*/ 'gyu ba phra mo la yang dgag sgrub mi bya/ ngal gso zhing bskyang*/ de'i tshe sngar rtog pa bkag pa ltar byas nas rig pa ye re bar sems sgrim dgos pa'i tshe mi bde zhing*/ 'dir ma yeng tsam gyi ngang nas rang lugs su bzhag /rtog pa gang shar la dgag sgrub mi bya zhing de nyid gnas par 'char la/ dran pa la zhe 'dod mi dgos par gu yangs pa lta bu 'byung ba dang*/ glod dus lhod kyis gnas shing gnas pa'i mtshang rig nas skyong bde na bogs thon pa yin no// gal te 'gyu bar yengs pa dang 'gyu ba ngos ma zin pa sogs ni dran pa stobs chung ba yin la/ bying na dran rig la ngar bskyed/ rgod na sems ngar cung zad glod la bskyang*/ 'dir rkang ma tshud na sgom 'phel 'grib can 'ong bas rkang tshud par bya/ de yang dang po rnam rtog phra rags mang po 'khrugs shing bar na mi rtog par gnas cha cung zad rnyed pa de gcong rong gi 'bab chu dang 'dra ba gnas pa dang po'o// de nas rnam rtog phal cher rang sar zhi nas bde cham me ba la 'on kyang rnam rtog gi g.yo ba drag po byung na mi non par skabs su 'phro rgod byung ba ni chu bo dal zhing g.yo ba lta bu gnas pa gnyis pa/

de nas rnam rtog phra rags mi ldang bar mi rtog pa'i ngang du ci tsam bzhag kyang gnas shing*/ rnam rtog phra mo ldang yang des rtog pa'i bya ba mi nus par mi rtog pa'i ngang du rang sar dag pa ni chu ma bu 'dres pa lta bu zhi gnas gsum pa mthar thug pa'o// zhi gnas 'di phyag chen gyi sgom ngo bo'i go mi chod kyang sgom gyi gzhi gal che zhing rnam dkar gyi las gsog pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs khyad par can yin pa'i phyir bshad ma thag pa ltar skyon med kyi zhi gnas brtan po bsgrub par bya'o// gnyis pa bdag med rtogs pa'i thabs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhag mthong gi sgo nas 'khrid pa la gnyis/ sems snang sna tshogs gtan la dbab pa dang*/ gzhi rtsa la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'o/ dang po la gnyis/ sems kyi ngo bo gtan la 'bebs pa dang*/ de'i rtsal rnam rtog dang snang ba'i ngo bo gtan la 'bebs pa'o// dang po ni/ lus gnad sngar ltar la mig tshag btsum g.yo 'gul med pa ha rer bltas la// shes pa gsal zhing mi rtog par sngar skyes pa'i zhi gnas la mnyam par bzhag /de'i ngang nas sems de nyid la rjen lhang gis bltas la dbyibs dang kha dog sogs ji lta bu zhig 'dug /gnas dang rten gang la gnas/ ngos bzung dang rnam 'gyur ji ltar 'dug rim par brtags shing dpyad/ de yang zlum po sogs dang sa rdo ri brag gi rnam pa dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gzugs su 'dug gam/ kha dog kyang dkar po sogs su e 'dug rdo rus 'phrod par brtag /de bzhin du phyi rol snod bcud la gnas sam nang lus la gnas/ lus la gnas na spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar lus kyi gnas so sor ram phyi nang spyi khyab tu gnas/ spyi khyab tu gnas na 'dres pa'i tshul lam phyi nang gi tshul du gnas/ 'dres na sems phyi'i yul la 'phro ba'i tshe ji ltar so sor brtag /de bzhin du sems kyi ngo bo stong pa'i ngos bzung du 'dug gam gsal ba'i ngos bzung du 'dug

/stong par 'dug na cang med pa'i stong pa'am nam mkha' lta bur 'dug brtag |gsal bar 'dug na nyi zla mar me la sogs pa'i 'od ltar gsal bar 'dug gam kha dog med pa rang gsal du 'dug brtag /'di rnams la rdo rus thug pa kho thag chod pa zhig ma byung na thos blo dang yin rlom go yul du dpyad pa tsam la bzhag pas phu thag mi chod pas legs par gcun la bltar bcug go// de ltar bltas pa la dri rtsad byas la log shes dang go yul dpe mthong ngag sgros kyi rjes su 'brangs nas 'chad pa 'dug na gnod byed kyi rig pa btang nas sun phyung zhing slar brtag tu bcug /dbyibs dang kha dog gnas sogs med par shes pa ni blo'i ngo bo dang ngos bzung gsal stong gi ngang du lhan ner gnas pa zhig tu go na gnas nyams kyi 'phrig ma tshud pas maṇ+ḍal dang*/ gsol 'debs la 'bad cing gsal lugs stong lugs gnas lugs sogs re re nas brdar sha bcad la ltar bcug /dngos rdzas su ma grub pa'i gnas dang rten dang kha dog med cing*/ 'di 'dra 'di min gyi ngos bzung med par gsal stong lta bu'i brjod mi tshugs pa zhig la myong rgyu yod pa zhig tu go na slar mgo g.yog nas de yang min pa ltar gcun pa'i go ba'am rna thos sam dpyad sgom yin na rtsad bcad pas mtshang rdol zhing brtag mi thub la/ myong ba yin na zer lugs mi shes kyang go don thigs gcig tu mi nor bar song te de byung na myong ba skyes pa yin no// 'di'i tshe smra mkhas kyang myong ba med pa dang*/ smra mi shes kyang myong ba skyes pa 'ong bas legs par brtags nas bla mas myong thog nas 'khrid cing phu thag bcad/ don gyi ngo bo zhi gnas gsal sing nge ba de la mi rtog pa'i ngang nas sems rjen lhang gis bltas pas tshig gis brjod par mi nus la/ shes pa ngos bzung med bzhin du rang rig gsal stong seng nge ye re hrig ge ba lta bu de la ma yeng bar skyong du bcug go// gnyis pa ni lus gnad sngar ltar la/

ngos bzung med pa'i sems gsal stong gi ngang nas nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa rags shing ngar che ba zhig 'gyur bcug la/ de lhang gis skyes pa dang de la gcer gyis bltas nas dbyibs dang kha dog la brten nas ngos bzung rnam 'gyur sogs la sngar ltar brtags shing dpyad/ de bzhin du rnam rtog phra mo shar ba'am spros la gong ltar brtag /de bzhin du snod bcud dgra gnyen skyid sdug la sogs pa'i snang ba'i 'char sgo dpag tu med pa shar ram 'char du bcug la gong ltar brtag dpyad bya/ de yang sngar ltar ngos bzung ma byung ba'i rigs 'gres ma brtag na myong ba phra zhib can mi 'byung*/ de yang 'gyu snang phra rags la ngos bzung med par go ba tsam las thug 'phrad ngo shes pa lta bu'am| rdzun phug rdib pa lta bur grol ba'i myong ba rgyun brtan po mi 'ong bas snying rus bskyed la kho thag chod par brtag dpyad byed dgos so// de nas nyams la bltas pas/ rtog pa'i 'char sgo rnams brtag pa'i tshe ngos bzung mi 'dug cing sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong de gar song zhes pa'i go yul tsam zer na/ gsal stong zhes pa'i tshig ris tsam la yid brtan med pas/ rnam rtog de 'gags nas gsal stong du 'dug gam/ rnam rtog yod bzhin du ni gsal ba yin du chug kyang stong pa'i don med do zhes gcun la bltar bcug pas rnam rtog gang shar de'i 'char sgo ma 'gag par gsal bzhin du rtog pa'i bya ba mi byed par ngos bzung rgyu med pa zhig dang*/ snang ba yang snang cha ma 'gag par snang tsam la a 'thas bden 'dzin med par brjod yul las 'das pa zhig tu go na myong ba skyes pa yin no// de lta bu'i gsal la ngos bzung med pa'i gsal stong*/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i snang stong la sogs pa de nyid kyi don la ma yeng bar skyong du bcug /'dir sgom chen pa kha cig gis 'gyu ba la gnyen pos bslebs pas 'gyu ba de zhig nas gsal stong du 'gro zer ba ni rtog pa dang snang ba zung 'jug tu gtan la ma phebs pa ste gyi na'i sgom chen no// gnyis pa la bzhi/

rnam rtog sems su thag bcad/ snang ba'ang sems su thag bcad/ sems gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba bcad/ gang shar skye med du thag bcad pa'o// dang po ni/ lus gnad sogs sngar ltar la/ sems gsal stong gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag la de'i ngang nas rnam rtog gcig 'phros sam spros la/ de la bltas te rgyu'am gzhi ci la brten nas byung legs par brtag /sems gsal stong gi ngang de nyid las byung snyam na/ ma las bu skyes pa ltar byung ngam nyi ma las 'od 'phro ba ltar ram sems de rnam rtog rang du song ngam tshul ji ltar brtag /de'ang zhe sdang gi rnam par snang na zhe sdang de nyid kun dkris drag po bden 'dzin dang bcas par snang ngam/ zhe sdang lta bu'i rnam pa tsam la ngo bo ngos bzung rgyu med du snang sogs legs par blta/ mthar ji ltar song bltas la rtog pa de bkag gam sangs/ bkag na sus bkag /rkyen gang gis bkag /sangs na rkyen gyis sangs sam/ rang sangs la song brtag /de bzhin du rnam rtog phra rags thams cad la gong ltar brtag dpyad bya'o// de la log shes 'dug na gnod byed btang zhing phyogs tsam bstan la slar brtag tu bcug /'di na 'di bzhin byung dang dbyibs rnam 'gyur 'dir gnas sogs tha ma 'dir song ma rnyed kyang don du rnam rtog dang sems tha dad phyi nang gnyis 'dzin gyi blo zhig nas rnam rtog sna tshogs pa rnam pa cir snang ngo bo ngos bzung med pa snang stong rang shar rang grol du rig nas sems kyi go ma 'gag pas sems rnam rtog rang du shar ba'am/ der snang ba tsam du nges nas rnam rtog dang sems dbyer med du thag bcad dgos la/ dper na chu rlabs ltar rnam rtog dang sems kyang rnam rtog shar tsam nyid nas ngos bzung med pa'i sems gsal stong las ma 'das shing*/ sems kyang 'char sgo ma 'gag pa'i rnam rtog sna tshogs par shar ba der shar yang ngo bo ngos bzung med pa'i sems gsal stong las ma g.yos par kho thag chod na/

rnam rtog sna tshogs pa sems su nges pa'i myong ba thon dgos shing*/ de bzhin skyid sdug gi rtog pa spros nas de nyid la khyad ci 'dug lta ba sogs rgyab bsnol gyi rtog pa yang yang thag chod par bya'o// gnyis pa ni lus gnad sngar ltar la/ sems gsal stong gi ngang nas/ gzugs snang gang rung zhig lam gyis 'char du bcug pa la bltas nas/ de'i byung gnas 'gro gsum la gong ltar brtag /gzugs snang de dang sems gnyis tha dad du snang ngam gcig du 'dug tha dad na phan tshun phyi nang steng 'og lta bur 'dug gam de ltar 'dug na rang tshugs thub pa'i ngo bo so sor grub pa 'dug gam der snang ba tsam du 'dug /sems der snang ba tsam las sems gcig las med par tha dad du 'gag par brtag /gzugs snang dang sems gcig na sems gzugs snang du song nas gcig gam gzugs snang sems du song nas gcig sogs brtag tu bcug /de la log shes 'dug na skyon btang zhing phyogs tsam bstan la/ gzugs snang thams cad sems kyi snang cha tsam du nges nas gzugs snang sna tshogs par snang yang ngo bo ngos bzung du ma grub par snang stong du myong zhing*/ sems kyi rtsal ma 'gag pas gzugs snang tsam du rig nas gzugs snang phyir ma lus/ sems nang du ma lus par snang sems dbyer med du thag chod dgos la/ dper na rmi lam gyi gzugs ni rmi lam gyi shes pa las ma 'das shing rmi lam gyi gzugs dang rmi lam gyi shes pa dbyer med pa lta bu'o// de yang gnas skabs su spyi mthun gyi las la grub pa yul rkyen gyi so sor sna tshogs pa snang ba ni| dper na shel dwangs pa zhig yul rkyen sngon po sogs kha dog sna tshogs su snang ba tsam las ngo bo shel dwangs pa la 'gyur ba med pa lta bu go ma 'gag pa'i sems las rtsal yul rkyen sna tshogs dang 'phrad na sna tshogs su snang tsam las ngo bo sems las gzhan du ma song bar thag chod nas snang ba sna tshogs sems su nges pa'i myong ba thon dgos so// de bzhin du mdzes mi mdzes sogs rgyab 'gal gyi snang ba gong ltar brtags nas/

gzugs kyis mtshon nas sgra grags stong*/ dri tshor stong*/ ro myong stong*/ reg bya reg stong sogs su nges pa rnyed pa go yul du ma lus pa gal che'o// gsum pa ni/ lus gnad gong ltar la/ sems gsal stong gi ngang du lhan ne gnas su bcug ste de la gcer gyis bltas nas brtag |yang gnas pa'i ngang nas 'gyu ba zhig 'gyur bcug te de la brtag /de nas gnas pa dang 'gyu ba'i byung gnas 'gro gsum ngo bo ngos bzung gi khyad par ci 'dug brtag /lhan ner gnas pa dang yer gyis 'gyu ba'i khyad par 'dug na/ de gnyis rang la bzang ngan dang stong mi stong dang ngo bor grub ma grub ngos bzung yod med sogs khyad par ci 'dug blta/ khyad par mi 'dug na gcig nas khyad par med dam tha dad kyang mtshungs nas khyad par med brtag /gcig na thog mtha' bar gsum gang du gcig brtag /mtshungs na ji ltar mtshungs la sogs pa brtag dpyad byed du bcug /log shes 'dug na skyon btang zhing sun phyung la zur tsam bstan/ lhan ner gnas na dang yer gyis 'gyu ba gnyis tha dad du 'dzin pa las log ste/ gnyis ka sems nyid gcig pu rtsa bral ngos bzung med par rang rig rang dag gsal stong ngo bo gcig par myong nas/ de gnyis gang byung yang dgag sgrub spang blang mi dgos par gnas na gnas thog 'gyu na 'gyu thog tu gsal stong rang grol du nges shes bskyed dgos pa yin no// bzhi pa ni/ lus gnad sngar ltar la/ sems gsal stong gi ngang nas rnam rtog dang snang ba sna tshogs ni sems 'di ga ma 'gag pa'i rtsal du 'dug /de ni sems 'di ga'i rang babs sam rang shes de ci lta bu zhig 'dug gcer gyis bltas la/ 'di'i rgyu gang las byung*/ tshul ji ltar gnas/ mthar ci 'drar song legs par bltar bcug /log shes 'dug na mtha' dgag cing phyogs bstan la slar brtag tu bcug /sems dang po rgyu rkyen las ma byung gzhi gang nas kyang ma skyes ye nas rtsa bral/

'phral gyi dbyibs rnam 'gyur sogs gang du yang mi gnas shing ngos bzung med par mthar sus kyang bkag pa med par rang sangs rang dag rang grol lta bur 'dug pa myong ste/ gdod ma nas skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi ngo bo ngos bzung med par rang rig stong pa nyid yin pa'i yin lugs gang shar gyi sems la bzang pos rgyan mi 'dzugs ngan pas sbag mi tshugs pas bcos bslad dang 'phri snon mi dgos par rang dag rang rig rang grol du thag chod pa zhig dgos so// de ltar lhag mthong gi lta rtogs dang gzhig grol thams cad lus gnad dang sems gsal stong mnyam bzhag gi steng nas brtags shing dpyad na lhag mthong gi shes rab kyis myong la rtog btags kyi blos dpyad na don spyi tsam rtogs srid kyang myong ba mi thon no// 'di la nges shes thag chod ma skyes na ngo sprad kyang phyis mi 'phel zhing gzhan la 'jug pa'i snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms kyang zhi gnas tsam po ba'i thog tu 'khaur nas nyams la zhen pas lo mang por 'bad kyang chos sku'i lag rjes 'jog mi nus so// de yang rab rtogs pa thob pa/ 'bring myong ba skyes pa/ tha mas kyang go ba brtan po thob pa zhes zer na'ang snga ma gnyis ma gtogs go ba brtan pos skabs 'dir go mi chod do// 'di'i skabs su slob ma 'chad mkhas kyang myong ba ma skyes pa dang*/ myong ba skyes kyang 'chad mi shes pa 'ong srid pas bla mas mtha' gcun zhing phyogs ston pa'i sgo nas 'khrid mkhas dang mgo g.yog la dri mkhas bya/ myong ba dga' rab skyes 'dug na'ang kha yang gi ngo sprod bya shor du song ba ye mi bya/ kha cig zhi lhag zung 'jug gi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la ma skyes par gnas cha tsam la brten nas rnal 'byor bzhi'i ngo sprod byed pa mthong ba ni shin tu nongs so| |yang lhag mthong la myong ba gtan mi skye na re zhig zhi gnas de nyid gsal rig thon pa skyong du bcug la skabs shig na 'khrid pas don 'grub cing myong ba brtan po yong ba yang yod do| |gnyis pa ngo sprod pa'i rim pa la sgrub brgyud gong ma'i bzhed srol rnam grangs du mar 'dug kyang 'dir lhan skyes gsum ngo sprod pa'i khongs su thams cad 'du zhing 'khyer bde ba'i phyir/

de la'ang gnyis/ ngo sprod pa'i rim pa dngos dang*/ skyon bsal zhing sgom ngos bzung ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sems nyid lhan skyes/ rnam rtog lhan skyes/ snang ba lhan skyes gsum ngo sprod pa'o// dang po ni/ bla mas ngo sprod gdab pa'i tshe slob ma de ga min pa gzhan phag tu'ang mi bzhag par lus gnad sngar ltar byed du bcug nas/ khyod kyi sems ma bcos pa rang lugs su bzhag pa'i tshe rnam rtog phra rags thams cad rang sar zhi nas sems rang lugs su lhan gyis gnas pa zhig 'dug gam/ zhes ltar bcug de la zhi gnas zer ba yin/ de'i ngang nas sems rmugs pa dang*/ lung ma bstan 'chal bar ma song bar sems kyi ngo bo 'di 'dra zhes ngag tu smra mi tshugs par sems kyis bsam du med pa ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba gsal la ma 'gag pa rang gi rig pa'i shes pa dwangs seng nge ba myong rgyu med pa'i myong rgyu 'dra ba zhig 'dug gam mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas ltos dang zhes ltar bcug |de la lhag mthong zer ba yin/ de gnyis kyang brjod bya so sor byas kyang don du tha dad med par zhi gnas de yang ngos bzung med pa'i rang rig rang gsal gyi lhag mthong kho nar 'dug gam/ lhag mthong de yang rang lugs su gnas shing rnam rtog gi mtshan mas mi gos pa'i zhi gnas rang du 'dug gam mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas ltos dang zhes ltar bcug /de la zhi lhag zung 'brel zer/ de gnyis ka sems nyid skad cig ma'i thog tu tshang ba yin/ 'di myong nas ngo shes pa la sgom skyes pa zer/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa sems can gyi sems nyid skye med chos sku gshis babs kyi gnas lugs lhan skyes kyi sems gnyug ma'i shes pa phyag rgya chen po sogs ming gi rnam grangs mang zhing*/ bka' lung mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag thams cad kyang 'di'i thog tu gzhol zhing 'bab pa yin no// don dril na sems nyid rang babs su bzhag pas rtog pa rang sar grol nas ngos bzung med pa'i rang rig rang gsal gyi sems lhan skyes de'i ngang du rtse gcig ma yeng bar zhog cig
