/thun mtshams kyi spyod lam rnams su yang de'i dran pa ma yeng ba ci thub gyis la zhag 'ga' 'jur thon par bsgom pa gal che'o| |de min thabs sna tshogs kyis ngal ngal dub dub tu btsal ba'i sems ngo mthong ba 'di bor nyan shin tu che'o// zhes mgo g.yog gis sems gcun la zhag 'ga' la bsgom du bcug go| |gnyis pa ni/ sngar bzhin mdun du lus gnad byed du bcug la khyod rang sems rang babs su bzhag na rnam rtog zhi nas ngos bzung med pa'i sems gsal stong gi ngo bo la ma yeng bar gcer gyis ltos la/ de'i ngang nas dga' skyid lta bu'i rnam rtog ngar dang bcas pa zhig bskyed la de'i ngo bo la gsal stong gi ngang nas gcer gyis ltos/ rnam rtog de yang ngos bzung med pa'i gsal stong du 'dug gam/ sems nyid lhan skyes kyi ngo bo dang khyad med de gar 'dug gam/ ltos dang zhes ltar gzhug gsal stong du 'dug khyad par mi snang zer yang rnam rtog de sangs nas gsal stong du 'dug gam/ rnam rtog de sgom gyi steng du tshur bzhag pas gsal stong du 'dug gam/ rnam rtog de ga gsal stong du 'dug dris pas/ snga ma gnyis ltar 'dug zer na sngar sgro 'dogs ma chod pa yin pas/ zhag 'ga' thag gcod du bcug /phyi ma ltar 'dug pa myong na rnam rtog gi ngo bo mthong ba yin pas ngo sprod pa ni| khyod kyis rnam rtog gi ngo bo la bltas pas rnam rtog sangs ma dgos tshur sgom la gcur ma dgos par rnam rtog de ga ngos bzung med par gsal stong du rjen ne 'dug pa de ka rnam rtog lhan skyes kyi ngo bo mthong ba'am/ rnam rtog chos skur shar ba zer/ sngar rnam rtog gi ngo bo gtan la phab dus dang gnas 'gyu'i rtsa ba bcad dus ltar ngos bzung med pa'i sems rang rig rang gsal gcig pu de min pa mang po med/ chu dang rlabs kyi dpe lta bu yin/ des na gnas 'gyu la khyad 'dug gam rtog pa dang mi rtog pa la khyad 'dug gam/

mi rtog pa lhan ner gnas pa la bzang rgyu'am dga' rgyu dang rnam rtog 'phros pa la ngan rgyu'am mi dga' ba dgos pa 'dug gam/ 'di'i mtshang ma rig na sgom gyi mu ge phog pa yin pas phyin chad rnam par rtog pa ma skyes na ma skyes pa'i ngang du skyong la ched du bskyed mi dgos/ skyes na skyes pa'i ngang du skyong ched du dgag mi dgos/ gnas 'gyu gnyis la nye ring ma byed/ rnam rtog 'dis rnam rtog thams cad la 'gre ba yin/ 'on kyang re zhig rnam rtog lam du 'khyer zhing rnam rtog ma skyes na'ang ched du spros la ngo bo skyong*/ de min rnam rtog gi ngo bo mthong bas 'dir shor dogs yod pas zhag 'ga' 'bungs la skyongs shig /ces bsgom zhing zhag 'ga' skyong du bcug go// gsum pa ni/ lus gnad gong ltar bcas la/ sems ngo bo mnyam bzhag gi steng nas ri'am khang khyim mi la sogs pa'i gzugs snang gang rung bkra lam pa 'char du bcug la/ shar ba de la gcer gyis bltas pa'i tshe gzugs su snang ba de dag ngos bzung med pa gsal stong du 'dug gam/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo gsal stong du 'dug de gnyis la khyad ci 'dug ltar bcug /khyad med par ngos bzung med pa'i gsal stong du 'dug zer yang*/ snang ba shar ba'i gzugs de 'gags nas gsal stong du 'dug gam/ gzugs de ga gsal stong du bsgoms pas gsal stong du 'dug /gzugs snang de ga gsal stong du 'dug dris pas/ snga ma gnyis ltar zer na slar bsgom du bcug la thag bcad/ phyi ma ltar gzugs kyi rnam pa de ga lam gyi snang ba snang cha ma 'gag par snang tsam la ngos bzung med par gsal stong du 'dug par myong na/ ngo sprod pa ni/ khyod kyi ri dang khang khyim lta bu'i snang ba bkra lam gyis shar ba'i tshe ji ltar snang ba'i snang cha de nyid yal ba'am bkag ma dgos par snang ba de nyid snang bzhin du ngos bzung med par gsal stong du 'dug pa de snang ba'i ngo bo mthong ba yin/

snang ba'i ngo bo lta dus dang sngar snang ba sems su thag bcad dus sgro 'dogs bcad pa ltar/ snang ba phyi na med/ sems nyid nang na med/ sems gsal stong de nyid snang bar shar ba ma gtogs gzhan med pas snang ba shar tsam nyid nas ngos bzung med pa'i snang stong rang grol nyid yin| snang la ngos bzung med pa'i snang stong du rjen lhang ba 'di ga snang ba lhan skyes kyi ngo mthong ba'am snang ba chos skur shar ba zer/ des na stong pa bzang rgyu med/ snang ba ngan rgyu med/ snang ba snang thog tu skyong ched du snang cha mi 'gog /stong na stong thog tu skyong ched du snang cha ma sgrub par gang shar sgom du 'khyer/ spang blang dang bcas bcos bya mi dgos/ nyams len gyi dran pas slebs na snang srid thams cad chos sku phyag rgya chen po yin pas da phyin chad snang stong la nye ring dang dgag sgrub med par skyongs/ 'on kyang re zhig snang ba'i 'char sgo gzugs la sogs pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'char du bcug la snang la ngos bzung med pa'i ngo bo skyong ba la ma yeng bar bya'o// zhes zhag 'ga' bsgom du bcug /ngo sprod 'di gsum la spro na lung 'dren tsam yang bya/ gzhan blo chung mgo 'khor ba'i dogs pas lung 'dren dang kha bshad gtso bor bya mi dgos/ nyams myong gi thog nas 'khrid pa gal che'o// gnyis pa sgom skyon bsal zhing sgom ngos bzung ba la/ nor sa dang sgom skyon bshad pa dang*/ sgom skyon med gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ sems gnas cha tsam gtso bor bzung ba'i snang ba'i gsal cha ci yang med par dgag pa ni/ zhi gnas ting po zhes shin tu skyon che la/ ma bgags kyang wal wal po gyur nas mi gsal ba ni ltem po zhes skyon can no/ gzhan yang tshor ba med pa'i dran med du 'dug pa ni/ lung ma bstan dang*/ rnam rtog snga ma 'gags phyi ma ma skyes kyi bar du shes pa had po la sgom du 'dzin pa lhag mthong gis ma zin pa dang*/

zin kyang phyag chen skyong ba de las ma g.yos par 'dod pa sgom gyi mu ge dang*/ sems bde lhan gyis gnas pa tsam la sgom du re ba lhag mthong gis ma zin pa dang*/ zin kyang 'char sgo 'gog cing ma 'gags kyang dgrar 'dzin pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi rtog pa gang yang yid la mi byed par stong pa kho nar sgom du 'dzin pa lhag mthong gis ma zin pa snang cha bkag pa'i skyon can dang*/ gang snang ci shar thams cad bden med kyi 'dzin stangs dang ma bral bar skyong ba'i dngos med du 'dzin pa dang*/ dran med snang ba thams cad la dgag sgrub mi bya ba btang snyoms su gnas pa tsam sogs 'di lta bu'i sgom rnams ni phyag chen gyi sgom du sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams mi bzhed la/ de dag so so'i skyon gyi 'bras bu ngan pa re re yod kyang 'dir yi ger 'jigs nas ma bris la/ gzhan yang sems gsal ba mi rtog pa la sgom du bzung na rtog pa rang sar zhi nas rig pa rang gsal ngos bzung med par sgom 'dra rung du yod kyang*/ mi rtog pa ci nas kyang dgos pa 'dod pas phyogs re ba tsam dang*/ rnam rtog 'phro ba'i tshe de'i 'phro bcad nas/ sems gsal la mi rtog par 'jog par 'dod pa'ang phyogs rer zad cing*/ de gnyis ka 'gyu ba dang snang cha gtan la ma phab pas spyi brtol tsam mo/ yang dran rig tu rer byas nas sems gsal stong kho na sgom du 'dzin pa de nyid sgom yin yang dran rig gang shar skyong ba rlabs che na lhug par 'jog pa med pas lhod cha med par ha cang sgrim thal ba'i phyogs re ba tsam mo// de ltar na sgom rnam dag yin min gyi gnad ma 'chug pa shin tu gal che zhing phyogs re ba tsam yar 'phel du 'gro ba'i yon tan yod kyang skyong ma bde na sgom dang sna sun byung dogs yod pas snang thog stong thog gnas thog 'gyu thog thams cad du grims lhod sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas brdar sha chod cing ngo 'phrod par skyong bde ba zhig dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/

tha mal gyi shes pa ma yeng ba la sgom zhes bzhed cing tha mal gyi shes pa ni sems kyi rang bzhin gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs ci 'dug de ga yin te/ de la spang blang dgag sgrub bcas bcos byas na tha mal gyi shes pa gshis sam babs su mi 'gro ba'i phyir ro// des na sems kyi rang babs ci 'dug ci snang ci shar de ga rang rig dran pas ma yeng bar skyong ba la sgom skyon med ces ming du btags so// blos bcos nas sgom rgyu spu tsam yang med do// de yang sgom rgyu rdul tsam med cing yeng du skad cig kyang mi 'jug pa/ tha mal gyi shes pa yeng med sogs bshad tshul mang yang don rang gi sems gshis babs skyong ba kho na'o// des na rang rig dran pas ma yeng bar sems gnas 'gyu gang ltar byed kyang de ga'i ngo bor rang babs su bsgom mo// 'gyu ba bkag nas stong par sgom pa ni thal tshabs can no// mdor na rang rig gi dran pa dang ldan na gnas 'gyu thams cad sgom yin la sems yengs na gang yang sgom min pas re zhig dran pa la rtsis su bya zhing*/ ji zhig na dran pa dang sems kyi ngo bo tha mi dad pas dran pa'i rang bzhin du gyur nas bde ba zhig 'ong ngo*// 'o na dang po nyid nas rtogs bya'i tha mal gyi shes pa ngo sprad na ngal ba chung zhing dgos pa che ba la zhi lhag nas rim gyis rtsol bcas kho na ni ngal ba don med do zhe na/ cig car ba'i las can kha cig tsam yang de lta bus chog pa srid kyang*/ gzhan phal cher rim gyis pa kho na mang bas khrid rim ltar dgos shing*/ khyad par du snang sems kyi rtsa ba la sgro 'dogs mi chod cing*/ ngo bo mthong ba'i myong ba dang bcas pas nges shes mi 'byung bas dran pa gzhan yod kyang rang gi dran pa med pas mi 'ong ngo*// tha mal gyi shes pa sems kyi gshis babs ma bcos pa gnyug ma'i sems zhes pa'i tshig don yang 'dir gnas la/ kha char bu yug chab rom ser ba 'bab chu la sogs pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po'i klong du ro gcig pa ltar lta ba rnam dag ston pa'i mdo rgyud dang*/

rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung rgyun dang*/ bsgom bya'i gnad thams cad kyang chos nyid 'di gcig pu'i steng du gzhol zhing 'bab pa kho nar nges so// de dag gi nyams len skyong tshul ni/ sgom skyong dgos tshul/ khyad par mnyam rjes su sgom skyong dgos tshul/ gegs dang shor sa dang gol sa bcad pa/ skye med du la bzlas te bogs byung ba/ lam 'khyer spyod pa'i sgo nas rtsal sbyang ba/ rtog pa 'char tshul bogs 'don dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni sgom skyes pas mi chog legs par skyong dgos/ de yang sgom skyes nas de nyid mi skyong zhing*/ bsags sbyang gzhan la 'bad pa ni/ rgyal pos 'bangs kyi bya ba byed pa dang seng ge khyi'i zlar song ba dang 'dra ste don med do// de yang zhen log sgom gyi rkang pa yin pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam zhing mi rtag cing snying po med pa gang gis kyang dgos pa med pa'i 'khri ba bcad la tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par bya/ mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo yin pas bla ma dang bka' brgyud yongs la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang ma bral zhing re ltos bcas nas gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ dran pa sgom gyi dngos gzhi yin pas thun gyi dus min gzhan du blos btang mi bya bar dus kun tu rang rig gi dran pa'i rgyang so dang ma bral bar bya/ snying rje sgom gyi phrin las yin pas sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom zhing skyabs 'og tu bcug /rang nyid sgom mthar ma phyin par gzhan don ltar snang bdud kyi bar chad du bzung la dben pa bsten/ khrel dang ngo tsha sgom gyi go cha yin pas nang rang sems dpang por bzhag cing phyi nang bla ma dkon mchog dang mched grogs kyis mi khrel tsam gyis tshig re'am 'dag sbyar smra bcad kho nas dus 'da' bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sgom sna zin nas rtse gcig chen po'i bar du/ mnyam rjes mtshan nyid pa med par bshad kyang sgom skyong ba la spyir rang rig dran pa ma yeng na thams cad sgom yin pas mnyam rjes ma 'dres par thun gyi dngos gzhi thams cad mnyam bzhag tu byas la ngo bo rtse gcig tu skyong*/

thun mtshams sogs rjes thob tu byas la rtog pa dang snang ba lam du 'khyer la ma yeng bar bya/ de yang ngo bo'i skyong thabs so ma rang thang lhug pa gsum zhes pa lus khong glod/ ngag rlung mi btsir/ sems gang la yang rten mi bca' zhing*/ rtsis gdab med pa'i so ma/ sems rang lugs ngos bzung med par ma yeng bar bzhag pas rang thang*/ dgag sgrub 'bad rtsol med par tshogs drug rang babs su bzhag pas lhug pa ste gnad gsum ldan de la yang nang tshan re rer gsum gsum du dbye bas dgu'am/ yang na rtsis gdab med par rang lugs so mar bzhag |dgag sgrub kyis ma bcos par rang thang du bzhag /rtsol sgrub mi bya ba lhug par bzhag ste gnad gsum ldan no// de yang nam mkha' ltar dpangs bstod de snang ba gu yangs seng*/ sa gzhi ltar rgya bskyed de dran pa khyab che ba/ ri bo ltar lhun phab la sems g.yo 'gul med pa/ mar me ltar gsal stong la rig pa gsal sing nge*/ man shel ltar dri ma spangs la shes pa rtog med du dwangs seng nge bzhag ste dpe lnga'am/ yang na sprin bral gyi nam mkha' sgrib g.yogs med pa ltar ngos bzung med par gu yangs sang nge*/ rlabs dang bral ba'i mtsho mi g.yo ba ltar rtog med du ma yeng bar lham me/ rlung gis mi bskyod pa'i mar me gsal 'grib med pa ltar gsal sang nge yer re bzhag pa ste dpe gsum ltar mnyam par bzhag go// de yang shes pa bying rgod kyis mnyam par bzhag mi bde na so so'i skyon gnad bcos la re zhig mdung bye khung du bcug pa ltar rtse gcig tu skyong dgos so// des skyo na thun mtshams sogs rjes thob thams cad du rang rig gi dran pa rgyun chags su byas te/ rnam rtog dang snang ba'i 'char sgo ci snang ci shar de ma yeng bar bskyang*/ rnam rtog tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad dgag mi dgos par rang rig gi dran pa gzhung bsrangs te/ gang shar ngos bzung med par lhug par bskyang ngo*/

de yang dus thams cad du ma yeng ba'i dran pa rgyun chags su brtan pa'i dang por sems yeng ba shas che na'ang rim gyis shugs 'byung rtsol med kyi dran pa 'phel te rtog pa dang snang ba phal cher gsal stong du lhang lhang 'char la/ cis kyang skyong dka' na mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas rtog snang gang rung 'char bcug la de'i ngo bo la blta ba sogs byas te gtan la phab nas gong ltar bskyang*/ mnyam rjes skyong tshul de ltar 'bad pas ci zhig na thams cad rang gi dran pas khyab ste rtog snang thams cad shar tsam nyid nas gsal stong ngos bzung med par 'char zhing*/ mnyam bzhag tu ngo bo rtse gcig tu skyong zhing rjes thob tu dran pas skyong ba gnyis ngo bo khyad med pa 'byung ngo*// bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams srab mthug sna tshogs 'byung mod kyang nyams dang 'grogs na gnas lugs la sgrib pa/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ skyon med kyi ting 'dzin gsum gyis khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu byed par gsungs pa'i phyir dran rig ngar bskyed hur phyung la yang yang shes pa nyams kyi rlan dang bral zhing so ma rjen pa bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams la ma shor bar byas te skyong ba gnad zab bo// gsum pa ni/ thos pa dman zhing bla ma bsten yun thung ba rnams shor gol 'byung nyen che ba'i phyir/ de'i dogs gcod cung zad brjod na/ stong nyid la shor sa bzhi yod pa'i dang po/ shes bya'i gshis la shor ba ni/ sgom rnam kun mchog ldan snang stong dbyer med kyi don ma go ba skyon yon gang yang med cing*/ bden par ma grub pa stong nyid du 'dod pas rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i ye shor/ sgom gyi ngo bo'i don bshad shes kyang rang gis nyams su ma myong ba'i 'phral shor gnyis so// gnyis pa lam du shor ba ni/ sgom lam 'bras dbyer med rang chas su yod pa ma rig par sgom la lam byas nas 'bras bu chos sku slar 'thob tu re ba'i ye shor dang*/

sgom ji lta ba rang la yod kyang de la blos mi khel bar de bas lhag pa logs su yod par re nas 'tshol zhing sgom la slar lhag po khan nas sgom pa phral shor gnyis| gsum pa gnyen por shor ba ni/ sgom spang gnyen dbyer med rang ngo rang rig gi spang bya nyid gnyen por 'char ba ma rig par spang bya nyon mongs dang gnyen po sgom so sor bzung ba ye shor dang*/ rnam rtog sogs rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ de bshigs nas slar sgom du 'jog pa'i 'phral shor gnyis/ bzhi pa rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/ sgom thabs shes dbyer med chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid du gnas pa ma rig par dmigs bcas la rang bzhin du ma grub pa rgyas 'debs pa ye shor dang*/ sgom lam du ma lhongs par phyi bsnyags byas la sgom yin snyam du rgyas 'debs pa'am snga ma ma nyan slar sgom snyam du rnam rtog sgom gyis bcad pa lta bu 'phral shor ro// de lta bu'i tshul gyis de 'dra gzhan yang shor sa mang du yod pas shor sa la las ngan song du 'gro zhing 'ga' zhig gis sgom la bogs mi thon pa'i blo dred can du 'gyur bas ma shor ba gal che'o/ gol sa ni spyir sgom bskyangs pas bde gsal mi rtogs pa'i nyams kyi bye brag mtha' yas pa 'char zhing*/ khyad par sgrub pa po'i rtsa thig rlung sogs bzang zhing rnam g.yeng dang le lo spangs nas sgom la brtson pa dag la nyams kyi rigs ngo mtshar zhing brjod kyis mi lang ba skye la/ sgom dang rnam g.yeng bsres nas sgom pa dag la nyams kyang bag re las mi 'byung ngo*/ de yang bde nyams la lus bde bas khyab cing*/ tsha grang gi reg pa yang bde bar 'char ba sogs lus ngag yid gsum la bde ba'i nyams nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa tsam gyi bde ba sna tshogs pa 'byung*/ gsal nyams sems dwangs shing snang ba thams cad gsal ba dang mtshan mo yang nye ring med par mthong ba sogs 'od gsal ba'i snang ba dpag tu med pa dang*/

khyad par gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes byed pa sogs sna tshogs 'byung*/ mi rtog pa'i nyams stong gzugs kyi rtags sna tshogs 'char ba thams cad la stong pa'i 'dzin stangs skye ba sogs dang stong pa'i nges shes sogs yin yin po mang po 'byung ngo*// bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum ga'i nyams phyogs re ba gang yin yang 'dra ste/ nyams de dag la mchog tu bzung nas nyams de byung na dga' la ma byung na mi dga' bar/ bskyang na bde bas 'dod khams/ gsal bas gzugs khams/ mi rtog pas gzugs med khams su gol bar bshad do// zhen 'dzin med kyang nyams la zhen pa'i sgom des ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal las ngal gso tsam ma gtogs rdzogs byang thob pa mi srid do// gzhan yang thos chung shes rab dman pa dag ngo bo gnyug ma skyong ba las log nas sgom phyogs re ba tsam dang gnas pa mthug po dang nyams wal wal dang gnyug ma rab rib can gyi khar 'khor ba 'ong bas/ des na gol sa 'ga' zhig gis ngan 'gror skye zhing gzhan dag gis kyang srid pa'i bde ba 'grub tsam las med do// de yang zhi gnas kyi nyams dang*/ lhag mthong gi nyams dang*/ rtogs pa'i rang nyams gsum yod pas phyi ma ni gol sar mi 'dzin la/ bar ma yang zhen med du sgom rang sor bskyangs pas nyams rang sar dag nas bogs thon la/ nyams bying can phal cher dang khyad par nyams snga ma ni dge sbyor na 'phar ba'i gegs kho nar 'gyur zhing gnas lugs la bsgribs pas thabs sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas nyams bshigs nas bsgom pa chod che ba yin no// bzhi pa skye med du la bzlas te bogs dbyung ba la lnga/ la bzla ba'i dus tshod dang*/ rtog pa dang snang ba rtsad gcod pa/ sgom dang sgom mkhan gyi sems rtsad gcod pa/ skye med zang thal du dpa' bo la dor ba/ mnyam rjes nyin mtshan du bsre ba'o// dang po ni/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams mthug po dag cing sems gsal dwangs thon nas/ gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu'i sgom khor yug tu song ba'am/

nyin snang shas cher khor yug tu 'gro zhing rtog pa 'gyu thog tu dran pas nam zin gsal stong sang nge*/ tshogs drug gi snang thog tu dran pas nam zin snang stong lhang lhang du 'char ba sogs rtog snang gi thog tu nges shes skyes pa'i tshe la dor bar bya'o| |la dor sngas na myong ba mi thon pas go yul la brten pa'i dred po kha bshad mkhan gcig 'byung ngo*// ha cang phyis na skal ba can nyams myong gi zhen 'dzin rang dag la song nas rtog pa khor yug tu grol ba mang yang*/ 'ga' zhig bzang rtog nges shes kyi 'dzin pa cher song nas dge sbyor la mtho dman sna tshogs 'byung ba yin no/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro spyi ltar dang*/ khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshe mos gus cher bskyed snang srid chos skur 'char bar gsol ba drag tu gdab/ ngo bo bzhag thabs sngar bshad pa ltar rtse gcig tu bzhag ste sems dwangs snyigs phyed pa dang*/ sems ma yeng ba'i gu yangs seng nge ba'i ngang nas rnam rtog phra ba zhig dang rags pa gcig spros te de'i ngo bo la bltas na rtog pa phra rags la khyad ci 'dug blta/ de dang sems gnas pa'i ngo bo la khyad ci 'dug blta/ de bzhin du bde sdug dang nyon mongs dug gsum gyi rtog pa mang po zhig la blta/ res rtog pa dgag |res mang du spro/ res bskyang 'ded bya ba sogs sna tshogs pa byas la blta/ yang phyi'i gzugs snang mdzes mi mdzes sogs la blta/ yang lus kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs dang mig 'byed 'dzum g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu blta ba sogs sna tshogs pa snang ba'i 'char sgo du ma 'char du bcug la khyad par ci 'dug blta/ de rnams dang sems kyi ngo bo la khyad ci 'dug ltar bcug la de 'dra ba zhag 'ga' byas nas thag chod kyi myong ba skyes pa dang sngar bshad pa ltar rnam rtog dang snang ba'i ngo sprod bskyar nas gsal btab la nges shes bskyed do// gsum pa ni| sgom gyi ngo bo skye 'gag ngos bzung med pa'i blo 'das yin snyam pa gcig pus mi chog sems ma yeng zhing gu yangs sang nge ba'i ngang nas sgom gyi ngo bo 'dzin med du lhang bltas la ci 'dra 'dug yang yang blta/

de bzhin du sgom mkhan gyi shes pa dang nga dang bdag 'dzin mkhan gyi shes pa la yang yang blta/ gzhan yang dus gsum gyi sems la khyad ci 'dug /'das pa'i sems gar song*/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems gang nas byung*/ da lta'i sems ji lta bu 'dug sogs blta zhing sgro 'dogs gcod du bcug la thag chod kyi myong ba skyes pa dang*/ bsgom bya'i yul dang sgom byed mkhan dang dus gsum gyi rtog pa thams cad kyang rgyud tha mi dad par ci yang 'char gang du yang ma grub pa'i sems 'di nyid yin la/ 'di yang ngo bo ngos bzung bzhag sa rten gnas skye 'gag gnas gsum dus gsum du dbye ba sogs sgro btags thams cad kyis ma gos pa/ gdod ma nas gzhi med rtsa bral 'khrul ma myong grol ma myong*/ skyon gyis gsang mi tshugs| yon tan gyis rgyan mi tshugs par rang byung rang dag zla med zang thal phyogs med rgya yan du ngo sprad la/ zhag 'ga' ched 'dzin med par rang babs su lhug par skyong du bcug pas nges shes thag chod skye/ gal te slob ma blo rtsal zhan na gong du bshad pa'i rtog snang sgom gyi ngo bo sgom mkhan dus gsum gyi shes pa rnams so sor phral la zhag mang du ltar bcug nas thag chod kyi nges shes thob nges bya ba gal che'o// bzhi pa ni/ bsgom bya sgom byed myang bya myong byed rtogs bya rtogs byed sogs kyi blo thams cad bor/ yin min gyi yid byed dang sgom 'dod dran 'dod sogs zhe 'dod thams cad btang*/ ci yang yid la mi byed snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang med par tha mal gyi shes pa bcos med rang ga ma de gar sdod lugs ci bde byas la 'dug /rang ga ma'i rnam rtog dang snang ba ci shar yang blos bcos bsgyur mi bya bar rang gar btang*/ yid byed kyi rjes su mi 'brang sems dum re yengs pa la skyon du mi bzung zhing brtag dpyad mi bya/ nam dran gyi tshe sgom rgyu myong rgyu byed rgyu gang yang med pa'i tha mal bcos med de gar bskyur/

za nyal 'chag gsum yang blo bral gyi ngang nas bya zhing gzhan bya ba gang yang mi bya/ gtor ma dang gsol 'debs nyung zad tsam re ma gtogs de min 'dus byas kyi dge sbyor thams cad bzhag la smra bcad bya/ nyal ba'i tshe yang bcos med zang mar nyal/ de ltar zhag 'ga'i bar du yid byed thams cad bor la rang gar 'dug tu bcug la nyams blta/ bzang zhen gyi 'dzin pa grol/ ngan rtog gi 'khrul ba zad nas thams cad sgom gyi rang bzhin du nges shes thag chod skyes na/ tha mal gyi sems gang 'dug ci shar skye 'gag med pa spang blang med pa bral thob med pa/ yeng ma yeng dran ma dran myong ma myong rtogs ma rtogs med par rang byung rang dag rang grol zang thal thams cad sgom gyi rang bzhin sgom gyi khor yug tu ngo sprad la/ zhag lnga tsam 'byams su bcug cing skabs rer tsam sgom min pa'i sems btsal du 'jug go| |lnga pa ni/ de ltar sgom khor yug des mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob bsre zhing*/ rjes thob tu dum re yengs na yang rjes shes dran pas nam zin gnas lugs de rig pas chog /de bzhin du nyin mo'i 'khor yug de mtshan mor bsre zhing gnyid dang rmi lam du lhong na mchog yin/ de min 'khrul ba'ang zad ma thag rjes la gnas lugs de rig pas chog /gzhan mtshan bcas dang yid byed gang yang mi bya bar zhag lnga re tsam bzhag /yang zhag re tsam gang bder ngal gso/ yang zhag bdun re bcu re tsam du la dor re dang ngal gso re spel la gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa des nyin par khor yug tu ma song bar du la dor/ nyin par khor yug tu song na mtshan mo rim gyis 'char bar nges so// la dor 'di la sgom 'khor yug gi man ngag kyang zer/ la bzla ba yang zer 'di ni spyir mnyam med dwags po'i gab pa mngon phyung gi dgongs pa yin la/ dgos rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi brnag pa dang gnas lugs rjen par gtan la dbab pa'i bogs 'don yin pas man ngag 'di ston pa skabs mtshams zos na gnyug ma bzang zhen can gyis lo mang du bgrod dgos pa'i rtogs pa zhag 'ga' la bgrod nus pa yin no// cis kyang bogs ma thon na re zhig mnyam rjes kyi dge sbyor skyong lugs sngar bzhin bya'o// lnga pa la bdun/

lam 'khyer gyi dus dang*/ spyod pa/ rnam rtog /nyon mongs/ lha 'dre/ sdug bsngal/ na tsha 'chi ba rnams lam du 'khyer ba'o/ dang po ni/ sgom ngo mthong gi rtogs pa shar nas tshe 'di'i snang shas la song ba dang*/ rkyen drag po dang 'phrad pa dang*/ rtog pa bag nyal ngo ma shes pa 'ong ba'i dus dang*/ mdor na dge sbyor rang shugs su lam du slong dka' ba'i khu 'phrig gi 'dzin rtog nam byung gi dus dang*/ dben pa'i gnas su sgom khor yug shar na de brtan cing bogs dbyung ba'i tshe gong gi rkyen khu 'phrig byung ba'i dus rnams su lam 'khyer bya dgos la/ gzhan du snang srid lam 'khyer gyi rgyal po blo bral phyag rgya chen po sgom pa dor nas blo can gnyen po can gyi phaṭ sgra dang dom ra rkang dung khyi lpags kyi smad g.yogs thod phor sogs thogs nas phyogs thams cad du bza' ba don du gnyer nas gcod yul zhes thams cad khyad du gsod pa'i snying stobs can de lta bu ni don min no// 'dir spyod pa bya ba'i dus ni mnyam rjes khor yug tu gyur nas bya'o// spyod pa ni sngags nas gsang spyod brtul zhugs phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa sogs he ru ka'i chas dang shes rab ma'i grogs dang bcas 'gro bar gsungs mod/ 'on kyang 'dir rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos bzhed pa'i sdom pa gsum ldan gyi rnal 'byor pas phyi 'dul ba dang nang gsang sngags zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rab byung gi bslab gzhi dang mi 'gal bar kun bzang gi spyod pa don mthun spyod pa'i tshe gnas ni ri bo'i rtse dang gnyan sa dang dur khrod dang shing gcig gi drung dang bzhi mdo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su smra bcad ku sā li'i mchod sbyin bya zhing*/ 'jig rten la blo mi 'jug pa ri dwags rmas ma lta bu'i spyod pa/ ci byung yang nyams mi nga ba seng ge lta bu'i spyod pa/ gang la yang chags zhen med pa bar snang gi rlung lta bu'i spyod pa/

ci la yang blo gtad mi bca' ba nam mkha' lta bu'i spyod pa/ dgag sgrub dang gza' gtad med pa smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa ste de lnga'i sgo nas rkyen thams cad lam du slong zhing gnas lugs la bogs 'don par bya'o// gnyis pa rnam rtog lam 'khyer/ gsum pa nyon mongs lam 'khyer/ bzhi pa lha 'dre lam 'khyer/ lnga pa sdug bsngal lam 'khyer/ drug pa na tsha lam 'khyer rnams ni 'dir yi ger 'jigs pas ma bris la/ de dag so sor nyams su blang bar 'dod na mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zab chos rnams su gsal zhing*/ de yang don dril na rnam rtog bzang ngan/ nyon mongs pa phra rags/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul/ rkyen ngan gyi sdug bsngal/ na tsha zug rngu sogs ci byung yang gong du bshad pa ltar gnas lugs kyi ngang du cham gyis bzhag pas chu dang rlabs ltar 'gyur ba dag go// bdun pa 'chi ba lam 'khyer 'di ni dgos pa gal po cher mthong bas cung zad brjod na/ mi tshe gang byung gi ring la rkyen ci byung yang lam du 'khyer nas goms par byas pas 'chi ba'i tshe thim rim la sogs pa ci byung yang ngo shes pa tsam byas la re dogs dang dgag sgrub kyi khu 'phrig med par gang shar de ga la blo ma bcos par gsal rjen lhang nge bskyangs pas/ thim rim rdzogs pa'i rjes la rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal 'char ba dang lam du bskyangs pa'i 'od gsal de ma bu 'dres pas chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gyur te 'tshang rgya bar bshad cing*/ gal te goms pa chung bas sangs ma rgyas kyang bar do dang skye ba'i lam 'khyer sngar gyi shugs kyis rang dbang thob par bshad do// drug pa rtog pa 'char tshul bogs 'don dang bcas pa la lnga/ 'char tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rtse gcig /spros bral/ ro gcig /sgom med rnams bogs 'don dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ gang zag cig car ba'i rigs la dang po gnas pa'i dus sam ngo sprad pa'i dus nas rtse gcig dang spros bral man chad dang*/

ro gcig man dang sgom med phyin chad cig car du skye ba sogs sna tshogs pa yod la skyes pa de yang brtan no// thod rgal ba la rnal 'byor bzhi snga ma ma brtan par phyi ma thol gyi skyes la skyes pa mi brtan par 'phel 'grib che bas mtshams la rgyun du gnas shing rtse gcig tu bsgom na rtogs pa brtan po thob la/ tshe 'di sgom yun thung na rtogs pa gsha' ma bar dor 'char bar bshad do// rim gyis pa la rnal 'byor bzhi rim pas 'char zhing snga ma brtan phyi ma rim gyis skyes la skyes pa de brtan te snying rus bskyed pa gal che'o// thod rgal ba dang rim gyis pa gnyis kyang bla ma la mos gus dang sgom la snying rus bskyed na cig car ba dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba la tshegs med par bshad cing*/ rigs gsum po so so la'ang blo rtsal che chung gi dbye bas skye lugs ma nges sna tshogs 'ong bar 'dug pas rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi bshad tshod thams cad dang khrigs rim 'grig pa rang gi nges bzung mi snang la/ 'on kyang rim gyis pa la rim can nges bzung du 'char ba'i tshul bshad na nges pa'i 'char tshul la'ang dge sbyor gyi gnas skabs dang blang dor phyed pas de ltar bshad par bya'o// gnyis pa rtse gcig chung 'bring che gsum/ gsum pa spros bral chung 'bring che gsum/ bzhi pa ro gcig chung 'bring che gsum/ lnga pa sgom med chung 'bring che gsum so so'i bogs 'don dang bcas pa ni 'dir yi ge mang gis dogs pas ma bris shing*/ de dag rtogs par 'dod na nyams myong gi gnad/ mgon po 'bri gung pa'i zab chos rnams su bshad pas der rtogs par bya'o// de ltar bshad ma thag pa rnams kyang slob ma so so'i nyams myong dang bstun nas rim gyis 'khrid cing ngo sprod pa yin gyi phyag chen gyi skor 'di rnams slob ma so so'i nyams myong dang ma bstun par zhag dang thun du bcad nas spros bcas kyi dmigs rim ltar kha bshad dang 'gro chos su mi bya zhing slob ma tshogs pa'i dbus su yang mi bya bar rang rang gi nyams myong dang bstun nas gdab dgos so// de lta bu'i gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs pa'i dgos pa ni|

gzhung las/ rtogam̐s pasam̐ rnamam̐ grolam̐ zhes pas gang rtogs na/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad mkha' ltar 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po gnas lugs tha mal gyi shes pa rtogs pa ste/ 'phags pa glang po'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das rtogs pa rtogs pa zhes bgyi ba 'di chos gang gi tshig bla dwags lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rtogs pa rtogs pa zhes bgyi ba de ni skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod pa yang dag pa thob pa'i tshig bla dwags so// zhes so// rtogs pa dang mi ldan pa'i skyon ni/ gzhung las/ 'dzim̐n pasam̐ sridam̐ param̐ 'chim̐ng*// zhes pas/ de yang phyi rol mu stegs pa rnams rtag tu lta ba'i dug gis zin/ nyan rang gi sde pa rnams chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dug gis zin/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dgag sgrub dang blang dor du 'dzin pa'i dug gis zin pas srid par 'ching ba ste/ slob dpon chos kyi grags pas/ gang la bdag tu 'dzin pas chags// der 'dzin pa la zhe sdang ngo*// de las 'jig tshogs skye de las// skye bo kun nas nyon mongs brten// zhes dang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ gang gi chos kyi gtso bo mchog /sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na// bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang*// de dag don med gyi nar 'khyams// zhes so// de lta bu'i rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa des gegs sel dang bogs 'don lam 'khyer ji ltar bgyid ce na/ de ni gzhung las/ dugam̐ nyidam̐ bdudam̐ rtsim̐ zhes pas/ dug ha la lta bu ni cung zad zos kyang srog 'dor ba'i nyes par 'gyur na yang sngags mkhan mkhas pas sngags btab na slar dug nad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad sel zhing srog 'tsho bar 'gyur te/ dgyes rdor las| dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis// skye bo thams cad 'chi 'gyur ba// dug gi de nyid shes pa yis// dug gis dug ni 'joms par byed// ces so/ */dpe de lta bu'i mtshon pa'i don ni|

gzhung las/ nyonam̐ mongam̐s yem̐ shesam̐ tem̐// zhes pa bshad ma thag pa'i lam 'khyer ro snyoms lta bus nyon mongs pa lam du bslangs nas nyon mongs pa spang ma dgos par/ nyon mongs lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gdod ma nas gshis babs su gnas pa rtogs par 'gyur te/ brtag gnyis las/ de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa// 'dod chags nyid kyis dbyung bar bya| |bzlog pa'i sgom pa 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes// zhes dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las/ thabs chen dag dang ldan pa la// nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur// 'khor ba zhi ba'i bdag nyid de// sngags kyis bsad pa'i dug bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas gdod ma nas rang rig chos sku'i ngo bor yod pa nyid ma rtogs pa la gti mug ces btags shing rtogs pa na chos sku zhes brjod kyi/ gdod nas med pa zhig slar mi 'byung ba ni/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos gshis la mi gnas na bltas pas mi 'gyur bar gsungs pa dag go/// / ༈ /spyi don lnga pa ni/ de lta bu dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po yang byang chub tu yongs su ma bsngos na 'dzad par 'gyur gyi 'phel zhing rgyas par mi 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung*// rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad// de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang*// byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad// ces pas dge ba'i rtsa ba de rnams zhing bsam dngos po gsum rnam par dag pas bsngo dgos la/ de yang 'gro ba la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar 'dod na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi ngang nas bsngo/ phyi nang gi bar chad zhi zhing sngags kyi yon tan thams cad 'grub par 'dod na lha'i bskyed rim gyi ngang nas bsngo/ bla ma'i thugs la 'dogs shing bla ma'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bar 'dod na bla ma'i mos gus kyi ngang nas bsngo/ rtogs pa gong nas gong du bogs thon par 'dod na gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas bsngo dgos la/

gzhan yang bsngo ba'i tshul rgyas pa ni sngar lan gnyis bshad pa ltar dang*/ don dril na 'khor gsum yongs dag gis rgyas gdab par bya ste/ de'i tshul ni/ bdag dang 'khor ba pa rnams dang*/ myang 'das kyi sar bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyis sngon byas zin pa'i dge ba dang*/ ma 'ongs par byed 'gyur gyi dge ba/ da ltar byed bzhin pa'i dge ba rnams dang lhag par bdag gzhan rnams la gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po gdod nas yod pa'i dge ba rnams gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya dgos pa gal po che ste/ de yang bde gshegs snying po bsngo ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'u las/ bde gshegs snying po khams dge ba// bsngos na 'bras bu smin par 'gyur| |zhes dang*/ byams pa'i smon lam las/ bdag gi kun mkhyen sa bon te// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so// de ltar dpal phag mo gru pa dang mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po yab sras kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhed pa dam pa'i chos lnga nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu ni gnyis te gnas skabs dang mthar thug go// dang po ni/ gzhung las/ mim̐ mthunam̐ skyonam̐ dgam̐ ces pas tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa gsum rtsad nas zad cing med pa 'gyur te/ bram ze chen po sa ra has/ bskal par bsags pa'i mun pa mthug po yang*/ /sgron me skyes ma thag gis sel ba ltar/ /'khor ba'i bag chags rgya chen mthug po yang*/ /rang sems rtogs pas skad cig gcig gis sel// zhes so// de yang sdig pa rnams zad cing dag pa'i dus na las kyi 'bras bu bag tsam yang rnam mkhyen thob pa'i gegs dang phyi mar mi myong bar tshe 'dir myong zhing zad par byed do// gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud las/ gang du rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos// chud mi za ba nges 'byung phyir// shin tu dag tshe sdug bsngal 'byung*// de nyid phra ba rtogs par dka'// zhes so// de ltar tshe 'dir smin pa'i tshe sngar bshad pa'i lam 'khyer dang thun mtshams su bshags sdom bgyis pas 'byang bar 'gyur te/

'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u las/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang*// bdag nyid smad dang bshags sdom bsngos pa yis// de dag srab par 'gyur zhing rtsa ba nas// gtan du phyung bar 'gyur zhes nga smra'o// zhes so// de ltar sdig pa byang zhing dag nas kyang gnas skabs su phan pa dang bde ba'i dpal thams cad 'bad med du 'byung ba yang*/ gzhung las/ dgosam̐ 'dom̐d namam̐ mkham̐'i mdzom̐d// ces pas dpe don sbyar na don dam byang sems phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa des kun rdzob byang sems yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che de lta bu la byi dor byas nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba thob par gdon mi za na 'jig rten gyi bde ba smos ci dgos pa ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ thar pa 'dod pas ting 'dzin rdul bral 'di 'dzin na// lha dang mi yi bde ba gya nom rnyed par 'gyur// lha dang mi yi mchod pa dam pa des thob ste// bsam gtan bde dang 'phags pa'i bde ba mchog kyang thob// ces pa nas/ sangs rgyas ye shes dam pa 'di la su dad pa// de dag 'dzam gling rin chen rigs shes bya ba yin// 'jig rten na ni de dang mnyam pa su yang med// de ni skye bo mang pos shin tu mchod par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar rgya cher gsungs so// gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ gzhung las/ drugam̐ dngam̐ bzhim̐ sogam̐s byangam̐ chubam̐ chom̐s rnamasam̐ rdzaugam̐s// zhes pas de la yang thabs kun rdzob byang sems kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rdzogs par byed de/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' chos gcig dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di dag dang chos gzhan yang dpag tu med pa dag yongs su 'dzin to// chos gcig gang zhe na/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems te/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' chos gcig po dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang chos gzhan yang dpag tu med par 'dzin to| |zhes so// de bzhin du shes rab kyis chos thams cad kyi chos nyid kyi rang bzhin rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i dus na chos thams cad kyi don la ma rtogs pa dang mngon du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med do// ting 'dzin rgyal po las/

chos kun don gcig par ni rab shes te// don go gcig tu stong pa nyid yin pas// de dag las ni tha dad gyur pa med// don gcig nyid du chos rnams ston par mdzad// ces so// de ltar thabs shes zung 'jug des sa lam bsgrod tshul ni/ gzhung las/ sam̐ dngam̐ lamam̐ bgrodam̐ ces pas gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po des ni sa lam sogs phar phyin theg pa nas bshad pa ltar grangs med gsum sogs dus yun ring po mi thogs par skad cig la bgrod de/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ rtogs dang sgom dang mthar phyin dang*// 'di la yod pa ma yin te// rtogs pas skad cig de nyid la// bcu yi sa la rab tu gnas// zhes so// tshul de lta bu ni mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bgrod ces pa'i don to// de lta bu'i tshul gyis skad cig ma de nyid la 'tshang rgya ba yang*/ gzhung las/ mim̐ gnasam̐ myam̐ nganam̐ 'dam̐s| |zhes pas/ shes rab zab mo'i don rtogs pas// 'khor bar mi gnas shing thabs byang chub sems kyis myang ngan las 'das par mi gnas na mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad de// sems can sred phyir brtser ldan zhing thob min// de ltar blo rtse byang chub thabs bstan na// 'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur// zhes so// de yang gzhung las/ byangam̐ chubam̐ cesam̐ brjodam̐ pas de ltar byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbyer med du gyur nas mngon par byang chub pa yang zer te/ 'jam dpal rnam rol gyi mdo las/ khye'u byang chub sems dpa' rang gi sems rtogs pas ma rtogs pa gzhan ci yang med do// rang gi sems rtogs pa gang yin pa de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rtogs pa yin no// zhes so// gzhan yang gzhung las/ bdem̐ gshegam̐s zhes pas de ltar byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbyer med du rtogs pa de'i ngang du gshegs pa dang gnas par mdzad pas bde bar gshegs pa zhes kyang brjod de/

rgyal ba'i yum sdud pa las/ mkhas pa 'jig rten gnas sam myang ngan 'das kyang rung*| |chos nyid skyon med chos rnams stong pa 'di gnas te// byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin nyid 'di rjes su rtogs// de phyir de bzhin gshegs zhes sangs rgyas mtshan gsol to| |zhes so// gzhan yang gzhung las/ sangam̐s rgyasam̐ bstam̐n// zhes pas byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbyer med du gyur pa'i tshe mnyam rjes med pa na sangs rgyas te/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems bsgom pas ni sangs rgyas 'thob// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces so| |tshul de lta bu la dgongs nas/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ sangs rgyas ni byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs zhes gsungs so// de ltar rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de brtson pa chung yang mchog 'grub par yun ring po mi thogs par 'grub ste/ gzhung las/ bdem̐n mthom̐ng brtsom̐n minam̐ b.ram̐ doram̐ gsam̐l bzhagam̐ spangam̐*// zhes pas byang chub sems dpa' gnas lugs kyi bden pa mthong ba de brtson pa dang mi ldan na tshe 'dir sangs ma rgyas kyang bar dor mchog 'grub cing sdug bsngal gyi chu bo bzhi yang rim pa gnyis su grol ba kho na ste/ spyod bsdus las/ skye bo gang zhig kun rdzob bden pa ste// 'chi ba'i ming ni don dam bden pa yin// rim gnyis tha ma gcig tu gyur pa gang*// rnyed pa 'di ni ma 'ongs sangs rgyas yin// zhes so// de lta bu'i gang zag ni sdug bsngal gyi chu bo las 'das zin kyang gzhan don du snying brtses skye ba len pa'i tshul tsam yin gyi las kyis 'khor ba ni ma yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir// skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang*// snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang*// 'chi dang rga dang na bar ston// zhes so// de ltar bstan pa'i don rnams mdor dril na skye ba 'dir grol lam bar dor grol yang rung*/

brtson pa rab 'bring tsam ma gtogs mthar skad cig la don gnyis 'grub pa ste/ dang po bdag don du chos kyi sku 'grub pa ni/ gzhung las/ sgribam̐ gsumam̐ drim̐ bralam̐ dbyem̐r mem̐d chom̐s ྃskum̐ 'thom̐b// ces pas khams rang bzhin rnam dag chos skur gnas pa de las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa gsum so thar byang sems gsang sngags gsum gyi bslab pas sbyangs shing gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po rtogs par byas te dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku thob ste/ slob dpon ār+ya de wa'i man ngag las/ slob bzhin pa la bslab nas ni// mi slob zung 'jug chos sku 'thob// ces so/ chos kyi sku gang zhe na/ gzhung las/ donam̐ dmam̐ zhim̐ khyabam̐ ces pas 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pas na zhi ba/ spros pa'i mtshan mas ma gos pas zhi ba/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas na khyab pa ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med// mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs// nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi// sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te// zhes sogs gsungs so// de yang tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ gzhung las/ rtogam̐ bralam̐ namam̐ mkha'am̐ bzhim̐n// zhes pas/ nam mkha' la mtha' dbus phyogs lhung sogs med pa ltar chos sku de yang ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi khams rgyud la gnas pa ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ rang gi ngo bo nyid gyur zab pa'i tshul// rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur zhib mor bsam pas na// don dam bde mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa ni// nam mkha' bzhin du rgyu mtshan rnams dang bral// zhes so// de ltar bdag don chos sku las gzhan don gzugs skur snang tshul ni/ gzhung las/ chosam̐ dngam̐ longam̐s spyodam̐ snam̐ tshogam̐s 'dom̐d dgum̐r sprulam̐// zhes pas chos sku spros bral de'i rang rtsal 'gag med las gdul bya'i don du gzugs kyi sku gnyis su snang tshul bstan pa ste/

sku gsum bstan pa'i mdo las/ sa'i snying po dper na nam mkha' stong pa la brten nas sprin 'byung ba'o// sprin la brten nas char 'byung ba'o// de bzhin du chos kyi sku la brten nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku snang ngo*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la brten nas sprul pa'i sku snang ngo*// zhes so// de ltar mchog gi sprul skur ma zad gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i sprul pa mchog dman mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i don byed pa'o// 'khor lo sdom pa nges brjod rgyud bla ma las/ rdo rje can ni thams cad du// cha med cha ni rnam spangs pa// lus la 'das shing gos pa med// la la gzugs can dag tu bzhugs// zhes pa nas/ la lar sreg pa'i me dag dang*// la lar mtho ris skye ba dang*// rnam par sprul pa 'di lta bur// brten nas 'gro ba 'dul bar mdzad// ces pa'i bar gyis sprul pa mchog dman bar ma sna tshogs su snang bar gsungs so// de ltar bstan kyang rtog pa mi mnga' ba ni/ gzhung las| mim̐ rtogam̐ yidam̐ bzhim̐n noram̐ ltaram̐ mdzadam̐ pa'im̐ rgyunam̐// zhes pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la rtog pa med kyang gdul bya'i bsam pa la ji ltar 'dod pa stsol ba ltar/ chos kyi sku la rtog pa med kyang gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham pa ni gdul bya ma zad kyi bar du sprul pa mi zad par ston pa ste/ dad pas stobs bskyed pa'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal 'di lta ste/ dper na nor bu baiḍūr+ya ni rnam par mi rtog mod kyi dngos po'i dbang gis bya ba rnam pa mtha' yas pa gzhal du med pa 'di lta bu dag 'byung ngo*// 'jam dpal de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad du skad cig ma rnam pa tha dad pa gzhal du med pa dag 'byung ste/

de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog rnam par mi rtog mod kyi/ 'on kyang ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa 'di lta bu dag ston pa la thogs pa med do// zhes so// de lta bu'i sangs rgyas de la ye shes ji lta bu mnga' zhe na/ gzhung las/ mtham̐' bralam̐ kunam̐ mkhyenam̐ zagam̐ medam̐ yem̐ shesam̐ gzigam̐s| |zhes ye shes mnga' ba dang mi mnga' ba gnyis ka yod med kyi mtha' yin pas/ 'dir ni mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan de nyid chos dbyings ye she| de'i rang rtsal me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar longs skur snang ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ srid zhi mnyam pa nyid du dag pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ dus gsum shes bya thams cad chags thogs med par mkhyen pa sor rtog ye shes/ sprul pas sems can gyi khams dang mnyam par khyab cing gang la gang 'dul gyis don mdzad pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste// ye shes gsum ni de la brten// mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa nyid yin no// zhes so// de rnams ni ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam pa gnyis su 'dus so// de lta bu'i sangs rgyas de'i bral ba'i yon tan ni gzhung las/ stobam̐s bcum̐ mim̐ 'jim̐gs mam̐ 'dresam̐ yonam̐ tanam̐ rdzogam̐s// zhes pas/ sangs rgyas de la stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad rnams mnga' ba ni bral ba'i 'bras bu ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ stobs nyid ma rig sgrib pa rdo rje bzhin| |mi 'jigs nyid ni khor yug seng ge bzhin// de bzhin gshegs pa ma 'dres mkha' bzhin te// thub pa'i ston pa rnam gnyis chu zla bzhin// zhes sogs rnam smin gyi yon tan ni/ gzhung las/ mtshanam̐ dngam̐ dpem̐ byad ྃkyisam̐ brgyanam̐ ces pas sangs rgyas de'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni sku la mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/

dpe byad brgyad cus yang dag par mdzes pa ste| mtshan bzang ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ legs gnas 'khor los mtshan pa dang*// yangs dang zhabs long mi mngon dang*// zhes pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab sum cu rtsa gnyis so| |'di dag ston pa'i mi dbang mtshan du gsungs/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ dpe byad ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog ltar mdzes dang*// zhes pa nas/ dpal gyi be'u bkra shis ni// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por 'dod// ces pa'i bar gsungs so// de lta bu'i sangs rgyas de gdul bya'i snang ngor snang tshul ston pa ni/ gzhung las/ chum̐ zla ྃbzhim̐n// zhes pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rtog pa med kyang chu snod che chung thams cad du re re snang ba ltar chos kyi sku la rtog pa med kyang gdul bya mchog dman bar ma thams cad kyi snang ngor mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gzugs sku dang ma brgyan pa'i rnam pa du ma snang bar 'gyur te/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar sprin med nam mkha'i zla ba'i gzugs// ston ka'i chu sngon mtshor ni mthong ba ltar// de bzhin rgyal sras tshogs kyi khyab bdag gzugs// rdzogs sangs dkyil 'khor nang du mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes so// de lta bu'i sangs rgyas la phrin las 'byung tshul ni/ gzhung las/ phrinam̐ lasam̐ lhunam̐ grubam̐ rgyunam̐ chadam̐ medam̐ pam̐ 'byungam̐*// zhes pas sangs rgyas la rtog pa med kyang gdul bya'i dbang gis phrin las ni 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa gdul bya ma zad kyi bar du rgyun chad med par sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba dang mdzad pa ni/ dpe dgu'i phyogs tsam mtshon zhing de dag las 'phags pa ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dbyangs dang mi ldan de 'dra min// lha yi rnga bzhin thams cad du// don byed min pa de 'dra min// sprin chen dang mtshungs don med pa'i// sa bon spong min de 'dra min// tshangs chen bzhin te gtan du ni// smin par byed min de 'dra min// nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin gtan du ni// mun pa 'joms min de 'dra min|

|yid bzhin nor 'dra 'byung ba ni// rnyed par mi dka' de 'dra min// sgra snyan bzhin du rkyen las ni// byung ba de dang 'dra ba'ang min// nam mkha' dang 'dra dag pa yi// gzhi min de dang 'dra ba'ang min// 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa// 'gro ba'i phun tshogs ma lus pa// de gnas pa yi rten yin phyir// sa yi dkyil 'khor dag dang 'dra// zhes gsungs so/ de lta bu'i mdzad pa ni/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'byung bar 'gyur te/ gser 'od dam pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te// sems can rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir// mya ngan 'da' bar bstan pa yin// zhes so// phrin las de lta bu spyir 'jug tshul ni/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ mos pa du ma'i sems can la// spyod pa sna tshogs ston mdzad de// sna tshogs tshul gyis gdul bya la// thabs ni sna tshogs ston pa yin// zhes so// bye brag snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bod gdong dmar mi'i yul 'dir sangs rgyas nyid sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i tshul gyis ston par nges te/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ bskal pa bzang po'i rgyal sras rnams// mi yul bod kyi grong khyer der// skye ba dag kyang bzhes 'gyur zhing*/ /mi dang 'dra ba snang bar 'gyur// zhes so// de ltar mdo thams cad kyi snying po/ gsung rab thams cad kyi lde'u mig /rgyud sde bzhi'i gnad bsdus pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang ba bka'i rgya bkrol ba/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi gsang mdzod rdol ba/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i gnad ma lus pa gang zag gcig gis stan thog gcig thun gcig gi khongs su nyams len bya ba'i gnad phyag rgya chen po'i khrid yig lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan 'di nyid la ma rtogs pa dang*/ log par rtog pa dang*/ the tshom du gyur pa spang ba'i phyir so sor lung rnam dag gi yid ches so sor sbyar ba ste/
gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ lung gi

nges byed tshig yin te// nges pa med pa rdzun gyi tshig /smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir// nges byed lung du shes par bya// zhes so// lung dang mi ldan pa'i gdams pa ston pa ni/ rang gzhan gnyis phung gi las yin te/ 'phags pa rgyan stug po'i mdo las/ yid ches lung dang mi ldan par// chos gang ston par byed pa ni// rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid do// bdag kyang chud zos gzhan chud zos// zhes so// des na deng sang bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len sdom gsum gyi snying po 'di lta bu yal bar dor nas 'di las gzhan pa'i zhal gzigs dang nyams la shar ba dang*/ sa'i 'og nas rnyed pa dang*/ rang gi rig pa las rdol ba dang*/ nam mkha' nas mkha' 'gro mas 'di skad zer ro bya ba dang*/ gzhan yang lung dang mi ldan zhing*/ sdom pa gsum dang mdo sngags la ma grags pa'i zab zab mo nyung bsdus 'khyer bde zhes 'khrul ba'i rtog pas don log par bsdebs shing*/ 'thad bsdus kyi rgyu mtshan mang po bkod nas zab chos yin zhes smra zhing rang la nyams myong med par kha gsag dang dpe ltas ngag sgros kyis slob ma 'khrid pa dag mthong bas 'di rnams ni blun po mgo bo bskor zhing yid bslu bar byed pa'i chod nyid rnyed 'tshol dang bze zong yin pas de rnams chos su rlom pa ni sbrang mas khyi lud kyi ro nyams su myong ba'am/ sbur pas lci leb la gzhal yas khang du mthong ba dang khyad med la/ de lta bu'i bshes gnyen la 'khor dang longs spyod 'du ba ni mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med kyang sbrang ma'i tshogs 'khrul snang gis 'du ba dang khyad med de/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha'i man ngag las/ ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus su ni// lung zab man ngag mi bsten par// 'thad sgrub rig gnyis gtsor byed pa// rang rang grub mtha' dam par 'dzin| |sbas don tsam gyi chos byed cing*/ /mthar thug lta ba zab mo la// mi mos slar yang sun 'byin byed// des bdag nyid dang gzhan brlag 'gyur// zhes so// de lta bu bshes gnyen ni nyes pa'i rgyu ste/

slob dpon 'phags pas/ shin tu yang dag min par smra gyur na// ltung 'gyur lcags sreg brgya phrag lce la 'debs// zhes so| |de ltar na nges don gyi snying por gyur pa'i bstan bcos 'di yang bdag gis khengs 'dod dang nga rgyal sogs rang nyid kyi che thabs ma yin par rgyal ba'i bka' dpang du byas shing sgrub brgyud gong ma rnams dang*/ khyad par mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi gsang ba'i gnad mtha' dag bsdus te/ mi shes pa rnams kyi slob dpon/ mi gsal ba rnams kyi gsal 'debs| ma rtogs pa rnams kyi ngo sprod/ shes pa rnams kyi brjed bskul/ rang nyid kyi dran pa gso ba dang rjes 'jug skal ldan kun la phan pa'i blos sbyar ba ste/ de bas na rgyal ba'i bka' dang mtshungs pa'i phyir nyams su blang bar rigs te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gis// dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad// thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes 'brel ba// de yang drang srong gsung bzhin spyi bos blang*// zhes so// de ltar lung dang rigs pas gtan la phab cing myong ba'i gnad dang bcas pa'i lam 'di lta bus bslu ba mi srid de/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las/ lha dang drang srong bden pa'i ngag /gang la sbyar ba'i nus pa yang*// bslu ba med par ma mthong na// smon lam snying rjes gzhan don 'jug |mi shes chags pa mi mnga' bas// thams cad mkhyen pas smos ci dgos// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// smras pa/ rgyal kun ngo bo klu zhabs 'bri gung pa'i// zab chos lnga ldan gdengs can gtsug gi nor// deng sang 'khrul ba'i dri mas bsgribs mthong nas// gsal byed mdzes rgyan dam pa 'di smras so// mdo sngags rgyu 'bras theg pa'i zab don dpyid// grub chen kun gyi bzhed srol rdo rje'i gsung*// nges gsang phyag rgya che zhes grags pa'i lam// deng sang bshes gnyen phal gyis log par spyod// la las tha snyad tsam gyis rtogs par

rlom// kha cig dpyad sgom yin rlom khengs shing dregs// 'ga' zhig ngag sgros phyi la khyi bzhin 'brang*// la las gnas 'gyu tsam la ngor mthong smra// gzhan dag kha mkhas don la rmongs zhing nongs// phyogs 'dir lung rigs legs bshad myong grub kyis// gnyug ma'i rang zhal bstan na rgyab kyis phyogs// khe grags longs spyod 'khor mang 'dus pa'i dbus// dar zab lwa ba'i gos kyi rdzu bag dang*// khri mthon rtse nas gzhan dag bslu ba'i ngag /spyod lam btsun btsun des pas smra ba la// kun yid dad pas 'jug pa sha thang ngo*| |gnas lugs mnyam nyid sems kyi rdo rje dngos// tha snyad ngag sgros tsam gyi ngo sprod pa// srin bu'i 'od kyis gling kun gsal ba dang*// sbrang bu'i mchu yis rgya mtsho'i gting dpag dang*| |wa skyes sder chags rgyal por bkur dang mtshungs// de nyid gnyug ma chos sku'i 'od gsal ba// ji bzhin rtogs 'dod rgya la yod srid na// mdo sngags shing rta'i lam srol ma nyams shing*// nges don sgom rim gnad la ma rmongs pa'i// legs bshad bstan pa'i yang snying 'di longs la// don ldan sgrub pa'i go sa rab bzung nas// sku bzhi bde blag 'grub pa'i lag rjes zhog /de ltar de brtsams pa las ni// byung ba'i dge ba 'dis mtshon nas// 'khor 'das bsags yod rnam dkar tshogs// kun mkhyen 'thob phyir bsngo bar bgyi// de ltar theg chen bstan pa'i snying po'i khrid yig bstan pa'i yang snying zhes sam/ yang na lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi lam gyi gnad ma lus pa bsdus shing*/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i zab chos dgongs pa gcig pa sogs gtso bo byas pa la sgrub brgyud gong ma'i yongs 'dzin bka' drin can rnams kyi gsung gi gsang ba zab mo rnams kyis legs par kha bskangs te blo chung rnams 'jug bde ba'i phyir nyung ngur bsdus shing yid ches kyi lung re re tsam gyis brgyan pa ste/

'di yang gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i don mngon du byas pa 'khor 'das rang sems su rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ rim pa gnyis kyi lam gyi gnad la ma rmongs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas/ rab byung lo mgo'i zla ba'i phyogs snga ma'i dga' ba dang po la lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po pho brang bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //maṅga laṃ//
